Generate inorganic materials candidates without property...
other.summary_zh: MatterGen 是 Microsoft Research AI for Science 材料設計團隊開發的無機材料生成模型,成果發表於 Nature。新材料開發傳統上依賴高成本的實驗試錯,或僅能從既有資料庫篩選已知結構;MatterGen 改採生成式取徑,直接產出全新的候選晶體結構。其核心是一個擴散模型(diffusion model),可同時預測材料的原子分數座標、元素種類與單位晶格向量,亦即完整生成一個週期性晶體結構。除了無條件生成材料候選,MatterGen 亦可透過訓練或 fine-tuning 達成條件式生成,依目標性質引導輸出,例如指定體積模數(bulk modulus)、化學系統或磁密度等,提升材料搜尋的可控性。就證據面而言,本頁面僅提供摘要層級資訊,論文中詳細的實驗結果、與既有方法的基準比較及事後驗證細節在此無法完整查核,讀者應參閱原文;生成結構的合成可行性與實際性質表現,仍須仰賴後續計算與實驗驗證把關。模型以 MIT 授權釋出,程式碼可於 GitHub 存取,有利於重現與延伸研究。整體而言,MatterGen 展示了擴散生成模型在材料科學的應用潛力,將無機材料探索由「篩選既有資料」推向「依性質主動生成」的新典範,對能源、磁性材料等領域的開發具有指標性意義。

other.summary: **SQuadGen** is a diffusion-based generative framework for synthesizing simple quad layouts on 3D shapes. It introduces **Chart Distance Fields (CDF)**, a continuous surface-based representation that makes quad-layout generation amenable to neural learning while preserving structure useful for downstream modeling and editing. This repository hosts the pretrained checkpoints and matching configuration files used by the official inference scripts. It is intended as the model release page; installation, data preparation, training, evaluation, and full inference instructions are maintained in the GitHub repository. - **Developed by:** Youkang Kong, Yang Liu, Yue Dong, Xin Tong, Heung-Yeung Shum - **Affiliation:** Tsinghua University, Microsoft Research Asia - **Model Type:** Latent diffusion...
other.summary_zh: SQuadGen針對三維形狀上的四邊形網格(quad)布局自動化問題:傳統上,quad layout的規劃高度依賴人工操作,現有自動化方法則難以兼顧布局簡潔性與下游建模、編輯所需的結構品質。為此,作者提出一套以擴散模型(diffusion)為基礎的生成式框架,並引入Chart Distance Fields(CDF)作為核心表示:CDF是一種連續的曲面表示方式,使四邊形布局的合成得以轉化為可透過神經網路學習的問題,同時保留對下游建模與編輯有用的結構資訊。依據模型卡,此模型屬於latent diffusion類型,由清華大學與微軟亞洲研究院(Microsoft Research Asia)團隊開發。此頁面定位為模型發布頁,提供預訓練權重(checkpoints)與對應設定檔,搭配官方推論腳本使用;摘要層級的內容並未呈現量化評估、基準比較或消融實驗等具體證據,安裝、資料準備、訓練、評估與完整推論流程均維護於GitHub儲存庫,讀者應以該處文件為準。整體而言,本研究展示了將離散、結構化的四邊形布局問題轉換為連續表示後交由生成模型學習的可行性,對3D內容創作、遊戲與動畫資產製作等下游應用具有潛在價值,但實際效能與限制仍需參閱原論文與程式碼方能確認。

links.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO

evidence: Abstract & Section 3.2: ES improves average Pass@1/16/32 over base and exceeds GRPO on Pass@16/32; GRPO falls below base on Pass@16/32 in 15 of 18 Easy-Setting comparisons (Tables 2-3)

Section 3.1 & Appendix A: Lemma 1 gives E[JS]=sigma^2/2(1-1/N)tr(I_x)+O(sigma^4) (Eq. 9); Proposition 1 (Eqs. 12-14) requires an assumed KL transfer-error bound epsilon_succ that is not empirically verified
Section 4.2, Table 4: Full ES relative L2 drift is 40.7-44.1x GRPO; largest ES updates concentrate in LayerNorm/attention parameters while GRPO's top updates sit in embeddings/LM head
Appendix D, Tables 11-12: magnitude-thresholded ES retains Pass@1 with changes of -0.351 to +0.488 points at ~78% update sparsity, degrading only beyond ~92%
Section 5.1, Table 6: N=16 within 0.01 of N=64 reward for 1.5B/3B models but only N=32 for 0.5B at update 300, supporting decreasing population-size needs with scale

Section 5.2 & Appendix E, Table 13: two-point/antithetic subtraction fails to reduce variance for regenerated GSM8K rollouts (kappa_pair 1.99-2.78) though it works for fixed-batch objectives (0.16), explaining one-point preference

Appendix G, Tables 14-17: complete hyperparameters, evaluation settings, prompt templates, dataset provenance/licenses; GitHub repository link given in title-footnote; no seed repetitions or confidence intervals reported for main comparisons
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work directly matching high-weight preferences (LLM reasoning post-training, GRPO/RL comparison, CoT, scaling/efficiency). Contributions are analytical rather than a new method: theory linking ES population JS diversity to Pass@K, empirical demonstration that ES avoids GRPO-style entropy collapse and Pass@16/32 degradation, functional-sparsity analysis of ES updates, and hyperparameter/scaling study. Theory is correct but partly standard (AM-GM, Pinsker, Fisher expansions) and Proposition 1 relies on a transfer-error condition (Eq. 12) that is stated as testable but not directly measured. Empirics cover 4 models, two settings, held-out suites, and careful estimator diagnostics (Appendix E), but main RL/ES comparisons appear to be single runs with no variance or significance reporting, and some deltas (e.g., +0.07-0.8 points, Table 11) are small. Reproducibility is strong: GitHub link, full hyperparameters (Table 14), evaluation protocol (Table 15), prompts, and dataset licenses. Novelty limited by existing ES-for-LLM work (Qiu et al., ESSA, EGGROLL) that the paper builds on.

primary_link.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO

papers.summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lead to broader reasoning coverage, thereby better exploiting the reasoning capabilities of pretrained LLMs. Theoretically, we show that verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity across the ES population is helpful to higher Pass@K performances. Empirically, unlike GRPO, which exhibits entropy collapse, ES improves Pass@1 while attaining higher Pass@K than GRPO. We further develop a sequential GRPO-ES training strategy that combines GRPO's strength in Pass@1 with ES's gains in Pass@K. Second, we find that despite substantial whole-model parameter drift, the task-performance gains of ES are only contributed to a sparse subset of larger-magnitude updates. This functional sparsity suggests that large parameter movement need not imply widespread functional change, and held-out evaluations further show that it does not necessarily lead to catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we study how hyperparameter design affects the effectiveness of ES, demonstrating that ES requires a smaller population size in a larger LLM. These findings position ES as a distinct reasoning post-training paradigm rather than a less effective, memory-efficient alternative to GRPO.
papers.summary_zh: 本論文系統性探討演化策略（Evolution Strategies, ES）作為大型語言模型（LLM）推理後訓練方法的最佳化行為，並與主流方法 GRPO 比較。作者圍繞三個研究問題：ES 是否呈現與 GRPO 相同的後訓練特性、ES 是否必然導致災難性遺忘，以及何種超參數與估計量設計能使 ES 有效且可擴展。理論上，論文證明 ES 群體間的 verifier 投影 Jensen–Shannon 多樣性有助於提升 Pass@K；實證上，與出現熵坍縮、Pass@K 下降的 GRPO 不同，ES 在改善 Pass@1 之餘仍維持較廣的推理覆蓋率，作者並提出 GRPO→ES 與 ES→GRPO 兩種序列混合訓練，兼取 GRPO 的 Pass@1 與 ES 的 Pass@K 優勢。關於遺忘，研究發現 ES 雖造成整體參數大幅漂移（與初始化的距離約為 GRPO 的四十倍），但效能增益主要來自少數幅度較大的更新，集中於 LayerNorm 與注意力參數，展現功能性稀疏性；held-out 評估顯示能力大致保留，大參數位移未必導致災難性遺忘。設計研究進一步指出 z-score 獎勵正規化是關鍵要素，two-point 估計量對推理任務無優勢，且模型越大所需群體規模越小。限制在於理論結果依賴局部近似與傳遞誤差預算等假設，遺忘結論限於特定訓練設定，跨任務持續學習情境仍待驗證。整體而言，本論文將 ES 定位為獨立的推理後訓練典範，而非只是節省 GPU 記憶體的 GRPO 替代方案。

links.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable

evidence: Abstract: across 12 frontier models commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence escalates; fully fabricated panel lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from 37.6% with real data
§3.1: scrambled minus rich is +0.7pp with 90% case-clustered CI [-2.1, +3.1]; restricted to three responsive models the difference is +11.11pp, CI [+4.17, +18.06]
§3.3: three Claude models carry the effect while four models never commit and three always commit; Qwen3.7-plus output unparseable on 75.0% of rows
§5: committed-call AUROC 0.346 (CI [0.280, 0.413]) and Brier Skill Score -0.124 against climatology, while matched answerable controls are answered at 98.6-100% accuracy (0 of 864 declines)
§6.6: tense-balanced control with 48 answerable-future and 54 unknowable-present items; trained 3B declines 0% and 100% of these respectively, within-tense J +97/+100
§8: under the reasoning-suppressing frontier framing, ablation seed 1 commits on 48 of 48 unknowable items with a real probability, and answerable accuracy falls to 50.9-73.8%
§7: trained 3B commits 0.0% at all four evidence levels on the original 40 cases, but frontier baseline was sampled at temperature 0.3 vs. the trained model's greedy decoding
Limitations: weather is the weakest instrument (no sealed outcomes, ensemble rain probability carries real skill), effect rests on one developer's models, intervention tested at one 3B scale

Data and code availability: all raw cached generations, analysis scripts, pre-registration released at github.com/Pranav-1100/confidence-calibration-evaluation, archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22043517
Table 3 note contains contradictory statements about how many checkpoints back 'independent runs' vs 'main recipe' ranges (six/seven vs three/four), an internal editing inconsistency
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong in-scope LLM-agent safety paper: measures when agents act on aleatoric (unknowable) questions under authoritative-looking evidence, isolating presentation vs. information via fabricated panels, then fine-tunes the act/decline gate. Preference match is excellent (agents/tool use, AI safety, calibration/interpretability, LLMs, SFT/DPO training). Novelty is solid: the full-fabrication control answering the v1 confound, action-level (not stated-probability) measurement, and the failure-boundary analysis (reasoning slot required) go beyond the abstention and calibration literature, though adjacent concurrent work (AgentAbstain, Pal et al., Sun et al.) reaches similar localizations. Rigor is unusually careful (matched answerable controls, degenerate-strategy baselines, TOST equivalence, case-clustered bootstrap, tense-balanced and sports-overlap ablations, disclosed post-hoc choices), but is dented by single-sample cells, a temperature mismatch in the headline §7 comparison, editing residue (contradictory range counts under Table 3), and heavy reliance on heterogeneous per-family behavior. Evidence is abundant with sealed outcomes in equity/crypto, but the pivotal fabricated-vs-real equivalence is carried by three models from one developer, and weather lacks sealed outcomes (disclosed). Generalizability is limited: one 3B architecture at one scale, effect concentrated in one model family, and the paper itself flags scale fragility. Reproducibility is excellent: verbatim prompts, cached generations, scripts, pre-registration, and archived DOIs released.

primary_link.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable

papers.summary: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguisha
papers.summary_zh: 本論文研究 LLM 代理面對本質上不可預測問題時，在行動層次的校準失敗。作者以封存結果的短期股價方向、加密貨幣價格、體育賽事與天氣預報題目建構不可知性基準，檢驗證據呈現方式如何左右模型的承諾（commitment）行為。結果顯示，12 個前沿模型收到裸問題時僅 6.5% 選擇回答，附上專業技術指標面板後躍升至 54.0%。關鍵的因果控制實驗指出：將面板上六項技術指標全數換成捏造數值，甚至整個面板完全造假，承諾率仍與真實資料統計上無異（36.8% 對 37.6%），證明觸發行動的是權威包裝而非資訊本身。失敗被定位在行動閘門：同批模型對可回答的對照題近乎全對，也能標記題目不可知（90%），但該判斷未被用來抑制回答；陳述機率的 AUROC 僅 0.346，比氣候基準更差。訓練方面，僅用 540 個骰子、硬幣、罐子與計時器等合成案例微調 Qwen2.5-3B，即能把原始案例承諾率降至 0.0% 並轉移到未見領域；但閘門對提示結構脆弱，當輸出格式不留推理空間時即失效，某次消融訓練甚至在 48 題不可知題目上全數承諾並附機率。限制包括天氣域缺乏封存結果、效應集中於單一開發商的模型、訓練僅驗證 3B 規模、殘留詞彙線索未完全排除。本文提醒：代理評估應審計決策而非陳述機率，部署環境中的權威儀表板可能侵蝕模型拒答不可知問題的能力。

links.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms

evidence: Abstract/Section 1.1 and Table 1: gpt-5.6-sol is 'no worse' than the best existing method on every instance in six of ten classes at each level, with nested logit the main exception (mean revenue 1.2% lower)
Section 3.3/Table 3: on six exactly solvable short-lead-time instances, gpt-5.6-sol matches the DP optimum at level 1 and level 2, with all 95% CI half-widths below 0.05
Section 6.1/Table 7: zero-compute ablation shows level-2 algorithms remain within 0.4 points of full-budget results on the lead-time sweep, while level-1 policies degrade by 3.5-13%
Section 6.2: frozen level-2 artifacts are re-evaluated on new holdout instances ('no model is queried again'), including continuous-utility MMNL instances designed to remove the two-type structure
Section 6.3: stability study runs ten additional level-2 draws per class; 'five of 97 repeated draws fail under the evaluation protocol' and selected artifacts are shown not to be outliers
Section 5.4: authors caveat that all 628 released MMNL instances have only two distinct product-utility vectors, so exactness on the benchmark does not imply a general exact MMNL solver

Section 1.2: acknowledges contamination risk ('we also cannot rule out that benchmark-specific information... appeared in model training') and that generated algorithms resemble combinations of known OR structures
Appendix A: all code, prompts, and complete run records (queries, reasoning summaries, executed code, outputs, token usage) are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/llm-or-algorithms-F9F2
llm_evaluation.rationale: A centrally LLM-focused empirical capability study: four frontier models are evaluated on algorithm design for inventory, queueing, and assortment benchmarks using a minimal untuned prompt with a Python sandbox tool, directly matching LLM (2.5), Agents & Tool Use (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), and prompting-preference areas; it is an LLM evaluation, not a pure domain application. The level-1 vs level-2 taxonomy (instance solution vs reusable algorithm) is a clean framing, though LLM-for-algorithm-design is a growing area (CO-Bench, HeuriGym cited in Section 1.3), so novelty is good but not exceptional. Rigor is high: exact DP evaluation where feasible (Table 3), simulator validation against published values (Appendix B.1), zero-compute ablation (Section 6.1), frozen-artifact holdouts (Section 6.2), and a repeated-draws stability study (Section 6.3). Evidence is strong with per-instance tables, CIs, and timing data, but limited to three OR domains; the authors themselves flag the two-type structure of the MMNL benchmark (Section 5.4) and possible contamination (Section 1.2), which caps generalizability. Reproducibility is excellent: full prompts, code, and all run records are released (Appendix A, anonymous.4open.science link).

primary_link.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms

papers.summary: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Hu
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）能否為定義明確的作業研究（OR）問題設計有效演算法。作者在三大經典領域實驗：存貨控制（含缺貨損失、雙源採購、多階層配送）、多類別排隊網路控制，以及品項組合（assortment）最佳化，合計 34 個存貨、13 個排隊與 3,393 個組合實例。研究設計兩種呼叫層級：Level 1 針對單一實例直接求解；Level 2 只給問題類別描述與參數範圍，由模型回傳可跨實例重複使用的演算法程式碼。每個結果僅用一次未調校的提示詞，並附 Python 沙盒與固定運算預算。結果顯示，最強模型 gpt-5.6-sol 在幾乎所有實例上追平或超越既有最佳方法，包括精確動態規劃與逐實例訓練的深度強化學習基準；Level 2 成效尤為關鍵，且即使移除查詢時運算、或改在新生成的新實例上測試，表現大多維持。四個模型在八個月內陸續推出，能力差距明顯，顯示此技術快速進步。產出演算法結構可解讀，如 capped base-stock 變形、小型動態規劃與壓力型排程規則。限制包括無法排除基準資料汙染、未提供近似保證、演算法多為已知方法的重組，且問題類別定義過寬會誘發通用策略失效。整體而言，在文獻豐富的定義明確問題上，前沿 LLM 已能以低成本產生可檢視的強健演算法，可作為演算法設計的經驗基準。
papers.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms
papers.title_zh: LLM 能設計近乎最佳的作業研究演算法

links.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090

evidence: Abstract: best checkpoint trained at compute cost less than $6.9K and approaches Qwen2.5-1.5B under the report's evaluation protocol; full recipe, data, code, and weights released under Apache 2.0 at the HuggingFace thu-pacman collection.

Section 2.2: reproduction-cost boundary explicitly excludes data preprocessing, proxy experiments, ablations, post-training, evaluation, and labor, defining the headline cost as marginal accelerator cost only.

Section 3.2 / Figure 10(b): blockwise FP8 increases validation loss by 0.0031-0.0039 relative to BF16 across five ladder sizes, mapped to 98.0% BF16-equivalent compute retention, with 1.36x median throughput at 1.7B and 1.34x quality-adjusted net speedup.

Section 3.3.1: 170M BF16 diagnostic shows MuonH reaches final validation loss 3.029 versus 3.073 for ordinary-LR Muon, while effective-LR-aligned Muon reaches 3.030, supporting the effective-LR schedule interpretation.

Appendix D: matched scaling ladder fits a 1.19x compute-equivalent multiplier for complete MuonH vs tuned Muon, with leave-one-out range 1.17-1.28x, explicitly labeled a counterfactual quality-equivalent saving.

Section 5 / Tables 11-13: curriculum initialization beats uniform in all three repetitions for focused (+1.77pp) and scaled (+2.02pp) GSM8K SFT, and broad instruction SFT improves the 15-task macro-average by +1.59pp with 13 of 15 components improved.

Appendix A (Limitations): no corpus-wide contamination audit against benchmarks is provided; Chinese capability is not an optimization target; the model is overtrained (~700 tokens per parameter) and the scaling law is a fixed-2B, recipe-specific scale-down curve.

Appendix H.4: available evidence compares complete Phase 2 configurations rather than a factorial experiment over data ordering, constant-LR continuation, and checkpoint averaging, so no isolated component gain is assigned.

Section 4.3.2 / Table 6: cross-model reproduction costs are estimated via 6ND with an idealized 70% MFU H100-equivalent rate; the authors state this yields a cost lower bound for counterpart models in most cases, weakening the Pareto-frontier claim.

Section 1 artifact list: model weights (10 checkpoints), data manifests and materialized components, training code (Puro-Megatron), and data-processing code (Kaiyuan-Spark) are released under Apache 2.0, with exact averaging checkpoint IDs (222,100-222,569) and seeds specified in Appendix H.3.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pretraining methodology paper squarely in scope (LLM, training/optimization, scaling, data recipe). Novelty is moderate: FP8 blockwise training follows DeepSeek-V3, MuonH and CMA are adopted from prior work, and proxy-based data selection is established; the genuinely new parts are the trillion-token open-recipe pretraining on consumer RTX 5090s with explicit cost accounting, the Puro Cost Scaling Law framing, and the effective-LR schedule analysis of MuonH. Rigor is unusually strong for a tech report: matched scaling ladders with leave-one-out fits (Appendix D), a controlled 170M diagnostic isolating effective LR (Section 3.3.1), repeated post-training runs, and candid scope statements (Appendix H.4 admits no factorial ablation; Appendix A admits no contamination audit). Evidence is solid internally but headline cost comparisons rest on estimated 6ND/70%-MFU lower bounds for competitors (Section 4.3.2/Table 6), the $4.4K > Qwen2-1.5B margin is only 0.4 points on Avg15, and the curriculum gain may be partly contamination-driven (acknowledged). Generalizability is bounded: the scaling law is explicitly recipe-specific and fixed-2B (Appendix A), though FP8/MuonH/CMA components transfer. Reproducibility is excellent: weights, 10 checkpoints, data manifests, training and data-processing code released under Apache 2.0 with seeds and exact checkpoint IDs; minor gaps include the EULA-restricted GDR driver modification and gated data components.

primary_link.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090

papers.summary: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we pre
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型預訓練成本高昂，即使小規模模型的重現成本也常達數十萬美元以上，使學術界與開源社群難以研究完整訓練流程。本文提出一套兼顧成本、硬體可及性與開源可重現性的預訓練配方，於消費級 RTX 5090 叢集上從零訓練 Puro-2B 模型系列。核心方法包含：選擇單位價格運算效能較高的 RTX 5090，並修改驅動程式啟用 PCIe P2P 與 GPUDirect RDMA；採用 blockwise FP8 混合精度訓練，保留約 98% BF16 等效計算、輸送量提升 1.36 倍；引入以 Hyperball 約束權重矩陣半徑的 MuonH 最佳化器，使有效學習率排程得以明確控制；設計課程式資料排序，搭配固定學習率延續訓練與六個 checkpoint 的等權平均（CMA）；並以小型 proxy 模型實驗引導資料來源篩選與混合比例。兩階段合計訓練約 1.4T tokens，僅計加速器租用成本約 6.9K 美元；最佳模型在 15 項數學、程式、推理與知識基準上超越 Qwen2-1.5B 並逼近 Qwen2.5-1.5B。作者另擬合 Puro Cost Scaling Law，估計約 4.4K 美元即可達 Qwen2-1.5B 表現；後訓練案例亦顯示課程初始化在 GSM8K 與廣泛指令微調後仍維持優勢。限制包括未做全面性基準污染稽核、中文能力非最佳化目標、屬過度訓練的稠密模型，且 scaling law 僅適用於本配方之縮減情境。本工作證明可負擔的開放式預訓練今日已然切實可行。

links.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

evidence: Abstract: 'counterfactual arithmetic transfers primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories rather than hidden states, keys, reusable answer slots, or single-token triggers' - core carrier claim.
Section 5.1 / Table 19: CODI-GPT2 late layers 8-9 value target win 0.875-0.908 vs 10-11 block 0.017-0.029 and nonlate 0.000-0.008, supporting middle-to-late value localization.

Table 21 (Sec 5.1): matched corruption drops CODI-GPT2 recipient target win to 0.211 (dLP 13.655); Table 58 shows Sim-CoT-GPT2 drops only to 0.606, correctly tiered as directional rather than full necessity.

Table 43 (Sec A.6): three newly trained CODI-style seeds pass clean competence but show only 0.049-0.138 late-8-9 sufficiency and 0.026-0.089 corruption drops - an honestly reported negative replication bounding the headline mechanism to the original checkpoint.

Table 16 (Sec A.3.5): 16 carrier-threshold settings and .70/.80/.90 competence gates leave 12/12 large-N carrier calls unchanged; exact ties occur in 0.063% of 855,200 score rows - robustness of reporting rules.

Table 44 (Sec A.7): 1B augmented cells show latent-tail KV 1.000/prefix 0.000 while 8B cells invert to prefix 1.000/latent 0.000, supporting the competence-gated carrier-shift map rather than a universal claim.

Appendix B: code, configs, generators, and artifact builder public at github.com/YIDING4869/scit-emnlp-2026, but 'not local model checkpoints or large generated JSONL outputs'; Sim-CoT-GPT2 is a local reproduction (Sec 4/Table 7), limiting exact replication.

Limitations section: all cells are synthetic tasks; 'Balls, books, and coins are lexical surface variants of one two-hop arithmetic diagnostic, not a broad benchmark suite', with no exact counterfactuals available for natural GSM8K-like data.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference work: mechanistic interpretability of latent chain-of-thought in LLMs (GPT-2, LLaMA3-1B/8B, Qwen3-4B), directly matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, reasoning/CoT, and interpretability. The SCIT protocol (cache-segment, K/V-component, hidden-state, semantic-source, decoded, and matched-corruption grid for carrier discovery) is a meaningful extension beyond standard activation patching/IIA, though built from established intervention logic. Internal rigor is unusually high: tiered claims, competence gates, threshold/tie audits, and honest no-call boundaries. Evidence is strong but the full sufficiency-and-necessity closure holds for a single checkpoint, and the authors' own seed audit (Table 43) shows new CODI seeds fail to reproduce the mechanism (0.049-0.138 late-8-9 sufficiency), so the 'mechanism' is path-specific rather than a property of the training recipe. Generalizability is explicitly and severely limited to synthetic lexical variants of one two-hop arithmetic program; the 1B latent-tail vs 8B prompt-prefix split is diagnostic, not universal. Code/configs are public but checkpoints and JSONL outputs are not, requiring retraining for exact reproduction.

primary_link.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

papers.summary: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls
papers.summary_zh: 潛在思維鏈（latent chain-of-thought）模型將中間推理從輸出文字移入連續內部狀態，更緊湊卻也隱藏了因果對象：當模型不再寫出推理文字，反事實計算究竟由 Transformer 內部哪個物件承載？本文提出 SCIT（Suffix Cache Interchange Test）：先建構來源—接收者反事實算術題，於潛在推理過程中修補宣告的快取區段，並結合 K/V 元件切分、隱藏狀態對照、語意來源對照、解碼驗證與配對隨機破壞，逐一排除較簡單的解釋後才判定載體。結果顯示，在 CODI-GPT2 與 Sim-CoT 風格的 GPT-2 檢查點上，反事實算術主要透過 value-cache 字尾軌跡傳遞，而非當前隱藏向量、key 路由、可重用答案槽或單一 token：三個以上字尾位置即達 0.984–1.000 的目標勝率，CODI-GPT2 的中晚層 8–9 value 區塊具備完整的充分性與必要性證據（配對破壞使勝率降至 0.211），Sim-CoT 檢查點僅提供充分性與方向性必要性支持。跨規模校準發現載體型態會轉變：勝任的 8B 算術、實體查找、關係鏈與運算式/清單任務改走 prompt-prefix 或全快取 K/V，且提示狀態在潛在展開前即已充分；未過勝任門檻的實驗組合一律不做機制判定。限制在於任務皆為合成算術與少數可控診斷，並非廣泛基準；訓練路徑與種子敏感，新 CODI 種子無法重現晚期 value 載體；跨架構比較含混淆因子，不應視為規模定律。本研究的價值在於提供快取層級的因果診斷契約，把「潛在步驟是否重要」推進為「哪個物件承載計算」，為詮釋潛在推理模型建立更嚴謹的證據標準。
papers.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models
papers.title_zh: SCIT：測試潛在思維鏈模型中的因果快取載體

links.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers

evidence: Abstract: five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 have retained sets overlapping only 0.66-0.84 under reordering; OC-SFT flips the reader's answer on 0.125 of permutation pairs vs 0.149-0.164 for other order-targeting objectives.

Section 4: OC-SFT loss is a relevance-anchor term plus lambda-weighted order-variance penalty over N=2 shuffled views of the same window, targeting the order residual delta_B; attenuation not invariance is explicitly stated.
Section 6.3 / Table 1: OC-SFT tau-PSI 0.083 vs 0.209 single-order distillation and retained-set Jaccard 0.835 vs 0.656 at essentially equal nDCG@10 (0.459 vs 0.449).
Table 10: mitigation baselines close 63-71% of the stability gap (EMA 71.4%, order-avg T=10 62.7%, DebiasFirst 64.3%) while OC-SFT is 100%, with quality columns unmarked due to seed spread.
Table 21: OC-SFT retained-set overlap gain over single-order distillation is positive in 196 of 198 base-collection cells across 11 dense bases plus the MoE on all 18 collections.

Appendix A (Scope and limitations): admits no chain-of-thought, English-only collections, recurring ArguAna cost, GPT-5.4 tie-break sensitivity raising flip to 0.200/0.851, and that PINE-style attention restriction breaks the readout rather than being untried.

Reproducibility Statement: releases tau-PSI implementation, evaluation harness, silver labels, LoRA adapters for 11 dense-base students, and full configs; public suite runs 60-90 hours on one L40S, with Legal-A/B proprietary and GPT-5.4 rows less reproducible.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: studies order/presentation dependence in LLM scorers (rerankers, reward models, multi-doc QA scorers) and trains it down with OC-SFT, a consistency penalty over shuffled views added to distillation, evaluated on Qwen3/Gemma/Granite bases with LoRA SFT. Preference relevance is high — LLM fine-tuning, LLM-judge/reward-model reliability, retrieval reranking, and inference serving are all core LLM topics, though it is not a reasoning or agentic paper. Novelty is moderate: the consistency-regularization device and permutation averaging (BSC, RankVicuna, DebiasFirst) are prior art, and the paper honestly positions its contribution as stabilizing continuous per-candidate scores at the threshold and measuring downstream consumer decisions rather than rankings — a genuine but incremental reframing plus a simple objective. Rigor is exceptional: matched hyperparameter tuning across variants, 3-seed replication, paired bootstrap CIs, partition/marker/first-stage/score-collapse controls, 12 bases including an MoE, cost accounting (Tables 10-12), and an unusually candid limitations appendix (ArguAna cost, GPT-5.4 tie-break sensitivity, marker-renaming transfer failure, attenuation-not-invariance). Evidence strongly supports the central claim that equal nDCG does not imply equal decisions and that OC-SFT leads decision stability at one serving permutation (Table 1: Jacc 0.835 vs 0.656; answer flip 0.125 vs 0.149-0.164), with the gain holding across 196/198 base-collection cells (Table 21) and beating K=10 BSC on two of three consumers at K=1 (Figure 4). Generalizability is good across three tasks, sizes 1.7B-32B, and first stages, but bounded: English-only, no chain-of-thought scorers, transfer to marker renaming fails, and proprietary legal collections enter primary means (public-16 reported alongside). Reproducibility is strong: code, silver labels, LoRA adapters, prompts, configs, and runtime estimates released, with only GPT-5.4 rows and Legal-A/B flagged as less reproducible.
topics: LLM scorers (rerankers, reward models, LLM judges)

primary_link.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers

papers.summary: Rerankers, reward models and multi-document QA scorers score candidate documents or responses in one LLM prompt, so each score depends on their order. Such scorers are selected on ranking quality, but their scores determine a decision: what a score threshold retains, a reader answers, or a preference model selects. However, equal ranking quality does not imply equal decisions: on passage reranking, five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 retain sets that overlap by only 0.66-0.84 when reordere
papers.summary_zh: 本論文研究 LLM 評分器（重排器、reward model、多文件問答評分器）在單一 prompt 中為多個候選評分時，分數會隨候選順序改變的「呈現依賴」現象。作者指出排名品質相同不等於決策相同：五個訓練後評分器在 nDCG@10 相差 0.010 以內，門檻保留集合重疊率僅 0.66 至 0.84，連 GPT-5.4 亦僅 0.707。作者提出 τ-PSI 量化順序不穩定性，並將分數分解為順序邊際與順序殘差。實驗顯示 round-robin 分窗與 logit 校準等 prompt 層面修正無法改善決策，因此提出 OC-SFT：以教師單次標註為相關性錨點，對兩個隨機排列視圖的學生分數施加順序變異懲罰，在權重中衰減順序依賴。在 18 個段落重排集合、12 個基礎模型（Qwen3、Gemma、Granite）與多文件 QA、回應排名任務上，OC-SFT 維持排名品質，τ-PSI 由 0.209 降至 0.083，保留集合重疊升至 0.835，讀者答案翻轉率降至 0.125，優於單一順序蒸餾與需十倍教師標註的順序平均蒸餾，單一排列的穩定性更勝過現成模型平均十次排列。限制包括：懲罰達到的是衰減而非完全的不變性、無法泛化至標記改名、需要訓練監督成本，且評估皆為英文集合、未涵蓋推理導向檢索。此研究對法律檢索等高風險應用至關重要，並主張比較評分器時應一併報告下游決策指標。

links.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes

evidence: Section 3.2 / Table 1(b): CritICL-static reaches 59.2% overall on Qwen2.5-72B vs Consistency@5 59.0% — a 0.2-point margin; on 32B, 49.8 vs Consistency@7 49.5.

Appendix C.3 / Table 9: paired bootstrap tests — significant only on MATH (Δ+0.8, p=0.018) and macro average (p=0.041); AMC23 Δ−0.4 p=0.641, AIME24 p=0.812, AIME25 p=0.871 not significant; paper itself says to interpret small AIME differences cautiously.

Appendix C.1 / Table 7: source-of-gain ablation shows full CritICL-static avg 59.9 vs shuffled failure labels 57.8 and generic GPT critique 57.7, supporting that failure-mode alignment (not just extra context or GPT knowledge) drives gains.
Section 4.1 / Appendix B.1 Table 4: aggregate weak-profile consistency with strong models — Spearman 0.91 (Qwen) and 0.88 (Llama), JS distance 0.041/0.047; cross-family Spearman drops to 0.43–0.46.
Table 2: efficiency claim supported — CritICL-static 1 generation / 3768 total tokens vs Consistency@7 5440 and LLM-as-Judge 6465 tokens per MATH question.
Appendix B.3 / Table 5: annotation reliability — GPT-4o-mini vs human F1 0.82 (κ=0.74), close to human–human κ=0.80, addressing a key weakness of LLM-labeled CritBank.

Reproducibility: abstract lists github.com/umwyf/CRITICL; Appendix G.1 gives full prompt templates and Algorithms 1–3 specify retrieval; public datasets (GSM8K, MATH, AMC23, AIME24/25, GPQA), though repo contents are unverified and default T profile size is not explicitly stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, in-context learning, inference-time scaling, weak-to-strong alignment). Methodological rigor is above average: extensive ICL and test-time-scaling baselines (Tables 1, 12), selection and source-of-gain ablations (Tables 3, 7), annotation validation with humans and LLMs (Table 5), and honest bootstrap significance tests that admit most per-benchmark gains over TTS are not significant. However, headline accuracy superiority over test-time scaling is thin (59.2 vs 59.0 on Qwen-72B), novelty is a recombination of failure-mode taxonomies (didolkar2024metacognitive), W2S, and retrieval-ICL rather than a new capability, and the pipeline depends on gpt-4o-mini annotation and an unverified GitHub repo.

primary_link.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes

papers.summary: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures as undesirable outputs, CritICL leverages them as a source of guidance. Specifically, we utilize failure modes derived from weaker models and incorporate them into inference through critique-based in-context examples. We propose two variants: CritICL-dynamic, which adaptively predicts input-specific failure modes and retrieves critiques, and CritICL-static, which uses a global failure mode profile to provide stable guidance. Experimental results show that CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning and achieves performance competitive with or superior to test-time scaling methods, while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token cost. Code available at: https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 CritICL，一個推論時間的弱轉強泛化框架。問題：測試時間擴展雖能提升 LLM 的推理表現，但通常依賴重複生成或外部驗證，成本高昂。核心觀察是同一模型家族中不同規模模型共享結構化且高度一致的失敗模式分佈，如 Qwen 1.5B 與 72B 的分佈幾乎一致。方法上，先離線建構 CritBank：蒐集小型語言模型在 GSM8K 與 MATH 的錯誤回答，以 GPT-4o-mini 標註失敗模式並產生批判說明；推論時有兩種變體：CritICL-dynamic 依輸入預測可能失敗模式並檢索相關批判範例；CritICL-static 用家族層級的整體失敗輪廓提供穩定指引。實驗涵蓋 GSM8K、MATH、AMC23、AIME 與 GPQA，目標模型為 Qwen2.5-32B/72B 與 Llama-3.1-70B。CritICL 穩定優於標準 in-context learning，並以一至兩次生成媲美 self-consistency、LLM-as-a-judge，token 成本更低；消融實驗證明失敗模式導向的範例選擇優於隨機、固定或語意相似度檢索。限制：AMC23 與 AIME 的小幅改進統計上不顯著，跨家族轉移明顯較弱，CritBank 離線建構成本與分類粒度亦需權衡。其價值在於將弱模型的錯誤結構轉為可重用的離線資源，為低成本推論增強提供新典範。
papers.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes
papers.title_zh: CritICL：從小型語言模型失敗模式實現推論時間的弱轉強泛化

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong LLM interpretability paper (high-weight preferences: LLMs 2.5, interpretability 1.8, transformer 1.2, training 1.5). Novel reframing of circuit findability as trainable via iterative prune-heal-backtrack with LoRA; the C0 frozen-weight arm cleanly isolates weight updates from search. Rigor is exemplary: 32 task-model cells, 3 seeds, cluster bootstrap on the correct unit of analysis, sealed test split read once, multiple controls (no-prune heal, random/reverse ranking, off-target specificity, sibling swap, SFT-then-discover, joint gate-adapter with upper-bound framing), and an unusually honest limitations appendix. primary_link.title: Circuit Condensation: Post-Training that Concentrates a Behavior's Causal Circuit

papers.summary: One approach to mechanistic interpretability explains behavior through circuits: the components and connections that carry it. Frozen discovery often returns hundreds of edges, making them hard to inspect, compare, or verify exhaustively. We introduce Circuit Condensation, which post-trains models to concentrate behaviors into smaller causal graphs. Each round prunes low-attribution edges and trains a low-rank adapter to match the original through what remains, retaining the cut only if task per
papers.summary_zh: 本文處理機制可解釋性中電路過大的問題：固定權重下搜尋行為的因果電路，常回傳數百條邊，難以檢視與完整驗證。作者提出 Circuit Condensation，將「電路可否被找到」視為可訓練的性質。方法上，從全新 LoRA 低秩配接器與全開邊閘門出發，每輪以 EAP-IG 排序邊重要性、剪除最弱的一批，僅訓練配接器蒸餾原始模型輸出分布；控制器確認任務準確度與通用能力（困惑度比）皆存活才接受剪枝，否則回溯並縮小剪除比例。結果：四種行為、八個模型、三種子共 32 個組合中，凝縮電路有 30 個小於最強凍結基線 EAP-IG，平均縮小 8.1 倍、最高 316 倍；凍結權重對照 C0 在 29 個組合較大，證明關鍵是權重更新而非搜尋。小尺寸使窮舉驗證可行：19 個可枚舉電路中 11 個無更小忠實子集；成對消融顯示邊間有交互作用。IOI 上凝縮出 24 個注意力頭（17 個有文獻角色），優於凍結電路的 61 頭、36 個無記載；電路與原模型 KL 中位數 0.215，IOI 錨點 0.056，並能預測原模型錯誤。限制：電路描述的是改編後網路，邊數僅在交換消融慣例下有意義；Gemma 能力閘門幾乎不生效；docstring 與 agreement 缺準確度訊號，端點只是上界；聯合訓練基線在 5/32 細胞更小；三種子僅驗最佳化穩定性。此方法讓原本不可行的完整因果驗證變得可執行，且電路仍貼近原始模型行為。

Section 3.3.1 / Table 2: Agent_H achieves highest length-adjusted HealthBench Hard score 0.377 [0.353,0.400] vs GPT-5 0.334 and Professional 0.643, but requires approximately 40-80 LLM calls per query versus single-call baselines

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is LLM-agent methodology, not a pure domain application: a Gemini-based multi-agent research system with evolutionary ideation (TrueSkill/UCB ranking), evolutionary code generation, inference-time agent-architecture discovery (Agent_H, 40-80 LLM calls/query), and reliability modules against reward hacking/hallucination/plagiarism, plus a dual-use safety architecture. This aligns strongly with the highest-weight preferences (LLM agents, reasoning/test-time compute, safety, evaluation). Rigor is high: matched-topic controlled paper-generation study (50 topics x 3 conditions, 30 experts, 450 blind reviews, chi-squared tests, inter-rater kappa), held-out HealthBench evaluation with decontamination analysis, and honest negative findings (Goodhart exploitation of verbosity, autorater-clinician kappa 0.034-0.243, 8 of 9 human-rated dimensions non-significant, circularity divergence in biology). Novelty is moderate: Co-Scientist is an extension of prior published work, and components build on ADAS, Agent Laboratory, and self-driving-lab literature; the log-based hallucination clipping and joint-optimization penalties are incremental but well-motivated. Evidence is strong though partially self-validated by Google-affiliated experts with Alphabet funding, and the materials claim (Ti3C2Tx MXene) is not atomically confirmed. Generalizability is limited by instrument-specific recipes, interpolation-only biology results, unproven extension to physical-experiment verification, and compute-heavy agents; reproducibility is constrained by closed-source proprietary code (only benchmarks and colony images are public).

primary_link.title: Accelerating Scientific Research with Gemini in the Real-World

papers.summary: We present an extension and comprehensive real-world validation of Co-Scientist, a Gemini-based multi-agent system designed to accelerate end-to-end scientific research across hypothesis generation, experimentation, and manuscript generation. Moving beyond in silico hypothesis generation, this specialized configuration transitions Co-Scientist into an execution-grounded research partner advancing closed-loop scientific workflows across materials science, biology, and computer science. In materia
papers.summary_zh: 本論文將以 Gemini 為基礎的多代理系統 Co-Scientist 從純粹的模擬環境假說生成，擴充為能執行程式並落地驗證的研究夥伴，涵蓋材料科學、生物與電腦科學。系統採三階段流程：演化式搜尋搭配貝氏評分產生假說、演化式程式生成執行實驗、再合成論文，並加入幻覺與抄襲懲罰、執行紀錄核對及兩層安全審查等可靠性模組。材料科學方面，系統為 CVD 合成設計以 C2Cl6 取代劇毒前驅物的路徑，長出結構近似 Ti3C2Tx MXene 的二維層狀材料，並透過 Gemini 3 Deep Think 一次成功成長 MoS2、MoSe2 與 WS2 單層半導體；生物方面，系統自稀疏影像預測大腸桿菌群游表型，四項形態指標中三項與濕式實驗量測相符；電腦科學方面，自主發現的推論時運算縮放架構 Agent_H 在長度調整後的 HealthBench Hard 與 Professional 超越六個前沿模型，盲測醫師評估顯示潛在臨床傷害顯著下降。30 位專家對 450 篇自動生成論文的雙盲審查顯示，嚴重結果幻覺由基準系統的 90% 降至 4%，抄襲大幅減少，安全機制拒絕 98.7% 的有害指令。限制包括 MXene 原子結構尚未確認、表型預測屬內插而非外推、Agent_H 每次查詢需 40–80 次 LLM 呼叫且自動評審與臨床偏好對齊不足，程式碼亦未公開。本研究展示執行落地、人機協作的可擴展科學發現路徑。

links.title: Safety Does Not Compose: Non-Decaying Loop State for Autonomous LLM Agents

evidence: Section 4 'Reported results': 'B4 reduced overall ASR to 0.1%, compared with 88.4-97.6% for B0-B3, while retaining 96.9% CleanGC'

Section 3.1 Proposition 2: 'For any s>=2, any s-fragmented attack and any trajectory-scoped monitor M, the probability that M alarms on an attack iteration equals the probability that it alarms on a benign iteration' with proofs in Appendix B
Section 4 'Protocol': 'Each reported matrix uses one frozen cohort, one execution seed and one model-role assignment; multi-seed and multi-model replications are not included'

Appendix C Table 4: 'removing crg increased A14 ASR from 0.0% to 97.0%, revealing a dependency between xrc state retention and crg enforcement' (pre-registered off-diagonal prediction not supported)
Section 4 Table 3: XRC-decay Xi falls 0.560 to 0.392 at d=2 with ASR rising 0.0% to 97.0%, matching Proposition 3's predicted k*=2 for gamma=0.7, rho=0.8, theta=0.5

Reproducibility statement: 'Anonymized source code for the controller, all five components, both attack tracks, the metrics and the report generator is provided as supplementary material, together with the deterministic regression suite'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-preference work on autonomous LLM agent safety: trajectory-scoped guardrails provably cannot detect evidence fragmented across loop iterations (Prop. 2), decaying risk scores buy only constant cooling-off (Prop. 3), and a five-component persistent outer-state defense (LoopHarness) yields a horizon-independent bound on unauthorized commits (Thm. 5). Strongly on-topic for Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation, using LLMs in all model roles. Novelty is solid: the composition-failure framing, latching cumulant, and model-free deterministic bound are new relative to single-trajectory defenses, though the separation argument itself is elementary. Rigor is high: explicit assumptions (A1-A3), full proofs, dev/ood splits for Track A, paired clean/attack twins, matched ablations, and honest negative results (off-diagonal ablation prediction failed; red-team mitigation floor ~0.51). Evidence is convincing for the separation claim (B0-B3 at 88.4-97.6% ASR vs B4 at 0.1% with 96.9% CleanGC) and for the XRC threshold-crossing prediction, but empirically weak for compounding (B1 cASR plateaus at 6.2% from N=10 to N=20), uses one seed and one model-role assignment, and relies solely on Agent-SafetyBench simulators with a scheduled (non-contested) feed. Generalizability is limited by the single benchmark, single model stack, interface-only finance track, and undismissed gap to deployment (multi-agent extension left as future work). Reproducibility is good: anonymized code, deterministic regression suite, content-hashed episodes, temperature-zero cached calls, though concrete hyperparameters are deferred to supplementary material.

primary_link.title: Safety Does Not Compose: Non-Decaying Loop State for Autonomous LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as autonomous loops. Starting from one human goal, such a system repeatedly discovers work, plans, executes tool calls, verifies outcomes and persists state across many unattended iterations. The agent safeguards in wide use, however, are defined over a single trajectory, and their safety state is re-initialized when the next trajectory begins. We show that this is a failure of composition rather than an implementation detail. Our central res
papers.summary_zh: 本文指出,自主運作的 LLM 代理以迴圈形式持續發現工作、規劃、執行工具呼叫並保存狀態,但現有安全防護皆以單一軌跡為範圍,每輪結束即重設安全狀態,這是組合失效而非實作細節。作者證明兩項分離結果:對將攻擊證據碎片化分散於多個迭代的攻擊,任何軌跡範圍監控器無論多強,其真陽性率必等於偽陽性率;而以幾何衰減攜帶風險分數,只換來與迭代總數 N 無關的固定冷卻期,耐心攻擊者等待後即可通行。作者提出 LoopHarness,在內層防護之外維護五個永不重設的持續元件:進入與來源監控 ipm、跨迭代風險累計量 xrc(結構性旗標觸發後鎖定折扣)、記憶完整性守衛 mig、對抗穩健停止仲裁器 asa,以及複合風險治理器 crg。基於 Agent-SafetyBench 的評估顯示,完整設定 B4 將 Track B 攻擊成功率壓至 0.1%(基線為 88.4–97.6%),同時保持 96.9% 任務完成率;Track A 上 B4 在各迭代長度均維持零攻擊成功率,而逐一移除任一元件皆使對應攻擊成功率回升至 96–97.5%。理論保證給出與 N 無關的期望上界 B+m−1+m/δ_M,其確定性部分不需模型呼叫,即使驗證器與代理完全串通仍成立。限制方面:上界約束期望值而非杜絕風險,偵測下限 δ_M 是唯一經驗假設,且鎖定機制可能遭純鎖定攻擊轉化為可用性失效。此研究凸顯代理安全須從單次軌跡擴展至跨迭代持久安全狀態,對多代理系統亦具延伸意義。

links.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution

evidence: Abstract & §4.2 Table 1: WikiSkill achieves highest average across all five models; e.g., Gemini-3.5-Flash avg 68.1 vs 49.5 no-skill; improvements over strongest baseline of 3.3-12.0 points per model.
§4.2.1: gains increase with scale (Qwen family +12.3/+17.5/+23.9 for 4B/9B/27B); Qwen-3.5-9B with skills (47.4%) outperforms Qwen-3.6-27B without (39.4%).
§5.1 Table 3: ablation on Gemini-3.5-Flash shows Skill-Proposer wiki access raises average 48.7%->63.7% (+15.0); Inference-Agent wiki access during rollouts degrades 63.7%->60.9%.

§4.2.2 Table 2: cross-model transfer, e.g., Qwen-3.6-27B skills lift Gemma-4-31B LiveMath to 73.7% vs 56.7% self-evolved; negative transfer case (Qwen-3.5-4B skills drop Gemini SpreadSheet 50.5%->18.1%) analyzed in text.

Appendix C: stratified sampling up to 8 traces/iteration (5 fail, 3 pass), 15,000-char caps, paired bootstrap with 1,000 iterations; Appendix B Table 6 gives splits (e.g., SealQA 16/10/85) matching prior work.
Appendix D Table 7: optimizer API-call complexity; WikiSkill O(1) w.r.t. N_train in full-batch mode vs O(N_train) for Trace2Skill.
Appendix E: full system prompts for Inference Agent, Wiki Maintainer, and Skill Proposer provided; Algorithm 1 in Appendix A; AI disclosure notes LLMs used for writing/tables.

Limitations: no skill retrieval/triggering evaluated, strict gating excludes neutral proposals, no wiki pruning mechanism, no very long-horizon tasks; no code/data release statement anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope agentic LLM paper: skill evolution for LLM agents with tool use (ReAct proposer, bash/search/read tools), directly matching the highest-weighted preferences (Agents, LLMs, Reasoning). Novelty is moderate: the constituent mechanisms (trace analysis, pattern extraction, validation gating, rollback) are established in the skill-evolution/prompt-optimization literature; the genuinely new element is decoupling a persistent, non-rollback wiki layer with an audit trail (skill-impact.md) from gated skill updates. Rigor is solid: five benchmarks, five models, three baselines matched on splits/tools, three full evolution runs, paired bootstrap significance (Appendix C), four-configuration wiki-access ablation (Table 3, though only on Gemini-3.5-Flash), API-call complexity analysis (Appendix D), and honest negative results (Qwen-4B OfficeQA degradation, negative transfer on SpreadSheet with error analysis). Evidence is well-supported by consistent tables (e.g., avg gains 3.3-12.0 over best baseline; 9B+skills 47.4% > 27B no-skill 39.4%), though small validation sets (e.g., SealQA 10 tasks) are acknowledged and no code release is stated. Generalizability is aided by diverse domains and cross-family transfer, but bounded by modest test sizes and absence of long-horizon tasks. Reproducibility benefits from full prompts (Appendix E), algorithm, splits, and hyperparameters, but lacks an artifact-release claim and depends on closed models. Not penalized as an out-of-scope domain application.

primary_link.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution

papers.summary: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討 AI 代理技能的演進方式。現有方法（如 EvoSkill、Trace2Skill、SkillOpt）在訓練任務上執行代理、分析軌跡並迭代修正技能，但引導技能發展的洞見散落在最佳化歷史中，難以系統性重複使用。作者提出 WikiSkill，在工作區建立三層架構：Raw 層儲存不可變的執行軌跡、Wiki 層維護持續累積的結構化知識（模式頁、演化日誌、技能影響追蹤）、Skill 層存放可執行技能。每輪迭代由四個元件組成：推論代理、Wiki 維護者、技能提案者，以及依驗證分數進行把關與回滾的機制；關鍵在於技能可回滾，但 wiki 永不回滾，使後續修正能建立在累積知識上。在五個基準（數學推理、網路搜尋、試算表、長文件問答、具身任務）與五個模型上，WikiSkill 持續超越現有方法與無技能基線，且模型越大獲益越多；Qwen-3.5-9B 搭配技能可勝過無技能的 Qwen-3.6-27B。演化出的技能也能跨模型家族移轉，有時比自行演化的技能更有效。消融實驗證實持久知識累積是關鍵，且讓推論代理在訓練時存取 wiki 反而有害。限制包括未評估技能檢索、驗證門檻嚴格、缺乏 wiki 修剪機制，且未涵蓋超長程任務。此研究顯示系統性累積與精煉經驗，是打造可重複使用、可移轉技能的重要基礎。
papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.title_zh: WikiSkill：將代理經驗編譯為持久知識以促進技能演化

links.title: The Guard That Cried Wolf: How Scary Words Make Agent Guardrails Refuse Legitimate Actions

evidence: Abstract: 'we construct Cautious Bench... the first benchmark to make over-safety the construct for agent guardrails'; reports 756 Decidable benign/twin pairs (2,268 measured pairs across three name grades) and 40 Undecidable pairs.

Measurement section: seven guardrails evaluated — AgentDoG 1.5 fine-tuned on Qwen3.5-4B and Llama-3.1-8B, TS-Guard, R-Judge, ToolEmu safe-evaluator, PIGuard (out-of-scope probe), LlamaGuard (content-safety floor).

Table 1: FP rises from innocent to scary name on every execution-safety guard (AgentDoG-Qwen 63→82, TS-Guard 34→66, ToolEmu 32→45), while PIGuard and LlamaGuard stay near-flat, supporting name-attribution via the within-cell design.

Findings section: length-artifact control — 'on the 356 cells whose innocent and scary names differ by at most one character, refusal still rises... TS-Guard 32%→62%'; paired McNemar test cited for scary-vs-innocent rise.
Measurement section, refusal predicate: TS-Guard's hedged 'flagged' verdict counted as refusal; disclosed alternative scoring lowers its FP from 35% to 17% without changing rank or direction.

Limitations section: 'Each guardrail runs once per cell, so rates are point estimates and we claim the effect's direction and rank, not precise values'; guards are 'language-model-based, natural-language, English, single-principal, and synchronous'.

Ethics section: 'We release the generator, the authorization policy Π, the gate, and the recipes under an open license, and the corpus is regenerated by the released generator' — reproducibility claim without an explicit repository URL in the text.

Framework and Benchmark sections: build-time construction gate enforces four invariants (same-surface, contrast-observable, no label leakage, pre-action observability); faithfulness check backstopped by 'three security-domain human experts' as a corpus-level veto.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent guardrail evaluation benchmark touching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation simultaneously. The core contribution — policy-derived (Π-relative) labels with a build-time derivation gate, benign/twin counterfactuals, and a within-cell name-grade manipulation isolating a 'name-superstition' effect — is a genuinely novel construct for execution-safety over-refusal, distinct from content-safety over-refusal suites (XSTest/OR-Bench) and harm benchmarks (AgentHarm/AgentDojo). Rigor is above average: four construction invariants, a faithfulness check with three expert vetoes, a disclosed and sensitivity-analyzed refusal predicate, a length-confound control (≤1-char name-difference subset), and a McNemar test. Evidence is solid but not airtight: single run per cell with no confidence intervals (acknowledged), one exploratory subset analysis left unresolved (ToolEmu removal subset), and the trace analysis is admitted to be unsystematic. Generalizability is bounded by design: seven LM-based guards, English, single-principal, synchronous, with the effect possibly family-specific. Reproducibility claims are strong (generator, policy, gate, recipes released; corpus regenerable) though no concrete artifact link appears in the text. No over-claiming; limitations section is candid and well-scoped.

primary_link.title: The Guard That Cried Wolf: How Scary Words Make Agent Guardrails Refuse Legitimate Actions

papers.summary: Agent guardrails are checks that approve or refuse each action before an LLM executes it. Sometimes they refuse requests that are genuinely safe. This over-safety blocks deployment when a guardrail refuses an authorized task. Evaluating over-safety is hard: at the boundary an authorized action resembles an unauthorized one, and the safe-versus-unsafe label is a choice of authorization policy, not fixed by the action alone. We argue it therefore requires a benchmark that does not yet exist, one t
papers.summary_zh: 防護欄會在 LLM 代理執行動作前決定放行或拒絕，但常因動作「看起來危險」而拒絕其實已獲授權的行為，此現象稱為過度安全，會侵蝕信任並阻礙部署。衡量過度安全很困難：授權動作在決策邊界上與未授權動作相似，安全與否取決於授權政策而非動作本身。本文建構 Cautious Bench，首個以此為構念的基準：每個樣本與標籤共同設計自明確的授權政策 Π，涵蓋角色、範圍、同意、前置條件、來源等十條授權軸；benign 與 twin 成對反事實僅在一處授權事實上不同，標籤由建構期閘門機械地從政策推導，並經忠實性檢查把關。基準渲染 756 個可判定配對，並在無害、原樣、驚悚三種物件名稱等級下測量七種防護欄。核心發現是名稱迷信效應：所有執行安全類防護欄在驚悚名稱下的誤拒率都高於無害名稱（如 AgentDoG-Qwen 63→82、TS-Guard 34→66），顯示其判決隨表面名稱而非授權脈絡移動；刪除類動作上也有此現象，40 個不可判定樣本則另行報告。限制在於所有受測防護欄皆為語言模型式、英文、單主體且同步，且僅測量決策邊界。此工作為防護欄提供了可答辯的過度安全標籤參照，並指出防護欄應善用授權脈絡而非表面線索。
papers.title: The Guard That Cried Wolf: How Scary Words Make Agent Guardrails Refuse Legitimate Actions
papers.title_zh: 狼來了的守衛：驚悚名稱如何讓代理防護欄拒絕合法動作

links.title: Beyond Vector Hiding: Breaking and Mitigating Shared-Direction Weight Obfuscation in TEE-Offloaded Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: SpectralLeak surrogates achieve 87.98% mean accuracy versus 89.85% for victims across 12 task settings; LatticeLeak exactly reconstructs every protected fixed-point parameter in BERT-Base and GPT2-Base experiments.

Section 3 (Scope): the modular realization is 'constructed by this work and is not part of the released implementation,' instantiated in a defense-favorable manner from ArrowCloak's published modular security formulation.

Section 8.4: on the BERT anchor LatticeLeak exactly recovers all 72 protected tensors (82,944 rows, 84,934,656 coordinates) in 233.44 seconds including evaluation; reconstructed model retains 91.6284% victim accuracy.

Table 6 / Section 8.6: SpectralLeak recovers 99.606%-100% row correspondence on Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Gemma-4-E2B with 96.22-96.56% accuracy without refinement, within 0.34 points of victims; ArrowMatch correspondence is only 9.080-9.151%.
Table 13: transferred LatticeLeak against 512x ButterflyCloak recovers 0/82,944 exact victim rows; 44 of 72 tensors reject all 16 public coordinate windows.
Section 8.5: full-BERT protection preserves 91.6284% accuracy while reducing PC1 energy to 0.13049% and raw correspondence to 0.11695%.
Table 5 (RQ2): field-wide mod-Q keys reduce PC1 alignment to 2.5012% and permutation recovery to 0.0808% versus 100% under small keys, isolating the arithmetic-suppression effect.
Section 1: acknowledges concurrent preprints MOSAIC and ArrowRevelio analyzing the same ArrowCloak target, with ArrowRevelio also SVD-based against the real-valued implementation.

Appendix H: explicitly states neither attack solves LWE and ButterflyCloak provides resistance to the evaluated attacks, not cryptographic indistinguishability; implementation is a correctness-oriented prototype without measured TEE latency.

Appendix G: checkpoint revision hashes, seed 42, fixed hyperparameters, PyTorch 2.13.0/Transformers 5.15.1 versions, and machine-readable manifests with SHA-256 checksums support reproduction; Appendix A notes coordinated disclosure and artifact release preparation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-security paper on protecting LLM weights in TEE-shielded partitioning: it breaks the ArrowCloak obfuscation scheme (real-valued SpectralLeak via PCA; modular LatticeLeak via lattice reduction) and proposes ButterflyCloak, a maximal-rank keyed butterfly mask. Preference relevance is solid: the target and evaluation are LLM-specific (Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-4-E2B, GPT2-XL), and the attack/defense framing fits AI Security, but the core contribution is matrix/lattice cryptanalysis rather than language-model methodology, so it is not a top-of-scale match. Novelty is good though tempered by acknowledged concurrent work (MOSAIC, ArrowRevelio) on the same target; the modular-variant attack and the rank-root-cause defense are the more original pieces. Rigor and evidence are strong: formal threat model, rank-2/3 ablations showing adaptive PCA defeats constant-rank masks, random-direction controls (Table 2), challenger-only exact-recovery audits (82,944/82,944 BERT rows, Tables 10-11), adaptive-PCA defense diagnostics (Tables 12-13, 15), and unusually honest scoping (modular target self-constructed per Section 3 Scope; no LWE-solution claim in Appendix H). Deductions: exact recovery depends on primitive-row and fixed-point conditions, defense resistance is only against the paper's own attacks, and only operation counts (no measured TEE latency) support the efficiency claim. Reproducibility is aided by checkpoint hashes, seeds, and software versions, but artifacts are not yet publicly released.

primary_link.title: Beyond Vector Hiding: Breaking and Mitigating Shared-Direction Weight Obfuscation in TEE-Offloaded Large Language Models

papers.summary: Trusted Execution Environment (TEE)-shielded partitioning of Large Language Models (LLMs) accelerates on-device inference by offloading obfuscated linear layers to an untrusted accelerator while retaining only a small correction inside the TEE. However, earlier lightweight obfuscation schemes preserved weight-vector directions and were broken by ArrowMatch. To defend against this attack, ArrowCloak injects scalar multiples of the same hidden direction into all weight vectors, enabling lightweigh
papers.summary_zh: 為保護部署在邊緣裝置的專有模型權重，TEE 屏蔽的模型分割會將混淆後的線性層卸載至不受信任的加速器，僅在 TEE 內保留輕量輸出校正。先前輕量混淆方案保留權重向量方向而被 ArrowMatch 破解；ArrowCloak 為此對所有權重向量注入同一隱藏方向，以維持 O(nℓ) 校正成本。本文指出此共享方向重用會在整個加速器可見矩陣留下秩一關係。針對發布的實數版本，作者提出 SpectralLeak，透過主成分分析估計並移除共享成分、恢復列對應後重建權重，在 12 個任務設定中代理模型平均達 87.98%，接近受害模型的 89.85%，並擴及 Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B 與 Gemma-4-E2B。對防禦有利的模 Q 形式，提出 LatticeLeak，利用 Construction A 格與 LLL 取消共享項，再透過重疊跨度交集隔離個別列，在 BERT-Base 與 GPT2-Base 上完全重建所有定點參數，且不需查詢、標籤或微調。歸因根因為秩一重用後，作者設計 ButterflyCloak：以金鑰化的最大秩蝶形遮罩取代共享方向，任務準確率不變，卻抑制兩類攻擊，TEE 校正僅 O(nℓ log n)，漸近低於稠密遮罩。限制在於此屬系統性緩解而非密碼學證明，且實作為原型。本研究揭示矩陣層級洩漏分析對權重保護的重要性。
papers.title: Beyond Vector Hiding: Breaking and Mitigating Shared-Direction Weight Obfuscation in TEE-Offloaded Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 超越向量隱匿：突破與緩解 TEE 卸載大型語言模型的共享方向權重混淆

links.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: J-Zero verifiable overall 54.38 vs R-Zero 49.64 and G-Zero 47.41 on Qwen3-4B-Base; 58.55 vs 54.99/53.07 on Qwen3-8B-Base.
Section 4.2, Table 2: unverifiable overall 20.81 (4B) and 23.41 (8B) vs base 9.58/13.23; AlpacaEval rises 6.22 to 28.56 at 4B.
Section 5.2, Table 3: ablation shows removing Judge co-adaptation drops overall 37.59 to 34.54; removing D_amp drops to 35.95, D_role to 36.62.
Section 5.1, Figure 2: external Claude-based validation shows role-asymmetry win rate 87.9% declining to ~66%, amplification pairs below 50% for first three iterations then 70-80%.
Section 5.3, Figure 3: J-Zero improves monotonically through iteration 10 (+9.47 verifiable, +11.23 unverifiable over base) while R-Zero and G-Zero peak at iteration 2 and decline.
Appendix B, Figure 4: co-evolved Judge improves RM-Bench average 92.61 to 93.95 with Hard-pair accuracy +4.77 (85.08 to 89.85).
Appendix A.2, Table 4: full hyperparameters (Challenger/Solver/Judge steps 5/15/8, LR 1e-6/1e-6/5e-7, KL 0.01) on verl with B200/H200 GPUs; Appendix C provides all prompts.

Section 6, Limitations: restricted to base models up to 8B with an 8B discriminative judge initialized from an off-the-shelf checkpoint; generative-judge variant and post-trained models left untested.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: zero-data self-play for LLMs where a Bradley-Terry reward-model Judge co-evolves with adversarial Challenger/Solver roles via GRPO, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, alignment/RLHF, RL). Novelty is solid but incremental: the Challenger-Solver adversarial loop follows R-Zero and subtask amplification follows Christiano et al. (2018); the genuinely new mechanism is deriving judge-preference labels from structural asymmetries (role pairs, subtask-amplification pairs) rather than judge scores, avoiding circularity. Rigor is good: two model scales, 14 benchmarks, component ablations (Table 3), external LLM-judge validation of preference labels (Sec 5.1), and independent RM-Bench checks (Appendix B). Weaknesses: best-checkpoint selection uses the very benchmarks being reported, no error bars/significance tests, unverifiable-domain evaluation depends on LLM judges, and single runs per configuration. Evidence is internally consistent (tables check out arithmetically) but from single runs. Generalizability is capped by 8B base models only, one external judge initialization (Skywork-Reward-V2), and untested post-trained/reasoning models, as the authors acknowledge in Limitations. Reproducibility is strong: full hyperparameters (Table 4), all prompts (Appendix C), verl framework, named judge models, and claimed code/data releases.

primary_link.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data

papers.summary: Self-evolving language models have recently emerged as a promising path toward superintelligence, with the advantage of reducing the cost of human supervision. While considerable progress has been made in verifiable domains, self-evolution in unverifiable domains remains substantially less explored. We propose Judge co-adaptation from Zero data (J-Zero), a unified Challenger--Solver--Judge co-evolution framework that supports self-improvement across both domains. The Challenger and Solver co-evo
papers.summary_zh: 自演化語言模型在可驗證領域已有進展，但在無單一正解的不可驗證領域仍依賴固定的裁判模型，一旦求解者達到裁判的辨識上限，訓練便停滯。本文提出 J-Zero，讓挑戰者、求解者與裁判三方自零資料共同演化。挑戰者與求解者透過 GRPO 進行極小極大博弈：挑戰者以難度獎勵加上重複懲罰與格式檢查生成越來越難的任務，求解者學著在其上取得高分；任務選取採用分數離散度指標，挑出最具學習訊號的任務。裁判則以 Bradley–Terry 損失訓練，偏好對完全來自迴圈內的結構性不對稱：一是角色不對稱對（求解者的回答優於挑戰者的回答，因為後者只被訓練讓題目變難），二是子任務放大對（分而治之後重組的回答優於一次性回答），兩者標籤皆不依賴裁判自身分數。實驗以 Qwen3-4B 與 8B-Base 進行，J-Zero 在可驗證基準平均領先基線 4.2 分、不可驗證領域領先 8.0 分，並持續改善到第十輪，而 R-Zero 與 G-Zero 兩輪後即衰退。外部 LLM 評審驗證偏好標籤可靠，且裁判在 RM-Bench 上也有提升。限制為僅測試至 8B 模型、裁判為判別式獎勵模型。此工作顯示評估能力本身必須與策略一同演化，自改良才能持續。

links.title: PLCBench: Can Autonomous LLM Agents Turn PLC Access into Sustained Physical Impact?

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.1: 240 valid real-PLC episodes from 4 PLCs x 4 workloads x 5 models x 3 seeds; 75/240 (31.3%) sustain physical objectives over 118.0 aggregate PLC-hours.

Section 5.2, Table 3: GPT 5.5 reaches impact in 38/48 episodes (79.2%, CI [66.7, 91.7]) with 16/16 cell coverage but all-three-repetition success in only 9/16 cells; 95% CIs are cluster-bootstrap over PLC-workload cells.

Section 5.3, Table 4: stagewise chain 191 discover, 142 read, 141 write, 137 manipulate, 115 disrupt, 75 impact; 98 episodes stop before a valid native read, concentrated on P3 (12/60 valid reads) and P4 (12/60 discoveries).

Section 5.5.2/Finding 4: richer process observation leaves early flags unchanged but raises conditional post-write impact from 38/86 (44.2%) to 57/89 (64.0%), framed as association, not causal treatment effect.

Section 4.1: one-time deployment admission requires closed-loop sanity check, full 3600-s zero-action stability baseline, and withheld reference script satisfying the complete sustained impact predicate, preventing broken testbed cells from counting as agent failures.

Section 3.2.2/Table 7: deterministic evaluator assigns six hidden flags from independent runner, communication-audit, hidden object-binding, and 10 Hz canonical process-trace evidence, excluding agent self-report and model-facing status tools.
Appendix A: generative AI disclosure states an LLM assisted drafting/restructuring while authors verified content and measurements were not synthesized.

Appendix N/Table 21-22 and Ethics Considerations: audit map maps claims to CSV artifact records with SHA-256 prefixes, but the artifact release is 'planned'/'will be made available' and raw successful command sequences and exact write values are withheld, limiting current external reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: a benchmark evaluating tool-using LLM agents (ReAct loop, canonical system prompt, deterministic context compaction) on autonomous cyber-to-physical attack capability, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM preferences. Not a pure domain application; language-model methodology is central. Novelty is solid: the paper plausibly claims the first real-PLC hardware-in-the-loop benchmark measuring sustained physical impact from autonomous agents, with a six-flag stagewise diagnostic going beyond digital-only cyber benchmarks, though it composes existing agent-benchmark and ICS-security lines. Rigor is strong: crossed 4x4x5x3 design (240 episodes), deployment admission with zero-action stability and withheld reference feasibility checks (Section 4.1, Table 9), cluster-bootstrap CIs (Table 3), two controlled ablations (SoftPLC shared protocol; richer observation), and explicitly acknowledged confounds (one controller per protocol, observation-association not causation). Evidence is internally consistent (98 pre-read stops = 49+49; 62 manipulated-but-not-impact = 137-75; 38/86=44.2% vs 57/89=64.0%), with complete per-cell flag tables in Appendices H-J. Generalizability is limited to laboratory HIL configurations with reduced-order process models and single instances per protocol; defenses are proposed but not evaluated. Reproducibility is well-designed (deterministic evaluator, reproduced prompts, SHA-256 manifests, Appendix N audit map) but artifacts are only 'planned' for separate release and raw successful trajectories are withheld for dual-use reasons, so full third-party reproduction is not yet demonstrable.

primary_link.title: PLCBench: Can Autonomous LLM Agents Turn PLC Access into Sustained Physical Impact?

papers.summary: Industrial control systems (ICSs) rely on programmable logic controllers (PLCs) to connect networked computation with physical control. Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents represent an emerging attack threat: can an autonomous agent convert a network-reachable PLC into sustained adverse physical impact? However, existing evaluations focus on digital tasks or individual stages of PLC testing. In ICSs, evaluations that stop at software exploitation, an accepted write, or tool access may t
papers.summary_zh: 工業控制系統中，可程式邏輯控制器（PLC）連接網路運算與物理控制。使用工具的 LLM 代理構成新興攻擊威脅：能否把網路可達的 PLC 轉化為持續的負面物理影響？現有評估多止於軟體滲透或單一階段，可能誤判物理風險。本文提出 PLCBench，首個真實 PLC 的硬體在環（HIL）評測框架，結合廠商原生互動、商用 PLC 執行、閉迴路降階製程模擬與獨立結果驗證；確定性評估器依固定規則賦予六個隱藏診斷旗標，區分介面取得、製程相關操作與持續物理衝擊。框架實例化四款商用 PLC 與四種閉迴路工作負載，測試五個 LLM 家族共 240 個真實 PLC 回合，31.3%（75 回合）達成各自的物理目標。階段性分析顯示兩道障礙：98 回合在取得有效原生讀取前停止（Beckhoff 與三菱平台損失集中於此），62 回合雖完成製程相關寫入卻無法維持最終目標；更豐富的製程觀測使寫入後條件達成率由 44.2% 升至 64.0%，顯示介面摩擦與有限可觀測性並非持久的安全邊界。研究亦揭露各工作負載在保護邏輯上的防護缺口。基於雙重用途風險，作者劃定安全揭露的釋出邊界與僅軟體重現管線。此工作為網路到物理攻擊能力與防禦評估提供可重現基礎。
