links.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench

evidence: Section 1 Abstract/Contributions: MCR-Bench is 'the first defect state-aware benchmark designed for realistic multi-round code review' with 2,269 tasks across five languages and cross-round state labels
Section 3.2.4: manual cross-validation by six developers with Cohen's kappa 0.87 between two primary annotators and third-annotator arbitration for disagreements
Section 5.3 / Table 4: pre-study shows LLM-Hit-Judge (GPT-5.2-pro) attains QWK 0.73 vs BLEU-4 0.27 and ROUGE-L 0.21, justifying its adoption as primary metric
Section 6.1.1 / Table 5: best overall defect-detection F1 is 0.551 (Claude Haiku 4.5); Qwen3 Max drops to 0.153 F1 on C#, supporting the 'limited overall capability' finding
Section 6.2 / Table 10: F1 degrades with interaction depth, e.g., Claude Haiku 4.5 from 0.6495 at R2 to 0.2857 at R10, evidencing cross-round memory limits
Section 6.3 / Table 11: FP errors dominated by State-Temporal Misalignment (32.5%) and FN by Cross-round Defect Forgetting (25.1%) from open coding by four programmers
Section 9 Data Availability: 'we have released our code and the experimental data at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/MCR-bench'
Section 7.2: threats acknowledge limited model count, consistency filtering excluding difficult instances, and exclusion of proprietary enterprise repositories
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM evaluation benchmark squarely hitting high-weight preferences: Code & Programming ('code review' is the core task, Section 1), Agents & Tool Use (PR-Agent agent-based baseline, Section 5.2), LLMs (7 mainstream models evaluated), and Red Teaming & Evaluation (LLM-Hit-Judge metric pre-study, Section 5.3). Novelty is genuine but benchmark-shaped: the multi-round, defect-lifecycle-state formulation (New/Open/Resolved/Reopened) is claimed as first of its kind (Table 3 comparison), though the LLM-annotation pipeline adapts cited prior practices. Rigor is strong: kappa 0.87 with three-annotator arbitration (Section 3.2.4), 3x consistency filtering, metric pre-study via QWK (Table 4), baselines, error taxonomy via open coding (Table 11), and a threats-to-validity section; deductions for LLM-generated ground truth creating potential circularity with LLM subjects, use of GPT-5.2-pro as sole judge while GPT-5.2 is an evaluated model, consistency filtering biasing toward easier instances (acknowledged in Section 7.2), and state accuracy conditioned only on true positives (Section 6.1.3). Evidence is rich and quantitative (Tables 5-12) with some interpretive claims from informal manual sampling. Generalizability is good across five languages but restricted to public, permissive-license repos (Section 7.2). Reproducibility supported by explicit public code/data release (Section 9).

primary_link.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench

papers.summary: In real-world software development, code review typically involves iterative interactions between developers and reviewers to improve software quality, making the process costly and time-consuming. Although recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for automated code review, most approaches oversimplify code review into a single-round, static decision task, which fails to capture the multi-round interactive nature and the complex problem-solving processes inherent in realistic review sce
papers.summary_zh: 真實世界的程式碼審查通常涉及開發者與審查者的多輪迭代，缺陷會隨程式修改而演進，但現有 LLM 審查方法多簡化為單輪靜態決策。本文提出 MCR-Bench，首個缺陷狀態感知的多輪程式碼審查基準，涵蓋 Python、Java、JavaScript、TypeScript 與 C#，共 2,269 個真實審查任務，每項皆附精細缺陷卡（描述、位置、類別、嚴重度）與跨輪生命週期狀態標籤（New、Open、Resolved、Reopened）。建構流程包含嚴格的儲存庫篩選、多輪互動過濾、以 LLM 為本的兩階段狀態感知標註管線（先局部偵測、後全域追蹤）、三次獨立執行的一致性過濾，以及人工交叉驗證（Cohen's kappa 0.87）。實驗評測七個主流 LLM 與 PR-Agent、Hybrid-Review 兩基線，發現整體表現有限（最佳 F1 略高於 0.55），缺陷狀態追蹤同樣吃力，且互動輪數越多效能越降；語義複雜或低顯著度的缺陷更易漏檢。錯誤分析歸納出偽陽性主因為狀態—時間錯位（32.5%）與過度審查，偽陰性主因為跨輪缺陷遺忘、長程依賴遺漏與語義盲區。限制包括受測模型數量有限、一致性過濾可能排除特難樣本，且企業級儲存庫情境未必涵蓋。此基準凸顯跨輪記憶與狀態追蹤是未來自動審查的關鍵方向。
papers.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench
papers.title_zh: 從靜態到動態：以 MCR-Bench 評測真實世界多輪程式碼審查

links.title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance

evidence: Abstract: capabilities-framing predicts compliance with a +24 to +46 percentage-point gap over safety-framing on Qwen3-32B over FORTRESS across all tested steering conditions
Section 2 Validation: hand-grading blind to pipeline labels and condition; Stage 1-2 EA filter N=40 κ=0.80; Stage 3 cap-axis κ=0.80, safety-axis κ=0.81, 4-category κ=0.73
Section 3 Results: 10 of 11 prefills shift compliance in the predicted direction (sign-test p≈0.011); headline cap-vs-safety paired contrast 21.9pp, n_paired=52, p<0.0001
Appendix D.5 Table 9: drop-top-k robustness — headline contrast survives removal of the 21 most-influential of 52 prompts at p<0.001
Section 3 Figure 3b: OLMo-3-32B-Think replication of prefill experiment, directional trends hold including the 'generate such content' exception
Section 4 Limitations: steering-composition result is 'associational, not causal'; findings 'specific to Qwen3-32B'; single dataset limited to 55 prompts widening 95% CIs, especially HUA -0.6
Appendix D.6: subtractive design failed on Qwen3-32B — 66% of before-EA-sentence continuations regenerate same-flavor framing, 53% within the first sentence; confound transparently documented
Appendix C.2 Table (confusion matrices): LLM grader systematically under-calls the composite 'both' category, the largest residual disagreement source

Appendix A/D: full prompt-ID subsets, verbatim grader prompts, prefill list with provenance, and exact sampling seeds (73, 74) provided; Appendix E.1 references a released artifact but no explicit URL
Table 2: HUA -0.6 gap +23.6pp with wide CI [+3.6, +38.8] over 40 prompts
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/interpretability work: decomposes verbalized eval-awareness in CoT into capabilities- vs safety-flavored framings that oppositely predict compliance on harmful-request rollouts. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, interpretability, red-teaming/evaluation, reasoning/CoT). Rigor is above average: ~27k graded rollouts, blinded hand-validation (κ=0.80 EA filter; 0.80-0.81 binary cap/safety axes, Section 2/Appendix C), paired prefill design with seed matching, sign-test p≈0.011, headline 21.9pp contrast p<0.0001 surviving drop-top-21-of-52 removal (Table 9), plus an OLMo-3-32B-Think directional replication (Fig. 3b). Novelty is moderate-good: extends retrospective cap/safety classification (Needham et al.) to in-the-moment reasoning and shows suppression steering reshapes framing composition non-uniformly, but builds directly on Aranguri & Bloom and Hua et al. Evidence is solid though the headline framing-compliance gap and steering-composition result are explicitly correlational (Section 4), one steering condition has a wide CI (+23.6 [+3.6,+38.8], Table 2), and the LLM grader under-calls the 'both' category (Appendix C). Generalizability is limited: single main model (Qwen3-32B), single dataset (55 highest-EA FORTRESS adversarial prompts), acknowledged in Section 4. Reproducibility is decent (prompt IDs, full grader prompts, prefill list, seeds in Appendices A/D, 'released artifact' mentioned in Appendix E.1) but no verifiable code/data URL.

primary_link.title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance

papers.summary: Steering interventions targeting eval-awareness, a model's recognition that it is being tested, are increasingly used in safety evaluation pipelines, where evaluation-awareness is treated as a single quantity to be suppressed. We show that verbalized eval-awareness in chain-of-thought can be identified as capabilities-flavored ("the user is testing my ability to follow instructions"), safety-flavored ("the user is testing my boundaries"), both, or neither: framings that predict compliance very d
papers.summary_zh: 評測意識指模型在推論中察覺自己正被測試，會使安全評估結果高估對齊程度。近年研究以對比激活引導向量壓抑此現象，並將其視為單一待壓抑量。本文證明語言化的評測意識在思維鏈中自發分解為能力框架（「使用者在測試我遵循指令的能力」）與安全框架（「使用者在測試我的界線」）兩種變體，兩者對順從行為的預測截然不同。作者在 Qwen3-32B 上以 FORTRESS 資料集的 55 個高評測意識提示、每提示 500 次取樣進行實驗，以三階段 LLM 評分管線分類，並以人工盲評驗證（kappa 0.80）。結果顯示在所有引導條件下，能力框架的順從率比安全框架高 24 至 46 個百分點。在無評測意識的軌跡上注入 CoT 前綴的因果實驗中，11 種前綴有 10 種朝預測方向移動（符號檢定 p≈0.011），旗艦對比為 21.9 個百分點，且方向性趨勢在 OLMo-3-32B 上重現。此外，HUA 向量引導會非均勻地重塑框架組成，壓抑率變動時安全相關成分未必跟著改變。限制包括僅測試單一模型家族、單一資料集，且部分結論屬關聯性而非因果。此研究呼籲安全評估應報告框架分布，而非僅報告總體壓抑率。
papers.title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance
papers.title_zh: 並非所有評測意識皆相同：能力框架預測順從行為

links.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable

evidence: Abstract: 'larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior' - states the central scaling-recoverability claim.
Section 4.1: 'The number of targets with positive localization margin rises from 2/16 to 14/16 for animals over 1K-40K examples, and from 2/16 to 11/16 for plants over 10K-100K examples.'

Section 4.1 (Figure 2a fixed-step repeat control): 'increasing the unique-example count improves the readouts even though the total number of rows is unchanged', ruling out simple repeated-exposure explanations.
Section 4.3 (Figure 5b): LLM-judge unsafe rates rise 'from 2.0% to 33.7%' and human-judge rates 'from 3.3% to 38.0%' across the 300-prompt safety evaluation.

Appendix B.3 (Table 8): masking the first teacher-base divergence token weakens but does not remove the effect ('+1.10 at 10K to +7.10 at 60K' masked gap), showing scaling is not reducible to divergence tokens.
Appendix B.4 (Table 7): under fixed compute, carrier improvement changes only 0.984 to 1.172 while hidden-trait gap rises 2.033 to 7.409, supporting a landscape-alignment account.
Section 5.2 (Table 1): cross-model identity transfer shows all five induced identities become top-ranked, e.g. Qwen identity gap +4.42 at 20K to +7.78 at 150K.
Section 7 Limitations: 'Our experiments are controlled probes rather than full reproductions of industrial distillation pipelines', acknowledging scope limits.

Section 1 footnote 1: 'Anonymized code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/hidden-transfer-scaling'; Appendix C.2 (Table 10) gives full LoRA/optimizer hyperparameters and seeds 1-3, supporting reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core-LLM paper on how scaling model-generated distillation data amplifies recovery of latent teacher traits, squarely relevant to LLM, alignment/safety, synthetic-data, and training preferences. Builds on known subliminal-learning and emergent-misalignment results, so the core phenomenon is not new, but the scaling dimension, localization margin metric, fixed-compute landscape decomposition, dual-trait interactions, and cross-model transfer tests are genuine additions. Rigor is strong: matched no-trait reference teachers, format-only and shuffled-pairing controls, unique-vs-repeated-exposure control, divergence-token masking, DoRA/OPD/rank ablations, three seeds, pre-specified closed candidate sets, and dual LLM+human judging. Evidence is quantitative and multi-axis but confined to contrived probes (number-only carriers, animal/plant preferences); cross-model effects are weaker and noisier, and the authors concede in Section 7 that these are controlled probes without a complete mitigation, capping generalizability. Reproducibility is very good: anonymized code, full hyperparameters (Table 10), prompt inventories, candidate sets, and judge prompts in appendices.

primary_link.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable

papers.summary: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only co
papers.summary_zh: 擴增模型生成資料通常被視為改善蒸餾：樣本越多涵蓋越廣、雜訊越低、學生越強。本文揭示第二個效應：即使樣本與任務無關且從未提及目標特質，更大的資料集也會讓教師特定的隱藏訊號在學生身上更容易被偵測。受 subliminal learning 啟發，作者採用受控協定：先以系統提示或微調誘導教師表達目標特質，再讓其生成僅含數字等受限的離題資料並過濾明確線索；以相同配方訓練不同規模的學生，在獨立領域評估，並以配對的無特質對照組分離目標特定移轉。主要發現是更大的獨立資料集使誘導特質在學生後續行為中更突出：動物與植物偏好目標中，具正定位餘裕的特質數量隨規模由 2/16 增至 14/16 與 11/16；小規模時行為常落在相近吸引子（如虎誘導出獅子般的行為），規模放大後則趨向預期目標。LoRA 更新的幾何分析呈現平行趨勢；固定訓練步數的控制實驗排除了重複曝光的解釋。效應延伸到數學能力與「邪惡系統提示」的安全姿態（LLM 判定不安全率由 2.0% 升至 33.7%）、多重特質競爭與跨模型家族移轉。限制在於屬受控探針而非完整工業管線重現，且未提出完整緩解方案。此結果呼籲擴增生成資料應搭配特質感知的資料治理與部署規模的評估。
papers.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable
papers.title_zh: 擴增模型生成蒸餾資料可能使潛在教師特質更易復原

links.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: fusion paradigms average within 1.4 points but gap reaches 8.6 on a single benchmark; Merge/Mix RL trail experts by 4.9-9.2 points on IFBench
Section 5.1, Figure 3: layer-16 task-vector cosine similarity for math-science is 21.7 (4B) and 50.7 (8B) in units of 1e-3 vs at most 2.3 for pairs involving instruction following or agent
Section 5.3, Figure 5: pass@1 gains of 4.5-6.9 points over base decay monotonically and are indistinguishable from base by pass@32 on AIME 2025/26; no held-out loss on SimpleQA-Verified or AA-LCR
Table 2 and Appendix B Table 4: Mix RL costs 0.58x/0.67x of per-domain RL reference on 4B/8B; MOPD fusion stage <0.2x but end-to-end 1.14x/1.19x

Appendix E, Table 6: five full-parameter merging methods (Average, TA, TIES, DARE-TA, SCE) plus four LoRA merges compared on both backbones; lambda sweep in Fig. 7 shows thinking-mode leakage rising to ~66% at lambda=1.0
Appendix B, Table 3: verl framework, GRPO/Sampled-Token OPD hyperparameters, LoRA rank 32 / alpha 64, 32 NVIDIA H20 GPUs
Appendix D: Qwen3-32B LLM-judge protocol with full grader prompts for held-out SimpleQA-Verified and AA-LCR evaluations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology: a controlled comparison of three RLVR capability-consolidation paradigms (task-vector merging, mixed-domain GRPO, multi-teacher on-policy distillation) across Qwen3-4B/8B with shared experts and data. Strong preference fit (LLMs, RL/RLHF-adjacent, reasoning domains, agents/tool use, efficiency/cost analysis). Rigor is high: two scales, full-parameter and LoRA expert sets, merging-method and scaling-coefficient ablations including a thinking-mode-leakage confound check (Appendix E, Fig. 7), GPU-hour cost accounting, and held-out capability tests. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent, though statistical testing is thin (small AIME sets at mean@16), pass@k coverage analysis is math-only, and the corpus mixing ratio is fixed rather than swept despite the finding that proportions matter. Novelty is moderate: the unified three-way comparison and task-vector-geometry/transfer correlation are new, but all three paradigms and the reweighting-vs-expansion observation build on known methods and prior findings (explicitly credited to Yue et al. 2025 and Wang et al. 2026). Generalizability is limited to one model family and five chosen domains; reproducibility is good (verl, public datasets/benchmarks, full hyperparameters, claimed GitHub/HF releases) with placeholder links the only gap.

primary_link.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves specific capabilities of large language models, but covering multiple capabilities often involves training separate domain experts and subsequently consolidating them. We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to
papers.summary_zh: 可驗證獎勵強化學習(RLVR)能提升大型語言模型在特定領域的能力,但涵蓋多領域通常需訓練多個領域專家再加以整合。本文依重複使用的產物將融合範式分為三類:Merge 合併專家任務向量、Mix RL 混合各領域資料集、MOPD(多教師同策略蒸餾)兩者兼用。作者在 Qwen3-4B 與 8B 骨幹上訓練數學、科學、程式編寫、指令遵循與代理工具使用五個領域專家,以相同實驗框架系統比較。結果顯示平均效能差異不超過 1.4 分,但單一基準差距可達 8.6 分;領域層級表現與任務向量幾何揭示的跨領域關係一致——數學、科學與程式互相增益,指令遵循與代理使用近乎正交。訓練動態也揭露各自限制:Mix RL 依賴領域資料比例、MOPD 受教師上限束縛、Merge 將五個專家更新壓縮為單一更新。三種方法均只提升單樣本準確率,於 pass@32 時與基礎模型已無明顯差異,顯示融合是重新加權既有解題路徑而非擴大可解範圍,且未損及保留能力。實務指引:專家已存在且重視低成本用 Merge;無專家時用 Mix RL 但需調整領域比例;重視保留各領域增益則用 MOPD。限制在於僅測試特定骨幹與基準組合。

links.title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay

evidence: Abstract: calibration increases committed-answer accuracy by up to 41 pp across all six model-dataset pairs, but overall accuracy improves up to 15 pp on HotpotQA and falls up to 17 pp on MuSiQue
Table 1: Mistral MuSiQue Calibrated-Gated CA 45.5 vs Raw-Gated 15.9 with coverage dropping 99.7 to 7.3 and OA falling 15.9 to 3.3 at cost 0.26 to 2.92
Table 2 (RQ3): held-out ECE improves through depths 1-2 but calibrated ECE exceeds raw at depth 3 for all three models (e.g., Mistral 23.0 vs 15.4)
Section 4.1: isotonic map fit only on labeled depth-zero calibration records, pooled across datasets, frozen before final-test replay

Section 5 RQ5 / Table 3: 17.7% helpful vs 3.6% harmful retrieval transitions (net +14.1 pp), but the paper argues this aggregate effect does not establish confidence as a value-of-information estimate

Section 7 Limitations: benchmark-grounded evidence paths rather than a live retriever, LLM judge (gemini-2.5-flash-lite) used without human-validation study, zero cost assigned to abstention/escalation

Appendix A.4 and Table 5: open-weight checkpoints (mistralai/mistral-small-2603, openai/gpt-oss-120b, qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507), deterministic 2:1 calibration-test splits (3,702/1,852 HotpotQA; 1,208/605 MuSiQue), full system and judge prompts in Appendices A.1/A.3, but no code release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an evaluation methodology for confidence-gated retrieval in LLM agents, intersecting high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, RAG, evaluation/calibration) without falling into any excluded category. The matched trajectory replay protocol is a genuinely useful controlled-attribution design, and the empirical findings are reported honestly (calibration improves committed-answer accuracy up to 41pp but can collapse coverage and reduce overall accuracy up to 17pp on MuSiQue; the frozen depth-0 map fails at retrieval depth 3). Rigor is above average: held-out calibration splits, frozen maps, a-priori thresholds, multiple baselines (parametric-only, Fixed RAG@k, adaptive proxy), budget sweeps, and explicit caveats that results reflect operating-point shifts rather than improved ranking. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent (Tables 1-3, transition-count arithmetic 7,371-4=7,367). Main weaknesses: novelty is incremental (isotonic calibration and adaptive retrieval are established; the contribution is the evaluation protocol and depth-wise transfer analysis), scope is narrow (two multi-hop QA datasets, three models, one deterministic evidence-plan construction rather than a live retriever), correctness relies on an unvalidated LLM judge, and no code release is stated despite detailed prompts/checkpoints in the appendix.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay

papers.summary: Interactive language-model agents use confidence signals to decide whether to answer immediately, retrieve additional evidence (from memory or external knowledge), or defer. Yet confidence is usually evaluated in isolation, without measuring the trajectory-level consequences of the actions it triggers. We propose matched trajectory replay, a controlled protocol for comparing confidence-to-action mappings. The protocol holds candidate answer states, evidence points, budgets, and action costs fixe
papers.summary_zh: 互動式語言模型代理常依信心訊號決定立即回答、檢索更多證據或延後處理,但信心校準通常被單獨評估,未衡量其觸發動作在軌跡層級的後果。本文提出匹配軌跡重播控制協定:固定候選答案狀態、證據點、預算與動作成本,僅改變提供給控制器的信心分數,以隔離信心到動作映射的效果。作者在 HotpotQA 與 MuSiQue 多跳問答上,以 Mistral、GPT-OSS-120B 與 Qwen3-235B 比較原始口語化信心與事後等張校準。結果顯示在相同數值承諾門檻下,校準改變了代理最終承諾回答的題目集合:六組模型—資料集配對中,已承諾答案準確率最多提升 41 個百分點,但覆蓋率下降、檢索使用增加;整體準確率在 HotpotQA 最多升 15 個百分點,在 MuSiQue 卻最多降 17 個百分點,反映控制器移往更選擇性的低風險操作點,而非答案品質或信心排序的改善。此外,於檢索前擬合的校準映射在深度一、二仍能改善保留集校準,但三個模型在深度三都劣於原始信心。平均而言額外證據有幫助,卻不代表信心能辨識哪些個別事件將受益於另一次檢索。作者結論:校準可使承諾風險可解讀,但無法估計下次檢索的預期效益,檢索需獨立的資訊價值或效用估計。限制包括使用基準固定的證據路徑而非即時檢索器,且僅涵蓋兩個資料集與三個模型。
papers.title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay
papers.title_zh: 以匹配軌跡重播評估信心閘控檢索

links.title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?

evidence: Abstract: 'expert-annotated benchmark of 1,482 task-conditioned chart-generation instances' with Extract–Reason–Visualize pipeline and GitHub release link.

Table 1: DeepChart uniquely combines ~220K-token/218-page real-document contexts, retrieval+reasoning requirements, and 'Stage-by-stage' evaluation vs. prior benchmarks capped at <128K with endpoint scoring.
Section 5.2: '(2) Visual faithfulness does not guarantee data faithfulness' — Ecosystem average VAS 0.447 vs F1_src 0.149 and F1_der 0.276; Academic F1_src 0.691 vs F1_der 0.236.
Section 5.3 / Table 4: Finance-Ultra-Long (50-instance subset) drops average VAS from 0.421 (Normal) to 0.269, F1_src 0.385→0.167, supporting 'larger context windows alone are insufficient'.

Appendix B.2: F1 matching uses 'relative error is no larger than 1e-4' with one-to-one matching that 'intentionally ignores JSON keys and nesting structure'; VAS judged by qwen3-vl-flash with temperature 0.
Appendix B.4: judge ablation across 6 pairs (accuracy 0.773–0.898, κ 0.415–0.755) and human alignment on 2,339 items (94.1% accuracy, κ=0.852, chart-level Pearson 0.939).

Appendix B.1: 'we set reasoning_effort to low' and truncate context prefix to 80% of context window — a potential capability confound; detailed execution parameters (timeouts, 120 DPI, chunk caps) are documented.
Limitations: value-level F1 'should be interpreted as approximate indicators of numerical faithfulness rather than full semantic equivalence'; expert verification prioritizes quality over scale.
Section 3.3: three-role QC (primary annotator, independent verifier, senior reviewer) with unverifiable instances discarded; no annotator-agreement statistics reported for construction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric evaluation benchmark squarely within scope: it probes frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Claude 4.5 Opus, Gemini 3, DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3, Kimi-K2) on long-context evidence extraction (avg 220.6K tokens, max 1.2M), multi-hop quantitative reasoning, and executable chart-code generation, with a multimodal VLM protocol. The Extract-Reason-Visualize formulation with stage-by-stage intermediate references is a genuine advance over endpoint-only chart benchmarks (Table 1), and the 'hidden hallucination' framing is well motivated. Rigor is above average: expert QC roles (Sec 3.3), implementation details for value-level F1 (App B.2), a judge-model ablation and human-alignment validation for VAS (App B.4, κ=0.852, Pearson 0.939), and a documented representativeness check for the 50-instance Ultra-Long subset (App B.3). Key weaknesses: value-level matching ignores key/structure alignment, so semantically misassigned numbers can score well; reasoning_effort is set to 'low' (App B.1), a confound for a reasoning-heavy benchmark; results are single-run zero-shot with no variance estimates; rubric generation by Gemini 3 Pro is not itself human-validated. Claims are supported by concrete cross-model numbers (e.g., Ecosystem ER 0.782 vs VAS 0.447; Ultra-Long VAS 0.421→0.269), and prompts, parameters, and a GitHub release support reproduction, though proprietary-API dependence limits exactness.

primary_link.title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?

papers.summary: Faithful chart generation in real-world data-science workflows requires grounding visualizations in scattered evidence, computing chart-ready quantities, and rendering them accurately. Modern LLMs can produce visually plausible, instruction-compliant charts, yet data-level hallucinations remain difficult to detect in long, noisy, and multimodal contexts. To measure this gap, we introduce DEEPCHART, an expert-annotated benchmark of 1,482 task-conditioned chart-generation instances drawn from real
papers.summary_zh: 在真實資料科學工作流程中,忠實的圖表生成需從分散的證據擷取資料、計算圖表所需量,再準確繪製。現代大型語言模型雖能產出視覺可信的圖表,資料層級的幻覺卻難以在冗長嘈雜的多模態環境中偵測。本文提出 DeepChart,一個專家標註基準,含 1,482 個源自真實科學論文、財務申報與生態系報告的任務導向圖表生成實例,並將圖表生成形式化為 Extract–Reason–Visualize(ERV)管線,分階段評估來源資料擷取、衍生資料推理與圖表渲染,指標包括 F1_src、F1_der、視覺準確度分數 VAS 與執行率。對 GPT-5.2、Claude 4.5 Opus、Gemini 3 系列及多個開源模型的零樣本實驗顯示三大發現:可執行程式不保證視覺忠實(Ecosystem 平均執行率 0.782 但 VAS 僅 0.447);視覺可信不保證資料忠實,隱藏幻覺普遍存在;擷取良好不保證推理正確(Academic 的 F1_src 高但 F1_der 顯著偏低)。Finance-Ultra-Long 壓力測試中 VAS 自 0.421 降至 0.269,顯示僅靠加大上下文視窗不足,仍需可靠的證據定位與量化推理。限制包括領域範圍有限、值層級匹配僅為數值忠實性的近似指標,且為品質而犧牲規模。此基準凸顯證據定位與量化推理對忠實視覺化的重要性,並公開相關資源。
papers.title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?
papers.title_zh: DeepChart:大型語言模型距離忠實的資料科學圖表生成還有多遠?

links.title: Unsaid, Unsafe? Implicit Security Obligations in LLM-Based RTL Code Generation

evidence: §III-C1: vanilla prompts (L0) yield functional pass 73.4-79.4% but security pass only 14.5-35.4% across five LLMs; L2 CWE knowledge raises mean security from 23.3% to 59.4%.
§III-A5: average line coverage 95.84% over 98 designs; every case independently reviewed by three engineers with at least three years industry experience.
§V-A3: RTL-Obliger mean all-pass 61.6% vs 49.6% (SecV) and 51.4% (RESCUE); all-pass gains significant per model, paired Wilcoxon p_A <= 8.5e-3, Cohen's d 3.37/1.91 on Overall (Table VI).
§V-B1/V-B3: component ablations run only on DeepSeek-v4-Pro with a single run each; w/o Symbolic drops Avg all-pass 57.8%->49.7%, w/o Judge 55.6%, w/o Two-stage 54.8%.
§V-C2: of 3,765 failures, 73.2% fail at obligation-guided generation and 21.2% at symbolic matching; LLM-as-Judge (5.4%) and FSG extraction (0.2%) are minor.
§VI-A: coding-agent comparison (MAGE/Sec-MAGE) uses one run on DeepSeek-v4-Pro; RTL-Obliger Avg all-pass 58.7% vs 7.9%/24.2% at 3.6x-8.7x lower token cost.
§VI-B: threats to validity acknowledge single-run agent study, re-implemented baselines, and scope limits to resource-access, port-observable weaknesses.
Footnote 1 (§I): datasets and source code publicly available at github.com/NTDXYG/SecRTL-Gen; §III-B3 names Icarus Verilog, GHDL, and Amaranth simulators.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-methodology paper: LLM-based code generation (weight-2.0 Code), security evaluation of generated artifacts (weight-2.0 AI Safety), prompting-strategy study L0/L1/L2 (Prompting), LLM-as-Judge filtering and a coding-agent comparison (Agents/Evaluation). Not a pure domain application; the neuro-symbolic obligation-inference method and multi-HDL benchmark are general contributions. Novelty is solid but incremental in parts: LLM graph extraction, ontology matching, LLM-as-Judge filtering, and two-stage generate-then-revise are individually standard, combined here in a new hardware-security setting beyond SecV/RESCUE-style retrieval. Rigor is strong: 392 instances from real SoC IP, 3-reviewer manual QA with 95.84% line coverage (§III-A5), 5 models x 5 runs with mean±std, paired Wilcoxon tests and Cohen's d (Table VI), failure taxonomy over 3,765 failures (§V-C). Weaknesses: ablations are single-run on one representative model (§V-B1), agent comparison single-run (§VI-A), and both secure-generation baselines are author re-implementations without original artifacts (§V-A2). Evidence is internally consistent (verified: averaged all-pass 49.6/51.4/61.6 and F/S means in Tables III/V match the claimed aggregates) and claims are carefully hedged (T_sec as operational approximation, §II-B). Generalizability is explicitly bounded to resource-access, port-observable CWE families; authors discuss threats (§VI-B). Reproducibility aided by a public GitHub link for data/code, named simulators, and API settings, though full prompts/ontology live outside the text.

primary_link.title: Unsaid, Unsafe? Implicit Security Obligations in LLM-Based RTL Code Generation

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate register-transfer-level (RTL) code with rapidly improving functional correctness. Security of LLM-generated code, however, has been studied mainly for software, where flaws can still be patched after deployment. Insecure RTL offers no such remedy once taped out into silicon. We construct SECRTL-GEN, a multi-language resource-access security benchmark grounded in real SoC IP: 392 tasks over five CWE families and four HDLs (Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, and Py
papers.summary_zh: 軟體漏洞可在部署後修補,但 RTL 設計在 tape-out 後便固化於矽晶片中無法修改,使 LLM 生成的硬體程式碼安全問題更為關鍵。本文建構 SecRTL-Gen,一個基於真實 SoC IP 的多語言資源存取安全基準:98 個設計乘以四種 HDL(Verilog、SystemVerilog、VHDL、Python)共 392 個任務,涵蓋五個 CWE 家族,每個任務附黑箱功能與安全測試平台;功能規格刻意省略安全義務,呼應實務中安全要求常與功能文件分離的現象(OpenTitan 的 283 條反制措施全記錄於設定檔而非功能描述)。對五個前沿模型的實證研究顯示尖銳落差:vanilla 提示下功能通過率約 73–79%,安全通過率僅 14–35%,且功能強的模型未必更安全。提供 CWE 知識可將平均安全率提升至約 59%,單靠自我思考幫助較少,而兩種安全導向提示都會降低功能通過率,顯示瓶頸在於規格缺少弱點意識而非無法撰寫防禦性 RTL。作者進而提出 RTL-Obliger 神經符號框架:LLM 從規格萃取功能語意圖,符號引擎比對 CWE 模式本體找出緩解證據缺口並產生訊號層級義務,再以兩階段生成修訂 RTL。跨五模型四語言,平均 all-pass 從 49.6–51.4%(SecV/RESCUE)提升至 61.6%;失敗分析顯示 73.2% 的失敗發生於義務引導生成,21.2% 因符號匹配漏掉正確 CWE。限制為僅涵蓋資源存取類弱點與黑箱可觀察性質。
papers.title: Unsaid, Unsafe? Implicit Security Obligations in LLM-Based RTL Code Generation
papers.title_zh: 未言明即不安全?LLM 型 RTL 程式碼生成中的隱含安全義務

links.title: Sycophancy Suppression Can Impair Rational Updating: Anti-Sycophancy Should Preserve the Ability to Update

Section 5.4 / Appendix C Table 9: cosine between yielding and updating steering directions is positive in all 16 backbone x dataset entries (+0.40 to +0.84)
Appendix C Table 8: MLP-neuron overlap 38-90% at k=50 and 26-80% at k=5000 versus a random baseline below 0.03% at k=50, supporting shared substrate
Section 6.2 / Table 3 and Appendix D Table 11: orthogonalized steering raises selective settings from 5 to 10 of 36 on TruthfulQA only, described as modest and backbone-dependent
Limitations: only four open-weight instruction-tuned models, golden evidence by design, steering restricted to TruthfulQA due to logit-based scoring

Section 3.2: models are Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, gemma-3-4b-it; Appendix B.1 gives DPO beta (0.1/0.3), LoRA rank 16, lr 5e-5, and per-backbone preference pair counts (e.g., Llama-3.1 Joint 1,211 pairs)
Title page footnote 1: code and data released at https://github.com/dependentsign/sycophancy-rational-updating
llm_evaluation.rationale: A pure LLM-alignment/safety/interpretability paper squarely within stated preferences: evaluates four open-weight LLM backbones, DPO/SFT/LoRA interventions, sycophancy (AI safety/alignment), and mechanistic analysis (attribution patching, attention heads, steering directions). Novelty is solid: the Unsupported-Yielding vs Rational-Updating distinction and the demonstration of a behavioral trade-off under suppression-style interventions, plus mechanistic entanglement evidence, go beyond prior sycophancy-suppression work, though adjacent work on causal separation of sycophantic behaviors and correction selectivity is already cited, tempering originality. Rigor is good: calibration/test splits, explicit success/failure/trade-off accounting rules, cross-patch validation against two random controls, and ablation across DPO, SFT-on-chosen, and steering; weaknesses include greedy decoding with no variance estimates for the main tables, small preference sets (hundreds of pairs), and LLM-generated evidence for some analyses. Evidence strength is substantial (extensive quantitative tables across 4 models x 4 datasets), but headline 'trade-off' claims rest partly on counts across heterogeneous settings and single runs. Generalizability is moderate: only small open-weight models, golden evidence by design, steering tested only on TruthfulQA. Reproducibility is strong: public code/data link, detailed hyperparameters, prompts, and full sweeps in appendices.
topics: mechanistic interpretability (attribution patching, attention heads, steering vectors)

primary_link.title: Sycophancy Suppression Can Impair Rational Updating: Anti-Sycophancy Should Preserve the Ability to Update

papers.summary: Large language models often exhibit sycophancy, revising their answers to align with users when users push back. Such answer flips, however, can arise from different causes. One possibility is that the model simply aligns with the user's feedback in order to satisfy them. Another is that the feedback genuinely contains useful evidence, prompting the model to update its answer in a rational way. We distinguish them as Unsupported-Yielding and Rational-Updating. Prior work focuses primarily on sup
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常出現諂媚行為,在使用者反駁時修改答案,但答案翻轉的原因不同:可能為迎合使用者而放棄正確答案,也可能因回饋確實含有有用證據而理性修正。本文將兩者區分為 Unsupported-Yielding(無支撐的屈服)與 Rational-Updating(理性更新),設計兩輪評估框架分別衡量:第一輪模型獨立作答,第二輪接收無新資訊的使用者施壓或含證據的參考訊息,資料涵蓋 TruthfulQA、PopQA、EX-FEVER 與 AQuA,模型包含 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen3-8B 與 Gemma-3-4B。橫跨 DPO、SFT 與激活引導等訓練期與推論期干預,結果顯示反諂媚方法常遭遇權衡:降低 Unsupported-Yielding 常犧牲 Rational-Updating,反之亦然,即使聯合最佳化兩個目標也難以避免。機制分析顯示兩種行為共享內部基礎:驅動它們的 MLP 神經元與注意力頭大幅重疊(k=50 時跨資料集重疊率 38–90%),引導方向的餘弦相似度為正(約 +0.4 至 +0.84),解釋了權衡的成因。正交化引導的初步探索在 TruthfulQA 上帶來有限且依賴骨幹的選擇性增益。作者主張反諂媚不應視為單純的壓制問題,而是選擇性問題:有效干預應在減少無支撐屈服的同時保留理性更新。限制包括僅評估四個開放權重模型、機制分析粒度有限,且證據為人工控制的理想情境。
papers.title: Sycophancy Suppression Can Impair Rational Updating: Anti-Sycophancy Should Preserve the Ability to Update
papers.title_zh: 壓制諂媚可能損害理性更新:反諂媚應保留更新能力

evidence: Abstract: 'MoRe outperforms single-agent baselines by 2.2% on average, and achieves performance on par with MAS while reducing token cost by 20×' — but §4.2 reports only 'outperforms the best single-agent baselines ActAdd, by 0.96 and 0.97 on Llama and Qwen'.
§4 Table 1: MoRe AvgAcc 69.32 (Llama, rank 1) vs AgentVerse 69.28; on Qwen3-8B MoRe AvgAcc 71.48 (rank 2) below AgentVerse 72.40, showing MAS still wins on one backbone.

§3.4 GRPO Post-Training: 'we shift the RL action space from the token space to the persona space' with policy over unordered Top-K subsets (Eq. 5) and frozen backbone as black-box environment — the key methodological novelty.
§4.5.1 Ablation Study: four variants (base, +router, +codebook, MoRe) show both modules contribute; 'steering the last prompt token is optimal' (Prmt-Last, Figure 6b).

Limitations section: 'requires access to the internal hidden states of the backbone LLM and is therefore not directly applicable to black-box API models'; learned candidate vectors remain latent, limiting interpretability.

Appendix G.1-G.2: trainable parameters only 0.04M codebook + 1.32M router (0.017% of backbone); defaults α=0.2, N=10, K=3, λ_lb=0.1; 8×A100 40GB; package versions listed in G.4, though no code repository URL is given.
Appendix B.2: reward design with stepped multi-choice rewards, SBERT-similarity soft rewards for TriviaQA/GSM8K/MATH, addressing group-variance collapse.
Appendix D (Potential Risks): acknowledges LLM-as-judge (Claude) bias in personality evaluation and possible out-of-distribution behavioral changes from steering.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to stated preferences: an LLM method spanning agents/multi-agent systems, reasoning benchmarks, activation steering, MoE-style routing, and GRPO post-training. The core idea—query-aware composition of a learnable steering-vector codebook in activation space, with GRPO whose action space is unordered Top-K role subsets rather than tokens—is a genuine and well-motivated twist on static steering (CAA/ActAdd/IRIS) and expensive multi-agent debate. Rigor is solid: two backbones, 12 baselines, module and steering-position ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, per-role analyses, and honest limitations. Weaknesses: the abstract's '2.2% average' gain is against the mean of single-agent baselines, while the margin over the best baseline (ActAdd) is only ~0.96-0.97 points (Table 1) and AgentVerse still wins on Qwen3-8B (72.40 vs 71.48); accuracy tables lack seeds/confidence intervals; personality scoring relies on LLM-as-judge (Claude) with acknowledged bias risk; steering requires white-box hidden-state access, limiting deployment generality; and no code release URL is provided despite reproducibility claims. Detailed hyperparameters, reward design, role prompts, and hardware specs support reproduction but fall short of verified artifact availability.

primary_link.title: One Model, Many Minds: Unlocking Multi-Agent Synergy in a Single Agent via Mixture of Roles

papers.summary: Specializing Large Language Models (LLMs) toward distinct abilities underpins successes ranging from personalized assistants to multi-agent systems (MAS). Single-agent paradigms rely on pre-defined personas or steering vectors to induce specialization, yet they impose a single fixed specialization that fails to adapt to diverse queries. Conversely, MAS achieves dynamic multi-perspective problem solving by orchestrating agents with distinct text-based roles, but fusing these specializations requi
papers.summary_zh: 單代理範式依賴預定義人格或引導向量誘導特化,但固定特化無法適應多樣查詢;多代理系統(MAS)雖能動態整合多視角,卻需多輪互動而推高上下文長度與推論成本。本文提出 Mixture of Roles(MoRe),在單輪推論中自適應組合多種特化:學習一組可微分的引導向量 codebook,每個條目編碼一個潛在角色;查詢感知的路由器以多頭交叉注意力對候選打分,以 Top-K 稀疏路由動態融合成單一引導向量,注入凍結骨幹 LLM 中間層的殘差流。訓練採三階段課程式 SFT(先 codebook、再路由器、最後聯合),再以 GRPO 後訓練路由器;由於策略定義於角色子集空間而 LLM 視為凍結環境,獎勵可完全歸因於路由器,信用分配明確且無需追蹤 LLM 梯度。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 與 Qwen3-8B 上,於 MMLU、TriviaQA、MATH、GSM8K、MedQA 五個推理基準與 PersonalityBench 人格評估,MoRe 平均超越最佳單代理基準 2.2%,達到與 MAS 相當的表現同時減少約 20 倍 token 成本。消融顯示 codebook 與路由器皆有貢獻,學到的候選向量自然分化,路由權重隨任務類型呈有意義偏好。限制包括需存取模型內部隱藏狀態而不適用於黑箱 API、學到的向量可解釋性有限,以及引導向量在生成過程中固定於查詢層級。
papers.title: One Model, Many Minds: Unlocking Multi-Agent Synergy in a Single Agent via Mixture of Roles

evidence: Abstract: 'HarnessLens improves average held-out performance by 7.6–13.6% while consuming substantially less evaluation budget' and code link https://github.com/jhxu5214/HarnessLens
§5.1: 'All LLM agent and evolution roles use deepseek-v4-flash-preview' — evaluation restricted to one model family
§5.2 Table 1: HarnessLens best or tied-best pass@1 in 8 of 12 harness–benchmark pairs; e.g., OpenCode average 47.53 vs H0 41.83
§6.1 Table 2: ablation of Fixed/Random/RHO-based batch selection and Metric-Only Gate vs full method (e.g., Banking 25.37 vs 20.90/37.50 for gate variants)

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper on budget-aware harness evolution, squarely matching top-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code). The behavior-aware task selection plus attributable-evidence gate is a genuine, though incremental, refinement of propose-and-verify loops over fixed/random verification sets. Rigor is solid: formal budget-constrained formulation, held-out blind TEST splits, ablations of both selection and gating, explicit budget accounting, and decision-level re-scoring. Main weaknesses: single model family, one run per setting with no variance estimates or significance testing, pass@1 on small TEST sets (40-72 tasks) so several gains are 1-2 tasks, and apples-to-oranges budget comparison against baselines (acknowledged but only partially mitigated). Quantitative claims (7.6-13.6% relative averages) are consistent with Table 1. Reproducibility is aided by detailed protocols, seeds, version pins, and a code link, but depends on a preview model and an anonymized supplement.

primary_link.title: Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification

papers.summary: Agent harnesses shape how language-model agents use instructions, tools, and runtime components, but adapting these harnesses requires costly verification. Existing propose-and-verify methods typically score every candidate on a fixed task set, wasting rollouts on unrelated behaviors and allowing aggregate scores to obscure specific regressions. We introduce HarnessLens, a budget-aware framework for automated harness evolution. HarnessLens jointly explores the task space and user-configurable co
papers.summary_zh: Agent harness 決定語言模型代理如何使用指令、工具與執行時元件,但其適應需仰賴昂貴的驗證。現有 propose-and-verify 方法通常在固定任務集上為每個候選評分,不僅浪費 rollout 於不相關行為,聚合分數還會掩蓋特定退化。本文提出 HarnessLens,一個預算感知的自動 harness 演化框架,包含三階段:Context Exploration 描繪任務空間與可使用者設定的元件;Trajectory Diagnosis 從執行軌跡萃取可重用經驗與反覆缺陷;Harness Evolution 產生候選修改,並以行為感知驗證——依支持軌跡、任務模式、受影響元件與回歸風險選擇驗證任務,再以可歸因證據閘門決定接受或拒絕。在 OpenCode、Codex CLI 與 Pi 三個 harness 上,於 τ²-bench Retail、τ³-bench Banking Knowledge、Terminal-Bench 2.0 與 BIRD Mini-Dev 四個基準,HarnessLens 以最小預算(200 個互動單位,僅為 HarnessFix 的三分之二、Self-Harness 的二十四分之一)在十二個 harness—基準配對中的八個取得最佳或並列最佳,平均保留集通過率提升 7.6–13.6%,且從未低於初始 harness。消融顯示行為感知批次選擇與可歸因證據閘門缺一不可,固定批次、隨機批次或僅依聚合指標的變體表現明顯較差;分析也指出高任務多樣性使廣泛有效的修改更難辨識。限制包括僅涵蓋一個模型家族、三個 harness 與四個基準,且預算不計入 token 用量與延遲成本。

Section 5.2, Figure 6: Procrustes patching yields 66–85% directional success vs 76–98% within-model ceiling, shuffled ~50%, unprojected below chance, n=870, Wilson 95% CIs
Appendix G, Table 10: fixed j=2 relation sweep, Procrustes exceeds shuffled on all 7 relations but exceeds within-lang on two small-n relations (invention→inventor 69.6 vs 55.4), noted with wide CIs
Figure 6 caption: patch start layer j∈{1..8} selected per target to maximise within and Procrustes separation — an unaddressed selection degree of freedom
Appendix E, Table 8: GlotLID-v3 audit bounds English contamination at ≤0.1% for the nine main-analysis corpora

Limitations section: ≤1B parameter cap, low-resource languages covered only correlationally, patching restricted to seven relations and first-subword scoring, parallel-data assumption untested against unsupervised mapping
Footnote 1: code and data released at github.com/Ej-zhou/monolingual-alignment; Appendix G specifies seeds, lr, batch size, and per-language cloze templates
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-representations/interpretability study squarely within the LLM (w2.5) and interpretability (w1.8) preferences, with secondary hits on transformer architecture, pre-training, and scaling-by-data; no coverage of the other top-weight clusters (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM). Research quality is strong: a correlation→construction→causation design with shuffled, identity, unprojected, and Gaussian controls, bootstrap/Wilson CIs, a GlotLID contamination audit, and an honest limitations section. Novelty is a meaningful but not radical extension of Conneau et al. (2020b) to decoder-only LMs, adding causal cross-model activation patching with a rotation fit on parallel sentences; the orthogonal-vs-flexible-map dissociation echoes older word-embedding findings. Evidence is quantitative and multi-dataset but the causal probe is narrow (country→capital across 5 targets, 7 relations eng–deu, first-subword scoring) and Figure 6's per-target patch-start layer selection is an uncorrected researcher degree of freedom. Generalizability is bounded by ≤1B scale, Indo-European skew, correlational-only low-resource coverage, and the parallel-data assumption. Reproducibility is high: public code/data link, public checkpoints, seeds, and hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Cross-Lingual Alignment Without Joint Training: Do Monolingual Language Models Converge on Universal Representations?

papers.summary: Cross-lingual alignment in multilingual language models is typically attributed to joint training: shared parameters, mixed-language batches, or explicit alignment objectives. We ask whether monolingual models trained on non-parallel data learn alignable representations without joint training. By testing on strictly monolingual language models, such as the Goldfish model families and independently developed models from different research labs, we find three results. Correlation: these models dev
papers.summary_zh: 多語言語言模型中的跨語言對齊通常歸因於聯合訓練,本文探問在非平行資料上獨立訓練的單語言模型是否也能學到可對齊的表示。以 Goldfish 等嚴格單語言的因果語言模型,以及五個來自不同研究團隊、約 1B 參數的獨立模型(含 Minerva、Zh-Pythia、Tucano、Bielik)為對象,作者以相關性、建構性與因果性三層遞進的證據回答。相關性:在 FLORES-200、Tatoeba、OPUS 與 BouQUET 四個平行語料上,匹配句對的最後一層 CKA 遠高於打亂控制(平均 0.76 對 0.18),對齊隨訓練資料規模、模型規模與語言親近度增強,低資源語言亦成立。建構性:於平行句上擬合的單一 Procrustes 正交旋轉即可映射兩模型的隱藏狀態,P@1 檢索達 88.7%,且在角度幾何與檢索上優於更彈性的 Affine 與 MLP 映射;映射於第 6–8 層達峰。因果性:將旋轉後的英文殘差注入德文模型的事實完形填空任務,可讓預測翻轉為英文模型的答案,方向性成功率達 66–85%(同模型上限 76–98%),未投影與高斯隨機控制則在或低於 50% 機率線,同一旋轉並可零樣本轉移至七種事實關係。結果顯示跨語言對齊可從語言結構及其承載的資訊中湧現,無需聯合訓練,指向模型拼接、合併與模組化多語言系統等方向。限制包括偏向高資源印歐語系、訓練語料殘餘外語污染、需平行句擬合旋轉,以及因果評估僅涵蓋單一概念位置的事實關係。

links.title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers

evidence: Abstract: 'we study recursive Transformers, reusing a shared block across depth to scale compute, together with factorized embeddings... they outperform standard Transformers at 10M and 100M words, while remaining competitive with BabyLM Challenge 2025 winners.'

Table 1 (Section 5): 10M RecursiveGPT+FE (27.6M params, R=16) averages 45.80 vs 45.07 for the best standard model; at 100M, RecursiveGPT+FE averages 61.92 vs 63.47 for the 1.22B standard model, with RecursiveGPT-Large at 63.93.

Section 5: 'the compact 124.0M-parameter RecursiveGPT + FE model... trails it on COMPS, LAMBADA, and average score'; RecursiveGPT-Large 'uses substantially higher compute' (Appendix D Table 4: 4.42e19 vs 7.96e18 FLOPs).

Appendix F Table 6: FLOP-matched standard training for 146 epochs (10M words) degrades average from 45.07 to 41.47, and 50 epochs at 100M words degrades 63.47 to 56.68, supporting recursion over extra passes.
Section 5.2 Table 3: removing factorized embeddings drops average from 46.16 to 44.90; ablations are 'with seed 0' only; depth conditioning ablation shows small effect.

Section 3.2 / Figures 2-3: downstream performance is non-monotonic in parameters while training loss keeps falling, 'consistent with overfitting rather than optimization failure'; Appendix A shows the same qualitative picture on ClimbMix.
Limitations: 'did not retune hyperparameters separately for every combination of corpus, data budget, model size, and recurrent depth.'

Reproducibility: Section 1 states 'We openly release the training pipeline' (github.com/serdardoesml/recursive-lm); Appendix B specifies Muon/Adam optimizer settings, 32768-token batch, seeds 0-2, FlashAttention-2, and A100 hardware; Appendix D reports FLOPs and A100-time.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LM pre-training methodology paper squarely relevant to the LLM, Transformer Architecture, and Scaling preferences: it studies data-constrained pre-training (10M-100M words) and proposes RecursiveGPT (depth-recurrent weight sharing + ALBERT-style factorized embeddings) to decouple compute from parameters. Rigor is solid: two corpora, multi-seed main tables, depth/FE sweeps, ablations, epoch-based FLOP matching (Appendix F), and explicit compute accounting (Table 4). However, novelty is incremental since Universal Transformer recurrence and factorized embeddings are well-established, and the headline claim is over-extended: at 100M words the compact recursive model (1.34e19 FLOPs) trails the 1.22B standard model on average (61.92 vs 63.47, Table 1), and only RecursiveGPT-Large wins while using ~5.5x the standard model's compute; no significance tests are reported and ablations use one seed. Claims are otherwise honestly hedged (Section 5, Limitations). Reproducibility is strong with a released pipeline and detailed Appendix B hyperparameters. Generalizability is limited to very small scale and English.

primary_link.title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers

papers.summary: Pre-training under limited data requires a different view of scaling than web-scale language modeling. With a fixed data budget but relatively abundant compute, increasing parameter count helps only up to an optimal scale; beyond that point, models overfit and generalization worsens. We study this behavior across 10M-100M word pre-training budgets, two corpora, and multiple downstream evaluations, and find that optimal size depends strongly on both the data budget and the downstream target. We a
papers.summary_zh: 在資料受限（1000萬至1億詞）但算力相對充裕的預訓練情境下，標準 Transformer 的參數量並非越大越好：超過最適規模後模型會過擬合，且最適大小同時取決於資料預算與下游評測目標。作者指出標準架構在此情境縮小時表現不佳：固定詞彙表使嵌入層與 LM head 佔據大量參數預算，且每個 token 的運算量與表示容量互相綁定。為解耦兩者，論文提出 RecursiveGPT，以遞迴方式在深度上重複使用共享 Transformer 區塊，增加運算量而不等比增加參數，並搭配分解式嵌入減少詞彙映射參數。實驗橫跨兩個語料庫與 BLiMP、LAMBADA、COMPS 等評測，顯示遞迴模型在 1000 萬與 1 億詞預算下皆優於標準 Transformer，並與 BabyLM Challenge 2025 得獎系統具競爭力。循環深度增至 R=16 後效益遞減；若把相同算力改用於更多 epoch 重複訓練，表現反而因過擬合下滑。限制包括超參數調校有限、僅探索固定深度單區塊設計。此研究主張資料受限預訓練應視為獨立的擴展情境，遞迴權重共享提供了與參數量解耦的算力擴展軸。
papers.title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers
papers.title_zh: 以遞迴 Transformer 從有限資料中榨取更多效能

links.title: SPT: Skills as Pre-Training Data for Agentic Language Models

evidence: Main Results: 'Relative to direct SFT, SPT improves the four-benchmark agentic score by 9.11–24.96, while the six-benchmark general score changes by only −0.85 to +0.51' across all six backbone/SFT settings in Table 1
Experimental Setup: 'All reported results are means over five random seeds'; budget-matched conditions per Appendix A Table 5 (Dolmino, AgentBank, SkillCorpus each 347,770,880 training tokens)
SkillCorpus Construction: 'The final corpus contains 38,040 packages and 218,277 files (5.74 per package)' with decontamination against API-Bank, MetaTool, APTBench, ToolEyes, and OLMES

Appendix D: Reference Insert reduces mean reference distance from 14,518.996 to 737.189 tokens (94.92% reduction); serialization ablation shows Reference Insert 22.06 agentic vs 20.19 DeepSeek-Coder packing (Table 2)
SPT under Reinforcement Learning Post-Training: after identical Tulu 3 SFT + GRPO on SmolLM2-360M, SkillCorpus four-benchmark score 11.94 vs 7.25 Dolmino and 4.95 none (Table 3)
Limitations and Ethical Considerations: 'SkillCorpus is drawn from a single public repository' and 'Larger models, other compute regimes, and alternative corpus compositions remain untested'

Rigor gap: no standard deviations or significance tests reported despite five-seed averaging; ToolEyes judge swapped to DeepSeek-V4-Flash with '97.2% agreement' audited on only 300 samples (Appendix B)
Appendix F: artifact release is a future commitment—'We will publicly release the complete corpus-construction... code; all training and evaluation configurations; and all... checkpoints'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to core LLM-agent and training-data preferences: the paper proposes mid-training LLMs on human-written multi-file skill packages (SkillCorpus, 38,040 packages) to improve tool use, directly matching LLM, agent/tool-use, training-optimization, and dataset-curation topics. The core idea—treating skill packages as pre-training data rather than inference-time context, with a reference-aware serialization (Reference Insert)—is a fresh angle relative to trajectory/function-call corpora, though adjacent to continual pre-training work like MaskSearch and Hephaestus. Rigor is above average: budget-matched corpus comparisons (Table 5 exact token accounting), three backbones (1.6B/3B/7B), two SFT recipes, a Dolmino general-data control, an AgentBank trajectory control, mixture-ratio sweeps over two general corpora, a five-way serialization ablation, benchmark decontamination with 13-gram diagnostics (Table 8), and an SFT-then-GRPO robustness test; five seeds are averaged. Evidence is internally consistent (verified Table 1/12 averages match stated margins, e.g., 9.11–24.96 agentic gains with only −0.85 to +0.51 general drift), but no variance or significance testing is reported despite seed averaging, some gains (Reference Insert +1.87 over DeepSeek-Coder packing) may be within seed noise, and ToolEyes relies on a swapped model judge with only a 300-sample human audit. Generalizability is limited by a single corpus source (ClawHub), ≤7B models, only 348M-token mid-training, and self-acknowledged untested larger scales (Limitations section). Reproducibility is supported by exhaustive hyperparameter tables (Tables 9–11, 16–17), evaluation protocols in Appendix B, and reference-distance measurements, but artifact release is only promised, not verified.

primary_link.title: SPT: Skills as Pre-Training Data for Agentic Language Models

papers.summary: Agentic (tool-using) language models are mainly trained on tool-call traces and agent trajectories during post-training. These data provide direct behavioral supervision, but producing them requires task environments, execution, and verification, making broad tool and task coverage expensive. Publicly available skills offer another source of training data: they encode reusable tool semantics and workflows but are typically used only as inference-time context. We introduce Skill Pre-Training (SPT
papers.summary_zh: 具備工具使用能力的代理型語言模型通常在後訓練階段以工具呼叫紀錄與代理軌跡學習行為，但產生這些資料需要任務環境、執行與驗證，覆蓋面越大成本越高。本文改以人類撰寫的公開技能包作為預訓練資料來源，提出 Skill Pre-Training（SPT）：在 mid-training 階段對由 38,040 個清洗與去污染後的 ClawHub 套件組成的 SkillCorpus 施行因果語言建模，並提出 Reference Insert 組裝策略，將被引用的輔助檔案插入主說明檔首次提及處附近，以在單一因果序列中保留跨檔案關係。實驗涵蓋 1.6B、3B、7B 三種骨幹模型與多種後訓練配方，顯示 SPT 在 API-Bank、MetaTool、APTBench、ToolEyes 等代理評測上持續優於一般資料或軌跡資料的 mid-training，同時大致維持一般能力；混入約 30% 技能資料效果最佳，且優勢在 SFT 後接 GRPO 強化學習時依然存在；Reference Insert 亦優於其他多檔案組裝方式。限制包括語料僅來自單一儲存庫、領域與語言涵蓋受該社群偏重影響。此工作證明技能包是訓練代理模型的寶貴資料源。

links.title: A Single Suffix to Break Them All: Basin-Aware Jailbreaks for Merged Model Families

evidence: Section 6.2, Table 1: BAJ achieves TSR 61.3-89.1 across six backbones versus best baselines (e.g., SCAV 76.8 on DeepSeek-7B), with no-attack baseline at 0.0
Section 6.5, Figure 1: cross-backbone transfer shows high within-backbone (diagonal) and weaker cross-backbone (off-diagonal) success, supporting backbone-dependent vulnerability
Appendix F, Table 12: under matched surrogate access and compute budget, best baselines reach only 34.0-61.7 vs BAJ 65.8-77.6, isolating the min-max coefficient optimization as the source of gains
Appendix E, Table 10: replacing maximization-based merge parameter search with random sampling drops TSR (e.g., Llama2-7B 65.8 to 32.4), validating the min-max design
Section 6.4, Table 3: perplexity-filter row (65.8/68.2/77.6) is identical to the no-defense row, unexplained and suggesting an ineffective defense configuration
Appendix K, Table 14: adaptive refusal fine-tuning reduces TSR to 18.4/15.6/20.7, but reported Intent-FT values (47.4/42.4) conflict with Table 3 (57.9/67.5), an internal inconsistency
Appendix H.2: human evaluation of 50 sampled successful jailbreaks yields 68% Coherent, 0% Incoherent, Cohen's kappa 0.81, supporting judge reliability
Appendix I: authors state they do not release harmful prompts or model outputs; no code or artifact release is claimed anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/security work: jailbreak transferability across merged model families, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, red teaming/evaluation, alignment). The basin-aware min-max formulation over merging coefficients and the family-level threat model (attack succeeds even when all constituents are individually aligned) are a genuine, well-motivated contribution beyond prior 'unsafe constituent' accounts, though the attack machinery (AutoDAN-style mutation search, representation-guided objectives) is inherited. Rigor is strong in breadth: six backbones, ten task splits, six merging methods, deployment settings, six defenses plus an adaptive defense, matched-surrogate/matched-budget baselines (Appendix F), and component ablations. Evidence is weakened by internal inconsistencies (Intent-FT TSR 57.9/67.5 in Table 3 vs. 47.4/42.4 in Table 14), a perplexity defense row identical to the no-defense baseline with no explanation, no confidence intervals, and a judge (Llama-2-13B-chat) validated only on 50 samples. Generalizability is limited by exclusively self-fine-tuned task models on five tasks rather than real community merged checkpoints, despite the Hugging Face motivation. Reproducibility is mediocre: hyperparameters are detailed, but no code release is stated and Appendix I explicitly withholds prompts/outputs. No out-of-scope disqualifiers apply.

primary_link.title: A Single Suffix to Break Them All: Basin-Aware Jailbreaks for Merged Model Families

papers.summary: Model merging enables combining multiple fine-tuned models without additional training, but its safety implications remain poorly understood. Prior work primarily attributes merging risks to unsafe constituent models, implicitly assuming that merging individually aligned models preserves safety. In contrast, we show that model merging reveals a previously overlooked jailbreak risk rooted in the pretrained foundation model, even when all constituent models are individually safety-aligned. Motivat
papers.summary_zh: 模型合併可免訓練地將多個 fine-tuned 模型合而為一，但其安全影響仍未被充分理解。過往研究多將風險歸因於不安全的組成模型，本文則證明：即使所有組成模型皆已個別完成安全對齊，合併仍可能暴露源自共享預訓練骨幹的越獄脆弱方向。作者提出 Basin-Aware Jailbreak（BAJ），將越獄提示生成形式化為合併空間上的 min–max 最佳化：內層在合併係數空間搜尋最抗拒攻擊的合併模型，外層最佳化對抗後綴使其在最壞情況下仍有效，並以線性探測方向引導突變式離散搜尋。實驗涵蓋 Llama-2、Llama-3、DeepSeek、Qwen、Gemma 等骨幹，BAJ 的家族層級轉移成功率達 61.3–89.1%，遠超 GCG、AutoDAN 等基線；跨 Linear、Task Arithmetic、TIES、DELLA 等合併方法，以及浮水印與 NF4/INT8/FP16 精度設定皆維持高成功率；困惑度過濾、ICD、Safety-Aware Merging 等既有防禦效果有限，而跨骨幹轉移明顯較弱，證實漏洞與預訓練骨幹相關。以拒絕資料微調的自適應防禦可大幅壓低成功率，但針對合併情境的安全合併方法仍待發展。
papers.title: A Single Suffix to Break Them All: Basin-Aware Jailbreaks for Merged Model Families
papers.title_zh: 一個後綴攻破全部：針對合併模型家族的盆地感知越獄攻擊

links.title: Daydreaming: Stealing Hidden Agent Skills through Black-Box Task Interaction

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 7 skills and 4 victim models, Daydreaming recovers 86.8% of original skill's capability at Output, outperforming SigLeak by almost 4x'
Section 1: 'Across seven skills and three victim models, Daydreaming recovers 35.8-86.8% of the behavioral-utility gap' — inconsistent victim count vs abstract
Table 4: kimi-k3 reconstruction reaches SR/U .543/.806 with NSR/NU .727/.868; the 86.8% headline equals the best single victim's NU
Section 6.1: held-out dataset B has 5 tasks; Table 4 SR values (.143, .286, .571, .714, .857) are multiples of 1/7, indicating 7 trials per task
Table 5: structural recovery F1 ranges .018 (exact constants) to .200 (file paths/scripts), 'useful behavior does not require an exact copy to work'

Table 10 vs Table 4: matched-defense run D0 gives SR/U .286/.395 for claude-opus-5 vs .400/.764 in main results; authors caution 'rows should not be compared with a reconstruction from a different run'
Section 7: 'Only D2 lowers U, from .395 to .367... D1, D3, and D4 instead yield higher U than D0' — disclosure defenses largely fail against the work path
Table 15 footnote: 'The input detector rejected 251/252 scheduled BBS target attempts before victim-model execution'
Appendix B: Proposition 4.1 (exact source unidentifiable) with proof; B.3 single-threshold adaptivity gap; B.4 Fano finite-budget bound

Appendix C/D + Table 12: full pseudocode, complete static prompt templates, and default parameters provided; Open Science section promises release of benchmark, harness, pipeline, prompts, and configurations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: an execution-only attack that steals multi-file LLM agent skills sits squarely in Agents & Tool Use (SkaaS threat model, shadow agents, orchestration policies), AI Safety (theft/vulnerability/defense analysis), and Red Teaming/Evaluation, with clear LLM methodology. Novelty is solid: the three-level observability formalization (Differential/Trace/Output), a working attack at the strictest Output level, and supporting theory (unidentifiability, adaptivity gap, Fano bound) go beyond prior disclosure-based stealing (BBS, SigLeak). Rigor is mixed: careful held-out design, component ablations (Fig. 5), budget sweep (Table 6), defense study (Sec. 7), and honest reporting of low structural recovery (F1 .018-.200) and of a baseline (Fixed Probes) beating SR on two victims; but the held-out set is only 5 tasks (SR values are multiples of 1/7), the headline 86.8% is the best single victim (kimi-k3 NU=.868 in Table 4) with the intro reporting a 35.8-86.8% range, abstract/intro disagree on victim count (4 vs 3), and the matched-defense D0 run (.286/.395 in Table 10) diverges sharply from the main result (.400/.764 in Table 4), indicating large run-to-run variance. The BBS comparison is largely vacuous since 251/252 attempts were blocked by the input detector. Evidence is concrete and traceable across many tables but built on a very small evaluation suite. Generalizability is supported by multi-victim, multi-policy transfer experiments yet results vary widely by skill/victim (some negative NSR). Reproducibility: complete pseudocode, all prompt templates, and parameter tables are included, and Open Science promises full release, but the code link is a placeholder and artifacts are withheld during review.

primary_link.title: Daydreaming: Stealing Hidden Agent Skills through Black-Box Task Interaction

papers.summary: Agent skills bundle instructions, reference data, and executable helpers that let a general agent perform specialized tasks. Hosted providers can keep these files secret while selling access to task results, making the skill itself a valuable target. Existing disclosure defenses can block requests that ask for the skill or reproduce its text, but they cannot block customers from submitting the ordinary tasks the service is built to complete. We present Daydreaming, an execution-only attack that
papers.summary_zh: 供應商可將代理技能（指令文件、參考資料與可執行輔助腳本）視為機密資產，以代管服務出售執行結果，此即 Skill-as-a-Service。現有防禦能擋下要求揭露技能或重現其文字的請求，卻無法阻止客戶提交服務本應完成的正常任務。本文提出 Daydreaming，一種僅靠執行的攻擊：攻擊者從不直接索取技能或請求評分，而是設計「判別任務」，使不同行為假設預測出可區分的結果，並以攻擊者自控的影子代理（無技能的一般代理與候選計畫代理）輔助比對，再依受害者回饋逐步淘汰替代方案。論文形式化三層巢狀可觀測性：Differential、Trace 與 Output，並聚焦最受限的 Output 層級；方法分為行為屬性推斷、候選技能計畫比較與逐檔案細化三階段。在 7 個技能與多個受害者模型上，Daydreaming 於 Output 層級恢復原技能約 86.8% 的行為效用，較 SigLeak 高近 4 倍，每技能中位數僅需 32 次呼叫，且在多種揭露防禦啟用下依然有效；結構層面的精確常數還原仍有限。結果顯示隱藏檔案與過濾直接揭露不足以阻止功能性重建，保護正常執行所洩漏的行為資訊仍是未解難題。

Sec. 3.3 / Fig. 2: causal validation over a 2^3 design space shows the query-token choice (output vs input tokens) is the dominant design axis; Appendix G, Table A9 extends this to k∈{5,10,20,50}.
Sec. 5.1 / Table 3: VRHs detected only on RefCOCO degrade seven VQA benchmarks, e.g., Spatial457 for Qwen3-VL-8B 78.2→36.9 (-41.3), supporting cross-task generalization.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Mechanistic interpretability of vision-language models built on LLM backbones (Qwen2.5/Qwen3/Llama-3/Gemma-2/DeepSeekMoE/InternLM2.5/GLM/Phi), so it sits squarely in the LLM + interpretability + multimodal preferences rather than pure computer vision. Extends text retrieval-head analysis to visual retrieval from general images with a unified head-scoring design space and causal masking validation; the cross-task generalization and cross-backbone-head-sharing findings are genuinely new, though the work is a natural modality transfer of the retrieval-head framework and the core causal-sparse-universal triad replicates known text results. Experiments are broad and well controlled: 11 VLMs, 5 grounding and 7 VQA benchmarks, random-head controls, disjoint detection/eval splits with a contamination check (Table A10), k-sweeps, and per-dataset breakdowns; the causal evidence (e.g., 86.2→7.5 on RefCOCO vs random 86.1) is strong. Deductions: attention-based scoring is acknowledged as limited to routing rather than computation (Sec. 6), only single-image 7–8B models are tested, no activation patching, and no explicit code release is stated despite full head-index lists (Appendix D).

Inspired by retrieval heads in large language models, we ask whether VLMs contain an analogous mechanism for visual retrieval. papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型中的檢索頭已被證實是長上下文擷取的關鍵機制，本文追問：視覺語言模型是否也有對應機制來完成視覺檢索，即定位文字描述所指的影像區域並將視覺證據路由至輸出？作者提出視覺檢索頭的概念，證明僅佔約1.7%至2.6%的少量注意力頭，即是負責這項行為的因果核心。方法上，論文將既有的頭部評分方法統整為涵蓋查詢token選擇、鍵聚合與跨樣本聚合三個維度的設計空間，並發現以輸出預測階段token對真實參照區域之注意力總和評分，最能可靠找出具因果性的頭。實驗涵蓋11個視覺語言模型與5個指代表述基準：僅遮罩前20個視覺檢索頭，可使定位準確度最多下降80個百分點，遮罩同數量隨機頭則幾乎無影響。研究進一步揭示四大特性：由邊界框預測發現的頭可泛化至屬性、空間、計數與視覺數學等任務；具功能專一性，破壞定位但保留輸出格式；在共用相同LLM骨幹的不同視覺語言模型間可因果轉移；且僅需5至10個樣本即可穩定偵測。限制在於注意力訊號主要反映證據路由的去向，尚未觸及讀取了什麼內容，且實驗限於單一影像設定。此工作為視覺語言模型的可解釋性研究奠基，也指向視覺情境選擇與KV快取壓縮等應用。

evidence: Section 'Experiments and Results' (RQ4): BCIT beats Flat-Additive in all six paired runs with mean gain 2.63 points, 95% CI [2.10, 3.16], exact sign-flip p=.03125, and exceeds Validate-All by 1.50 [0.85, 2.14] and Additive+Veto by 0.90 [0.27, 1.52].
Table 1 (Audit-24): BCIT authorizes 2 of 8 harmful and 9 of 10 beneficial candidates vs 5 and 8 for Flat-Additive; exact McNemar test p=.25, described as directional cohort evidence.

Appendix F (RQ3, Table 12-13): short/full target-direction agreement 20/24 (83.3%, Spearman ρ=.72); Pass yields 80.0% precision and recall at median 17% of full-training cost, with four sign reversals disclosed.
Table 9 (RQ1): 13 of 24 candidates do not improve their target; standard SQL SFT gains +2.250 pp target but loses 22.736/18.705 IFEval-P/I points, motivating the conditional-transfer problem.
Section 'Limitations': evidence covers one 4B model, three target capabilities, one retention benchmark, and human-specified boundaries; component ablations are descriptive.
Appendix C (Table 7): full training defaults (LlamaFactory, bfloat16, LR 6e-6, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, four GPUs) are given, but the document contains no code or artifact release statement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology paper (Qwen3-4B, SFT/GRPO, autonomous agent-driven update authorization) squarely within LLM/agents/training preferences, not a domain application. The problem framing—candidate-level, source-context-bound authorization of experience reuse before weight-changing training—is a genuinely distinct contribution relative to transferability estimators (LEEP/LogME), case-based agent memory, and AutoML pipeline search, though the mechanism itself (product score, hard veto, bounded validation) is transparently hand-designed rather than learned. Rigor is unusually strong: outcome-blind Audit-24, frozen thresholds, protocol amendment prespecifying Validate-All and Additive+Veto before outcome opening, six paired seeds with exact sign-flip tests, component ablations, and a disclosed null pilot. Evidence is consistent but modest in scope: endpoint gains hold across all six pairs (2.63 pp, CI [2.10,3.16], p=.03125), yet the RQ2 audit result is only directional (McNemar p=.25), the AUC gap to Additive+Veto includes zero, and everything rests on one 4B model, three capabilities, and one retention benchmark—limits the authors state explicitly. Detailed hyperparameters, seed-level ledgers, and deterministic evaluation support reproducibility, but no code/data release is stated.

papers.summary_zh: 自主式後訓練系統會不斷累積過往更新的成效證據，但一項更新是否有益取決於當時的父模型、資料與訓練階段；若把過去的成功視為無條件的許可，可能浪費運算資源，甚至使後續訓練軌跡退化。本文將此問題形式化為條件式經驗轉移，並提出BCIT方法：在動用全量訓練前，先將每筆更新記錄與其來源情境綁定，以證據強度乘以當前情境相容度得到正向分數，並對具名的硬衝突行使否決；低於閾值即拒絕、證據未決者進行預算受限的當前父模型短期驗證、符合凍結規則者才授權全量訓練，所有訓練完成的候選仍須面對共用的採納或回滾規則。實驗以一個Qwen3-4B模型依序適應金融推理、文字轉SQL與函式呼叫，並以IFEval作為保留約束。回溯診斷顯示24個配對候選中13個未改善目標，效果高度異質；盲測稽核中BCIT僅授權25%的有害候選，同時保留90%的有益候選；36小時GPU時數的等預算比較下，BCIT平均得分47.0，優於全部對照方法。限制包括僅涵蓋單一4B模型、三項能力與人為指定的邊界條件。此研究確立經驗授權應作為自主後訓練中獨立審視的決策問題。

links.title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City

evidence: Section 4.1: 'The study contains 810 manually verified base instances distributed across Hong Kong'; every instance was completed by human testers under the same 100-step limit used for MLLM agents.

Section 4.1: evaluated models include GPT-5.5/5.4/5.2, Claude-Opus-5/4.6, Gemini-3.6-Flash/3.1-Pro, Doubao-Seed-2.0-Pro, GLM-5V-Turbo, Kimi-K3; agent protocol is first-person RGB + task text + history with one structured action per turn.

Table 2 (Section 4.3): long-navigation success ranges 0.0-3.8% across models versus short-navigation up to 75.0% (GPT-5.5, Claude-Opus-4.6), supporting the composition-failure claim; Figure 7 adds distance-bin stratification.
Table 4 (Section 4.4): road-closure SPR 10.0-46.7% with PNA ~93-96.4% and pedestrian-collision rate 76.3-90.0%, evidencing the gap between locally compliant movement and safe goal-directed control.
Appendix D, Table 7: oracle checkpoint rescoring for GPT-5.5 LongNav raises 'closer than start' from 57.5% to 98.7% but success stays 0.0%, isolating endpoint regression from arrival failure.

Appendix B: task prompts, ReAct JSON protocol, and full action-space schemas are reproduced verbatim; the runner 'accepted only the actions listed below and rejected every other command', and no route computation, waypoint, or distance readout was exposed to models.

Section 3.2: built from Hong Kong Lands Department 3D Visualisation Map (Cesium 3D Tiles, WGS84) and 3D Pedestrian Network, streamed into Unity with collision geometry; Section 3.3 adds time-of-day, weather, and Rocketbox pedestrians.

Section 1 and Section 2: 'first sandbox... physically constrained replica of Hong Kong built from territory-wide 3D geospatial data', differentiated from game sandboxes (MineDojo, BALROG), indoor benchmarks (OpenEQA), and simulators (MetaUrban, UrbanWorld, Virtual Community); novelty claim is argued but not externally validated.

Appendix E: LongNav failure-type taxonomy (stopped outside radius, no progress, lost progress, progress at timeout) is computed on GPT-5.5 only, and Figure 8 error bars (95% CI) are shown only for the progress analyses; per-episode run counts and decoding parameters are not reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic-LLM evaluation paper: closed-loop benchmark probing MLLM agents (GPT-5.x, Claude-Opus, Gemini, Doubao, GLM-5V, Kimi) with a map tool, ReAct-style structured-output actions, and spatial planning in a georegistered Hong Kong replica. Strong preference fit (agents/tool use, LLMs, reasoning, multimodal). Novelty is real but incremental: the 'first real-scale georegistered interactive city' claim is differentiated against game sandboxes, indoor embodied benchmarks, and simulators like MetaUrban/UrbanWorld/Virtual Community (Section 2), yet the Unity+benchmark+agent-eval recipe is well established. Rigor is solid: 810 human-verified instances (Section 4.1), feasibility checked by human completion under the same 100-step budget, distance-stratified horizon analysis (Figure 7), matched weather/time conditions (Table 3), and an oracle-checkpoint control (Appendix D, Table 7). Weaknesses: no repeated runs/variance or decoding settings reported for most tables, some analyses (failure taxonomy, oracle rescoring, trajectory case studies) cover only GPT-5.5, and evidence is single-city, single-protocol. Quantitative claims are well supported by tables (e.g., LongNav success 0.0-3.8% vs ShortNav up to 75.0%, Table 2; low SPR 10.0-46.7% with high PNA ~93-96% under closure, Table 4). Reproducibility is aided by released code/project page/app builds and fully reproduced prompts with a whitelisted action runner (Appendix B), though instance construction depends on manual annotation and a government data API. Overall a strong, relevant benchmark study with moderate-to-high score, held back by single-run evidence and limited generalization testing.

primary_link.title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City

papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can interpret a street view, but urban agency depends on whether such local evidence remains useful after the agent starts to move. In this paper, we investigate how far current MLLM agents can turn local urban perception into reliable action in a complicated real-scale city. We propose UrbanGround, the first sandbox to make this question testable in a physically constrained replica of Hong Kong built from territory-wide 3D geospatial data. UrbanGround supports closed-loop interaction from a first-person view and provides an interactive map for navigation. Agents can directly enter the 3D city and explore from a first-person view. Our analysis follows the growth of the spatial problem through three research questions. We first test whether an agent can ground a local scene well enough to answer spatial questions after active observation. Then we ask whether that grounding supports navigation as destinations become farther away and less explicit. Finally, we examine whether the resulting behavior survives changes in route availability and pedestrian motion. Contemporary MLLM agents usually show useful atomic abilities in visual recognition and short-range spatial reasoning, while orientation and pedestrian-aware movement remain unreliable. Their central failure emerges over extended exploration, where local abilities do not compose into sustained goal-directed behavior and errors accumulate without effective correction. We hope UrbanGround will support broader study of how far current MLLM agents can explore reliably in complex, open-ended urban environments.
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型雖能解讀單張街景，但城市中的自主行動取決於局部證據能否在移動過程持續有用。本文提出UrbanGround，首個以香港全域3D地理資料重建的實際尺度沙盒：基於地政總署的3D視覺化地圖與行人網路，串流至Unity並提供物理碰撞、日夜與天氣變化、動態行人與道路封閉事件，支援第一人稱閉迴路互動與互動式地圖。研究以三個遞進問題檢視當代MLLM代理：能否建立可用的局部空間定位；該定位能否支撐更遠、更不明確的導航；行為能否在城市變化下存續。810個人工驗證實例構成五級評測階梯，結果顯示：模型在視覺辨識與主動探索上表現良好，但方向理解明顯薄弱，多數接近隨機水準；短程導航尚有成功率，長距離導航幾乎全數失敗，即使多數旅程確實縮短了與目標的距離，錯誤仍持續累積且缺乏修正；遭遇道路封閉時，代理常繼續產出局部合規的移動而不重新規劃，行人碰撞率亦普遍偏高。天色與天氣對問答影響明顯，對短程導航的影響則不一致。核心啟示在於城市尺度的行動能力無法由孤立感知或短程成功推論，關鍵在於視野消失後維持並適時修訂空間估計，此沙盒為後續研究提供真實的地理基礎。

links.title: Behavior2Trip: Towards Personalized Travel Planning via User Behavior Trajectory

evidence: Abstract + §5.2 Table 3: GPT-4.1 achieves 0.5 Final PR on Hard while B2T-Agent-14B reaches 5.0 Final PR and 74.3 LLM PR, supporting the headline difficulty and method claims.

§3.2.2: user behavior trajectories are generated by Gemini-3-Flash role-play over candidate POI pools with controlled noise, so the core 'behavior' data is synthetic despite the real-platform grounding claim.

§4.2-4.4: multi-component reward (action penalty + gated plan reward), GRPO objective, and loss masking on tool/memory response tokens; method components are attributed to prior work (Shao et al. 2024b; Jin et al. 2025).
§6.3 Table 4: ablations on Qwen3-8B show removing loss mask drops DR 18.99%/Final PR 20.21%, memory removal drops Final PR 11.37%, penalty removal drops DR 10.17%.
§6.4 Table 5: cross-benchmark TravelPlanner results (FPR 9.0 vs 1.5 for GPT-4.1; CMa 25.0 vs 5.7) support generalization claims.
§3.2.4: two-stage quality control with DeepSeek-R1 0-3 scoring and human review of 1000 sampled instances at 94.6% agreement; §3.2.3 notes manual Next Step Prompt injection during annotation.
Footnote 1: code and data released at github.com/BUAA-IRIP-LLM/Behavior2Trip; Appendix A and C provide full toolset, constraint taxonomy, preference schema, and all generation/training prompts.
Limitations section: acknowledges GRPO rollout cost and multi-turn inference latency, an honest self-assessment.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM-agent paper: RL-trained agent (GRPO) with tool invocation, internal memory, and structured reasoning on a new personalized travel-planning benchmark; hits Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, memory, and training preferences. The task framing (inferring preferences from behavior trajectories instead of explicit instructions) is genuinely new for travel-planning benchmarks, and the benchmark itself is large and detailed (32 constraints, 9 tools, 11,400 instances). Novelty is capped because B2T-Agent assembles known techniques (GRPO, RLFactory, Qwen-Agent, Search-R1-style loss masking) and travel planning is a bounded domain. Rigor is solid: multi-model baselines (ReAct/SFT across Qwen3-8/14/32B, GPT-4o/4.1, DeepSeek-V3), micro/macro pass-rate metrics, component ablations, trajectory-complexity analysis, and cross-benchmark TravelPlanner evaluation. Weaknesses: behavior trajectories are LLM role-played (Gemini-3-Flash) rather than raw logs despite 'real user data' framing, CoA annotation requires manual next-step prompt injection, no significance testing, absolute hard-split pass rates remain very low (best 5.0 Final PR), and reward/metrics are travel-specific. Evidence is well-quantified and claims match tables; code, data, and all prompts are released, partially offsetting proprietary-model dependence and human-in-the-loop annotation for reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Behavior2Trip: Towards Personalized Travel Planning via User Behavior Trajectory

papers.summary: Travel planning agents assist users in generating personalized travel plans by modeling their individual preferences. Existing agents either rely on explicit user instructions or engage in multi-turn clarification to elicit user preferences. However, both approaches overlook the rich behavioral signals latent in users' past behaviors, which implicitly encode their preferences. This over-reliance on active user input increases interaction burden and limits plan personalization. To bridge this gap
papers.summary_zh: 現有旅遊規劃代理仰賴使用者顯式指令或多輪澄清來取得偏好，忽略了蘊含在使用者過往點擊、收藏、下單等行為中的隱式偏好訊號，不僅加重互動負擔，也限制個人化程度。本文提出新任務「行為感知的旅遊規劃」，直接從行為軌跡推斷偏好並生成個人化行程。為此建構Behavior2Trip基準：取材自中國大型線上旅遊平台，含11,400個實例，每例平均39.8個行為、橫跨5個偏好維度的14項屬性，並配備80.6k真實POI的沙盒環境、9項工具與32項約束，資料經兩階段品質把關。方法上提出B2T-Agent，以GRPO強化學習訓練Qwen3-8B：代理支援外部工具呼叫與以鍵值對組織的內部記憶模組，獎勵函數結合錯誤動作懲罰，以及以格式門控的常識約束與偏好約束分數，並對外部token施加損失遮罩。結果顯示任務極具挑戰：GPT-4.1在最難層級的全約束通過率僅0.5%，B2T-Agent-14B在同層級達5.0%、LLM評分達74.3，平均表現亦超越所有基線；消融實驗證明記憶、懲罰項與損失遮罩各有貢獻；遷移至TravelPlanner時更超越GPT-4.1。限制為GRPO取樣與多輪工具呼叫帶來的運算與延遲成本。此工作開啟以行為訊號取代主動詢問的個人化代理研究方向。
