links.title: Disentangling Optimization Scale from Preference Scale in DPO

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: claims β entangles inverse preference-noise scale with optimization dynamics; achieved policy deviation is non-monotone in β with peak at β_peak ≈ 4.6τ.
Table 2 (Section 3.2): measured initial gradient magnitudes G0/β constant to roughly 2% across a 20× range of β on HelpSteer3 SGD runs, confirming the linear prefactor in Eq. (6).

Appendix G.1 / Table G1: dense HelpSteer3 β sweep shows dead zone (β ≤ 2τ), peak at β ≈ 0.0025-0.003, and right saturation; two τ estimates (5.99e-4 from peak, 6.37e-4 from shape fit) agree within ~6%, explicitly labeled an internal consistency check.

Appendix H, Tables H1-H6: scale-equivalent pairs (matched ηβ) show validation DPO losses within 0.005-0.009 nats while KL ratios reach ~3-10×; Table I1 shows ~14-point AlpacaEval 2 LC win-rate gap between loss-identical runs (4 seeds).

Appendix B: closed-form β_crit = ε/√v̂^h (Eq. B.4-B.5) shows AdamW fully compensates for β ≫ β_crit, explaining why the coupling goes unnoticed at standard β ∈ [0.01, 0.2]; estimates use exact LoRA parameter counts with no free parameters.

Appendix E: Proposition 1 proves argmin equivalence of centered-softplus for β > 0; Proposition 2 gives the continuous β→0 limit −Δ/2; novelty statement credits Srinivas et al. (2022) for centered softplus and claims only the DPO diagnosis/normalization application as new.
Appendix A / Table 1: the β-prefactor coupling is shown analytically to persist across DPO-family variants (cDPO, α-DPO, GAPO, SimPO, TDPO, KTO), with IPO's inverted coupling noted as an exception.

Limitations section: evidence covers three datasets and four LoRA-tuned backbones (up to 4B); transfer to larger models, full fine-tuning, and noisy/adversarial labels deferred to future work; Wilcoxon tests at n=8 detect no significant differences and 'do not establish practical equivalence.'

Reproducibility section & Appendix M: public code (github.com/ivankru/bayesian_dpo), public datasets (HelpSteer3, UltraFeedback Binarized, PKU-processed HH-RLHF), full software versions (TRL 0.18.2, PyTorch 2.5.1), hardware, training times, and Monte Carlo KL protocol.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/DPO methodology paper, squarely matching LLM, Alignment & RLHF, and Training & Optimization preferences. The central observation (β prefactors the marginal gradient, Eq. 6) is one line of calculus and partially folklore given prior β-DPO sensitivity work; the centered-softplus normalization is argmin-trivial but genuinely useful as a diagnostic reformulation, and the paper honestly credits Srinivas et al. (2022) for the softplus form (Appendix E novelty statement). Rigor is solid: correct proofs, careful hedging of the phenomenological stopping-tolerance model, explicit acknowledgment that Adam compensation masks the effect at standard β (Appendix B) and that τ fits are internal-consistency rather than out-of-sample (Appendix G.1). Evidence is broad and quantitative: G0/β constant within ~2% (Table 2), dense non-monotone β sweep (Table G1), five scale-equivalent loss-invariance pairs with KL ratios 3-10× (Tables H1-H6), and downstream AlpacaEval 2/IFEval with seed-matched Wilcoxon tests (Tables I1-I2), though all LoRA at 3-4B scale with a Qwen-family judge. Novelty is the weakest component; reproducibility is strong (public code, datasets, full configs, versions in Appendix M).

primary_link.title: Disentangling Optimization Scale from Preference Scale in DPO

We show that $β$ entangles two distinct roles: it governs the effective inverse preference-noise scale and simultaneously rescales the optimization dynamics, coupling this scale with the effective step size. As a consequence, at a fixed learning rate the achieved policy deviation is
papers.summary_zh: 直接偏好最佳化（DPO）廣泛用於 RLHF 對齊，其係數 β 常被解讀為控制與參考策略的 KL 約束，但本文指出 β 同時扮演兩種角色：既是偏好雜訊的反向尺度，又直接乘在邊際梯度上，等同於改變有效學習率。這種糾纏使固定學習率下的策略偏離量對 β 呈非單調：過小時陷入梯度消失的死區，中等值附近出現峰值（約 4.6τ），過大時再回落；且不同 β 的損失值不可比較，損失曲線幾乎重疊的兩次訓練，其與參考模型的 KL 散度可相差數倍，導致超參數選擇困難並干擾學習率排程。作者提出中心化 softplus 重寫，在 β>0 時與原 DPO 極小值等價，卻移除梯度中的 β 前置因子，並具備 β→0 時收斂到線性偏好邊際目標的良定義極限。實驗以 Qwen 等模型在 HelpSteer3、UltraFeedback 與 HH-RLHF 上驗證，SGD 與 AdamW 下皆觀察到死區、峰值與飽和現象，正規化損失能恢復可預測縮放並使跨 β 比較可行。限制為證據多屬 LoRA 中等規模、種子數有限，極小值等價僅是目標層面的陳述；此工作對理解 DPO 超參數與訓練監控深具價值。
papers.title: Disentangling Optimization Scale from Preference Scale in DPO
papers.title_zh: 在 DPO 中將最佳化尺度與偏好尺度解耦

llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM-agent benchmark paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: it evaluates four LLM agents (gpt-5.5, gemini-3.1-pro, claude-opus-4.6, minimax-m2.7) on tool-assisted multi-step root-cause attribution over simulated time series, with agents writing/executing Python in a terminal scaffold. Novelty is moderate: agentic time-series/RCA benchmarks exist (OpenRCA, AIOpsLab, TimeSeriesGym, TS-Reasoner), but intervention-defined ground truth via physical simulation plus solvability filtering and four controlled task axes is a meaningful differentiation. Rigor is strong: matched test samples across conditions, five seeds per simulator/condition (60 episodes/agent), paired sign-flip-inversion confidence intervals (Table 23), classical baselines including privileged variants (Appendix E), confusion matrices, and explicit limitations (per-model scaffold confound, limited repetitions, closed label set). Evidence is mostly quantitative, though the programmatic-submission penalty at high noise (3.8 [-2.7, 10.5]) is not significant and the abstract's 'generally perform worse' slightly overstates it; the labeled-examples claim is appropriately hedged. Generalizability is limited and honestly scoped: three low-dimensional mechanical systems, closed-set labels, one instantaneous change per sample. Reproducibility is excellent: released code, dataset, trajectories, leaderboard, and full configuration details (noise coefficients, prompts, package versions, pricing).

In each generated task, an agent receives time-series observations produced by simulating a physical dynamical system and must determine
papers.summary_zh: 評估 LLM 代理進行時間序列根因歸因的基準多在真實遙測上進行，難以隔離代理結合時間與物理推理的能力。TraceBench 提出以物理模擬器生成受控任務的框架：代理觀察由可解釋力學系統（BallDrop、BounceBall、MassSlide）模擬產生的多變量時間序列，須判斷模擬中是否有參數被介入改變，若有則指出是哪一個參數，並以可解性過濾避免根因歧義的樣本。框架沿四個可控軸設計：領域脈絡、觀測雜訊、標註範例與提交模式（直接作答或撰寫 Python 腳本）。作者系統性評測四個代理，發現 gpt-5.5 在所有條件下準確率最高，minimax-m2.7 大幅落後；代理明顯受益於領域脈絡（移除後準確率下降 20–32 個百分點），但移除標註範例反而略增準確率並降低成本；代理主要仰賴數值主控台輸出而非視覺化圖表進行探索；撰寫可重用腳本的程式化提交表現較差且樣本外泛化有限。限制包括封閉標籤集、重複次數少與各代理腳手架不同；本基準是受控診斷測試平台，對釐清代理的時間與機制推理能力極具參考價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: a query-conditioned evidence-selection method for long-term multimodal agent memory, hitting high-weight preferences (agents, RAG/knowledge grounding, memory, LVLM/LLM readers). The framing of memory selection as maximum-weight forest optimization with decoupled node utility and anchor-conditioned edge verification is a fresh but incremental composition of known pieces (listwise LLM rerankers, multi-view retrieval, 1-swap local search, Kruskal MST). Rigor is solid: five baselines sharing one reader, two reader families, incremental ablation (Table 3: 49.20 to 61.55), controlled selector comparison against MMR/DPP/facility-location (Tables 9-10), solver audits (Fig 2), and a 200-sample judge audit with 97.0% agreement (Appendix A.7); all table arithmetic is internally consistent. However, the headline contribution's marginal gain over pointwise ECV reranking is modest (+0.90 to +1.85), no statistical significance tests are reported, no hyperparameter sensitivity analysis is given, there is no limitations section, and no code/data release is claimed. Evidence strength is supported by mechanism-level diagnostics (Tables 4-6) and cross-reader replication (Tables 1-2), but gains depend on a single LLM judge and external baseline results cannot be verified from the document. Reproducibility is helped by exhaustive hyperparameters (L=24, H=1, k=8, M=48, K=10, lambda=0.1, kappa=0.12), full prompts, and versioned judge protocol, but lacks availability statements.

To address these issues, we propose GraphMemix, a combinatorial-optimization graph memory framework that models memory organization as query-aware evidence-forest construction. Specifically, our method consists of three key components:(1) candidate gr
papers.summary_zh: 長期多模態代理記憶面臨兩難：與問題無關的離線摘要成本高昂且可能遺漏關鍵細節，單純的嵌入相似度檢索則容易選入近乎重複的記憶、漏掉低相似度卻互補的證據。GraphMemix 將記憶組織形式化為查詢條件下的證據森林最佳化：先以多視角檢索取得種子記憶，再透過綱要關係與語意關係擴展出有界候選圖；接著以節點驗證器估計單一記憶的直接支持度，並以證據鏈驗證器（ECV）在錨點條件下判斷每條關係屬於互補、冗餘、衝突或無關；最後在最大證據預算下聯合選取節點與可信邊，對任意節點集合以 Kruskal 演算法精確求出最大權重森林。在 ATM-Bench、Mem-Gallery、MemEye 與 H2HMem 四個基準上，配合 Qwen3-VL 或 Gemma 4 讀取器，Judge Accuracy 巨平均分別較最強公開基線提升 11.75 與 12.33 個百分點，並在完整生命週期成本上達到實證 Pareto 前沿；消融實驗確認多視角檢索、兩種驗證器與森林最佳化各有貢獻，聯合優化還能救回排名靠後的黃金證據。此方法為代理記憶的查詢時組織提供了精確且低成本的新典範。

links.title: FOCUS & RePAIR: Mitigating Text Degeneration via Token-Level Guidance for Pruned Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: proposes FOCUS (reweighted distillation toward high-confidence teacher regions) and RePAIR (onset-centered positive/negative continuation pairs with margin loss) for post-pruning fine-tuning.
Table 1 (Introduction): repetition rate rises from 5.9% (unpruned, sampling) to 12.4%/15.4% (width/depth pruned) and 26.6% to 63.1%/63.7% under greedy decoding.
Sec. 3.1 / Table 2: replacing only two onset tokens with top-2 alternatives reduces CREP from 5.9% to 0.7% (sampling) and 26.6% to 10.8% (greedy), supporting the entry-event claim.
Sec. 3.3 Eq. (9): persistence rho(c)=a(c)/(a(c)+e(c)); reducing repetition requires increasing escape mass inside the nucleus, not full-vocabulary entropy.
Footnote 1 (Sec. 3.2): the authors state rho-bar is not directly estimated; persistence evidence relies on mean repeated-token probability saturation (Appendix A, Fig. 6).
Table 3 (Sec. 5.2): Llama-3.1-8B CREP drops from 7.3 (KD) to 2.23 (RePAIR) and 0.57 (FOCUS+RePAIR) while PPL rises 21.69 to 23.12.
Table 4 (Sec. 5.3): Self-Instruct, RePAIR achieves CREP 0.63 and EAD1 0.32 vs KD's 1.97/0.28; FOCUS variants improve further with small PPL increase (25.65 to ~26.2).
Table 5 (Sec. 6): RePAIR vs DPO under identical pairwise data: RePAIR unique 3-gram 8.28 vs DPO 9.76, at slightly higher PPL (23.72 vs 23.29).
Sec. 5.4 / Table 6: LLM-as-judge uses 'GPT-120B (reasoning)', an unverifiable model name; win rates for RePAIR* over baselines are 38-41% with ~24% ties.
Appendix H, Tables 11-13: consistent CREP reductions on Llama-3.2-3B with Shortened-LLaMA and FLAP, and Qwen 2.5-3B with LLMPruner (e.g., Qwen KD CREP 6.73 vs FOCUS 0.87, RePAIR* 0.43).
Appendix I, Table 14: gains persist at 35% and 45% pruning, though MAUVE degrades with sparsity (0.72 at 35% to 0.46 at 45% for RePAIR).
Appendix D, Tables 8-10: zero-shot averages remain roughly stable (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B KD 60.39 vs FOCUS+RePAIR 60.86), supporting 'no meaningful performance degradation' claims.

Appendices E-K: hyperparameters (alpha1=0.05, alpha2=1, beta=15, KD temperature 2, DPO beta_dpo=0.1, pairwise threshold 0.3), CREP algorithm, and judge prompts are provided; no code release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely in scope: pruning-induced repetition degeneration in Llama/Qwen models, token-level distillation reweighting (FOCUS) and onset-centered pairwise margin loss (RePAIR). Relevance is high (LLM compression/distillation/generation quality with a DPO comparison), though it touches no agent/LLM-instruction topics directly. Novelty is moderate: the entry-risk vs. loop-persistence decomposition with nucleus escape mass (Sec. 3.3, Eq. 9) is a fresh analytical framing, but FOCUS is a focal-style KD reweight and RePAIR is an onset-localized variant of known unlikelihood/DITTO/pairwise-preference ideas. Rigor is decent: diagnostic onset-intervention (Table 2), four training baselines plus ToDi and DPO comparisons, ablations on hyperparameters (App. F) and pairwise data size (Fig. 5), yet Eq. 6 is only a loose structural bound and the authors admit persistence rho-bar is not directly estimated (footnote 1). Evidence strength is supported by many concrete tables across metrics and pruning ratios, but no statistical significance, single-scale models (3B-13B), and a dubious judge model name ('GPT-120B', Sec. 5.4/Table 6) weaken credibility. Generalizability is good within compression settings: three pruning methods, 25-45% ratios, two model families, two tasks (App. H-I). Reproducibility is moderate: hyperparameters, prompts, and algorithm (App. E-K) are detailed, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: FOCUS & RePAIR: Mitigating Text Degeneration via Token-Level Guidance for Pruned Large Language Models

papers.summary: Pruning is a practical approach to compress large language models (LLMs), but it can amplify text degeneration, especially repetition loops, even when perplexity and task accuracy remain largely unchanged. In this work, we present a token-level analysis of this failure mode by viewing decoding as a dynamical process that enters and persists in a small set of recurrent contexts. Our analysis decomposes degeneration into loop entry risk and loop persistence, and shows that persistence is controlle
papers.summary_zh: 剪枝是壓縮大型語言模型的實用手段，但即使困惑度與任務準確率大致不變，也可能加劇文本退化，尤其是重複迴圈。本文將解碼視為動態過程，把重複退化分解為迴圈進入風險與迴圈持續性，並證明持續性由 nucleus 取樣集合內分配給可信替代選項的逃逸機率質量所控制；剪枝與樸素蒸餾會同時增加教師抑制詞彙的洩漏（提高進入風險），並使迴圈敏感上下文的近似平手替代坍縮（提高持續性）。據此提出兩種 token 層級引導：FOCUS 對蒸餾加權、聚焦教師高信心區域以抑制洩漏；RePAIR 以退化起點為中心構造正負續寫對，用邊際損失促使模型偏好合理的替代詞。在 Llama 家族剪枝後以 LoRA 微調，於 WikiText-103 開放續寫與 Self-Instruct 指令生成上，兩法一致降低 CREP 重複率、提升 MAUVE、EAD1 與 BERTScore，僅帶來輕微困惑度上升，且可與 UL、ScaleGrad、DITTO 疊加，起點層級監督亦優於序列層級的 DPO。局限為超參數需另行搜尋，極端剪枝下的語意豐富度仍受容量限制；此工作為剪枝後的生成品質修復提供系統性處方。

Methodologically careful: matched clean-vs-poisoned trials with Wilson CIs, a no-policy ablation isolating instruction/data confusion from defeated alignment (31.9%→38.1%, overlapping intervals, Table 3), a SecAlign positive control (0/20 vs 20/20) validating the harness before claiming the defense's 32.5% generalization failure, and held-out encodings (ROT13 100%) exposing the authors' own guard as surface-bound. Novelty is moderate rather than high: indirect injection, instruction/data confusion, and the payload-blind-defense lesson are known (Greshake et al., CaMeL, adaptive-attack literature); the contribution is quantification (reframing taxonomy, attacker-effort curve 96% at k=3, three-level cost separating template from mechanism), which the authors themselves frame as trigger/cost rather than a new failure mode. Generalizability is bounded by a single-step synthetic agent, one canary secret, no size ladder, and a small output-only product test (0/48, mechanism unattributed, Section 7/10). papers.summary_zh: 工具使用型代理既會讀取攻擊者控制的網頁內容，又在情境中持有機密值，因而面臨間接提示注入導致資料外洩的風險。本文以合成金絲雀機密、僅記錄參數的模擬工具與乾淨對照中毒的成功指標，建立安全可重複的實驗室，並報告框架落差：在六個模型、十類直白注入上，gpt-4o 全部以 0% 拒絕，但把同一外洩行為改寫成完整性簽章、執行時設定欄位或貌似可信的主機後，其最強措辭的攻擊成功率可達 100%；由於各措辭成功率橫跨 0–100%，攻擊者嘗試三個手寫措辭即約有 96% 成功率。消融顯示移除機密性政策僅讓成功率由 31.9% 升至 38.1%，機制是指令與資料混淆而非繞過對齊。防禦方面：目的地允許清單與規劃器／讀取器能力隔離（CaMeL 式）皆可歸零；廣義「任何形式」保密條款雖有效卻脆弱；SecAlign 等微調防禦與通道分離均無法關閉落差，輸出正規化防護也會被留出的 ROT13 編碼繞過。結論是穩健性來自約束目的地或隔離能力，而非仰賴執行模型辨認攻擊，對代理安全設計極具啟示。

papers.summary_zh: LLM 機器翻譯可透過語境內學習利用翻譯記憶（TM）中的相似範例，但模型如何有效使用這些範例仍待探索。本文提出片段式推理框架：模型先從檢索到的相似範例中抽取平行的源語—目語片段，把這些片段作為中間推理軌跡，再產生最終譯文。訓練上以 Qwen3-32B 作為教師模型蒸餾出銀片段與草稿，再監督微調 Qwen3-8B 學生模型，比較僅片段、僅草稿、兩者兼用與無推理基線等變體。涵蓋六種語言、十六個領域的實驗顯示，片段式翻譯在 BLEU、COMET、MetricX 各指標與各範例數 k 下皆顯著優於標準 k-shot 與基礎草稿法，且增益與範例數無關，代表模型能從雜訊中篩出有價值資訊；方法也能泛化到未見過的 GNOME 領域。片段品質分析顯示源端片段精確率高、召回率約九成，學生推斷的片段甚至優於銀片段，但推斷草稿品質較低，常只是片段的重組。本方法並提供譯文對源句與範例的可追溯性。局限包括評測規模有限、仰賴 TM 或雙語語料，以及推理軌跡品質取決於教師輸出；對專業翻譯流程與檢索增強翻譯研究深具參考價值。

evidence: Section 1, Main Contributions: states three contributions - ACE-centered synthesis, factorized data object (E,q,τ,v), and mechanism-oriented taxonomy; no empirical claims are made.
Section 3.4, Eq. (8): ACE objective formalized as constrained distribution design with accuracy as an admission condition; no instantiation or validation experiment is presented.
Section 5.1, Eq. (10): complexity defined as verified failure probability under a declared learner configuration; framed as a simple model-relative definition, not measured in this paper.
Section 4.3.1: layered rule-/model-/human-based verification synthesized from cited works (APIGen, ToolACE, TOUCAN, ToolMVR, APIGen-MT) with qualitative tradeoff discussion.
Section 6.4, Eq. (13): proposes coverage and normalized-entropy statistics for diversity measurement, described as 'design principle rather than a universal score.'
Table 1 and Table 3: representative forward/reverse and domain-specific works listed with public GitHub/Hugging Face resource links for many entries.
Section 7.1: scaling-law discussion is explicitly speculative ('may therefore be less about...'), citing Chen et al. 2026a/b, Xu et al. 2026a, Tu et al. 2026 rather than presenting new evidence.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey/framework paper on agentic data generation for LLM agents, squarely matching the Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and Data & Datasets preferences (tool use, MCP, function calling, agent environments, verification). Its core contribution is conceptual: a factorized data object d=(E,q,τ,v) (Section 2.4), a forward/reverse generation taxonomy (Section 3, Tables 1-2), and the ACE lens (Sections 3.4-6). Novelty is moderate-to-good for a survey: the ACE framing and mechanism-level organization are useful syntheses, though the underlying ideas (verified synthesis, difficulty calibration, diversity beyond scale) are drawn from cited work rather than invented here. Rigor is limited by the absence of any empirical validation: the ACE objective (Eq. 8, Section 3.4), learner-relative complexity (Eq. 10, Section 5.1), and entropy-based diversity (Eq. 12-13, Section 6) are analytic formulations explicitly labeled 'a design principle rather than a universal score,' and no systematic literature-review methodology (search, inclusion criteria) is described. Evidence strength relies on qualitative synthesis with extensive, section-tied citations (e.g., layered verification in Section 4.3.1; execution-grounded checks in Section 4.3.3), but headline claims such as 'diversity-oriented scaling can outperform quantity scaling' (Section 7.1) are asserted from cited works without the paper's own experiments. Generalizability is a strength: the framework explicitly spans tool-use, SWE, GUI, embodied, social, and scientific agents (Section 6.3.6, Table 3). Reproducibility is partial: Tables 1-3 provide public resource links for many cited systems, but the framework itself has no implementation, and key components (weights, redundancy measures, entropy estimators) are left domain-dependent. A well-organized, highly relevant survey whose value is conceptual rather than evidentiary.

primary_link.title: What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents

papers.summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on generated interaction data to learn how to interact with external environments. Agentic data generation must maintain consistency among environments, tasks, interactions, and success signals while producing experience that is useful rather than merely abundant. Existing work spans many agent domains, but domain-centered organization and heterogeneous evaluation often obscure common generation mechanisms and conflate candidate construction with verification and selection. This work develops a two-level framework for the field. First, we represent agentic data as a common factorized object (E,q,τ,v), comprising an environment specification, task signal, interaction realization, and optional verifier. We organize generation paradigms by their primary anchor and dependency structure. Second, we formulate generation as constrained distribution design through the Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity (ACE) lens. Accuracy establishes the feasible support of grounded and internally consistent data. Within this support, Complexity places learning mass relative to the capability of a declared learner and execution configuration, while divErsity controls coverage and redundancy of data. Using this framework, we explore how prior work verifies generated experience, constructs and calibrates difficulty, and expands behavioral coverage. The literature reveals a shift toward execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity beyond surface variation or dataset size. We further discuss broader directions and emerging trends in agentic data generation through the ACE lens, including their implications for scaling, data sources, training regimes and adaptive learning. Overall, the central challenge is not simply to generate more data, but to continually allocate valid, informative, and non-redundant experience as agents and environments evolve.
papers.summary_zh: 代理資料生成已從單純的指令合成，演進為需同時維護環境、任務、互動與成功訊號一致性的複雜工程，但既有文獻多以領域為中心組織，難以比較彼此機制。本文提出兩層框架：首先將代理資料表示為可分解物件 (E, q, τ, v)，即環境規格、任務訊號、互動實現與可選驗證器，並依主要錨點與依賴結構把生成流程分為正向（環境→任務→軌跡）與逆向（任務優先、軌跡優先、結構優先）等範式；其次以 Accuracy–Complexity–divErsity（ACE）將生成形式化為受限分布設計：準確性定義可行支撐，複雜度需相對學習者與執行組態校準至可學帶，多樣性則衡量非冗餘的行為覆蓋。文章據此綜整各領域的驗證堆疊、約束式建構、執行導向驗證與回饋修復，以及結構規格、資訊控制、失敗驅動校準與覆蓋導向平衡等機制，並討論 ACE 下的縮放法則、真實與合成資料的取捨、代理預訓練／中訓練與自演化代理的資料迴路。核心論點是：挑戰不在生成更多資料，而在隨代理與環境演化，持續配置有效、有資訊量且不冗餘的經驗。

While deterministic graph tools are invariant to such shifts, extracting topological structures from noisy text is highly fragile for LLMs, which often overfit to surface patterns. Moreover, mitigating these parsing failures via multi-agent systems incurs prohibitive latency. To address this, we propose GRAIN, a single-agent framework opt
papers.summary_zh: 論文觀察到，圖形工具對節點命名與任務形式的改變並不敏感，LLM在真實世界圖推理中卻對表面變化極為脆弱：開源模型在隨機ID下劇烈退化，閉源模型在正規化命名下亦不穩定；多代理系統雖能提升準確率，但延遲與token成本高昂。作者提出GRAIN，一個單代理強化學習框架，將推理建模為「語意解析＋工具執行」管線，並設計結構不變性獎勵，以Jaccard指標比對模型抽取之中間圖與真實拓撲，迫使模型學習穩健的「文字到結構」映射而非記憶語言表層。訓練先以SFT暖啟動，再以ARPO（代理式強化策略最佳化）進行，利用熵驅動的自適應部分rollout處理命名歧義。同時發布GRIT基準，涵蓋六大圖問題、31種真實情境，並提供標準與敘事兩種形式、四種命名方案的等構多視角設計。實驗顯示GRAIN在Qwen-3-4B上達95.76%，較工具用SFT提升6.66個百分點，比多代理基線MA-GTS高出16.45%且延遲降低約24%；OOD差距由SFT的15.77%減半至7.80%，並在GraphInstruct、GraphArena上展現強零樣本遷移。消融證實結構獎勵與多元命名缺一不可。限制在於工具定義佔用上下文，未來擬採用MCP協定。此工作凸顯結構不變性對可靠圖推理的關鍵性。
papers.title: GRAIN: Bridging Name and Narrative Shifts in Real-World Graph Reasoning through Invariance-Rewarded Agentic RL
papers.title_zh: GRAIN：以不變性獎勵之代理式強化學習橋接真實世界圖推理的名稱與敘事轉移

links.title: Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Large Language Model Inference

evidence: Abstract: claims 2.71x speedup and 4.35-point CIDEr gain over Saber on Flickr30K; §4.2 reports >2x step reduction with >4 CIDEr improvement and >2 accuracy points on AI2D vs Saber.
§3.2, Eq. 3: confidence-ordered attention mask blocks information flow from lower- to higher-confidence candidate tokens; Eq. 5-7 define distance-weighted adaptive logit mixing with geometric kernel.
§5.1 Table 1: ablation shows bidirectional mask loses 1.8 accuracy points vs DARD's confidence ordering (+1.4 over Saber) at similar step counts (59.3 vs 58.5).
§5.1 Table 2: fixed w=1.0 achieves fewest steps (57.1) but adaptive mixing yields higher accuracy (34.6 vs 33.4), supporting adaptive weighting.
Appendix A.2: hyperparameters specified (tau_c/tau_u grids, lambda=0.917, p0=0.1), RTX A6000 hardware, temperature zero, single-run results — no variance reported.
Appendix C.5 Table 12: single-step latency 186.8ms (DARD, block 128) vs 183.9ms (WINO); peak GPU memory overhead under 6.3% in worst case.
Limitations: authors concede 'absolute performance gain remains moderate' and that the shadow sequence introduces additional per-step computation.
Appendix C.2 Table 6: confidence-based ordering aligns better with one-token-per-step trajectory (Overlap@8 = 0.81 LLaDA/GSM8K vs 0.60 for left-to-right), supporting the design intuition.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free decoding method for diffusion LLMs (LLaDA, LLaDA-1.5, MMaDA), squarely within LLM inference/efficiency scope. It identifies a credible failure mode (unreliable tokens contaminating verification context in revocable decoding) and contributes a three-state confidence-ordered attention masking scheme plus adaptive logit mixing — a genuine but incremental advance over WINO and Saber, which it builds on directly (shadow-sequence verification is inherited from WINO, §3.1). Evidence is broad: 12 benchmarks, 3 models, Pareto curves, ablations over mask ordering (Table 1), logit-mixing weights (Table 2), generation/block length (Table 3), threshold sensitivity (Table 9), latency/memory overhead (Table 12), and ordering-alignment analysis (Table 6). Weaknesses: single-run results at temperature zero with no variance or significance testing, headline multimodal gains concentrated on Flickr30K CIDEr, modest absolute gains acknowledged in Limitations, and no explicit code release despite reproducibility intent. Method is tied to absorbing dLLMs with bidirectional attention, limiting transfer beyond that family, though it generalizes across model scales/tasks tested.

primary_link.title: Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Large Language Model Inference

papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by decoding multiple tokens in parallel through iterative denoising. However, increasing decoding parallelism often degrades generation quality, as early errors can contaminate later contexts. Revocable decoding mitigates this issue by re-evaluating decoded tokens and remasking unreliable ones, but existing methods overlook that unreliable tokens may also corrupt the verification context itself. We
papers.summary_zh: 擴散式大型語言模型（dLLM）可平行解碼多個token以加速推論，但平行度提高時品質往往下降，因早期錯誤會污染後續上下文。可撤銷解碼透過重新驗證並重新遮罩不可靠token來緩解此問題，但現有方法忽略一個失敗模式：錯誤token本身可能成為驗證其他token的上下文，例如「Los Diego」這類局部合理但組合錯誤的配對。作者提出DARD，一個免訓練的三狀態框架，將token區分為遮罩、候選與未遮罩三種狀態，並以狀態專屬注意力遮罩控制資訊流：未遮罩狀態驗證時僅信賴可靠上下文；候選狀態依信心排序，高信心者先驗證並作為低信心者的上下文，近似信心排序的多步解碼。此外根據驗證結果自適應混合原始與影子序列的logits，動態調節候選token對後續解碼的影響。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct、LLaDA-1.5與MMaDA-8B-MixCoT上的12個文字與多模態基準顯示，DARD持續改善速度—品質Pareto前沿，於Flickr30K相較Saber取得2.71倍加速且CIDEr提升4.35分。限制包括絕對效能增益適中，以及影子序列帶來的少量每步開銷。此研究指出，驗證上下文的可靠性是可撤銷解碼的核心要素，對dLLM的可靠平行解碼具實務意義。
papers.title: Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Large Language Model Inference
papers.title_zh: 依賴感知之可撤銷解碼：實現高效率的擴散式大型語言模型推論

links.title: Meta-Learning Where to Allocate Experts: Task-Conditioned Layer-Wise Compression for MoEs

evidence: Abstract: aggressive setting activates 2.28 experts on average (62% fewer) with ~3.7pp accuracy drop; conservative setting 3.61 experts (40% fewer) at 0.489 vs 0.474 MMLU accuracy.
Section 4.1: backbone DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat (27 routed layers, 64 experts, native k=6) frozen; only MetaNet trained, 450 episodic steps; three RTX 4090 GPUs.
Table 1: C-Eval-Full zero-shot transfer, MetaNet aggressive 0.386 at ratio 0.045 vs fixed k=6 0.444 at ratio 0.094.
Table 4: component ablation - budget-only gate agreement 0.038 vs full method 0.943, low-use selection 0.734 vs 0.004.
Section 5.4: latency 542.94 to 516.52 ms (4.9%) despite 62% fewer activated experts; OLMoE result 'provides only weak evidence for compression'.
Limitations: active ratio is a routing-level proxy not total FLOPs; main MMLU result uses 192 held-out queries; only two seeds, no significance testing; adapted baselines are not exact reproductions.
Appendix C.2: seed sensitivity - fixed k=6 0.505±0.030 vs conservative MetaNet 0.506±0.022 at mean k 4.94±0.27, diverging from the main-table operating point (3.61).
Table 6 / Appendix B: full hyperparameters and MMLU subject splits disclosed; Ethical Considerations promise release of code and controller artifacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper on MoE inference efficiency (DeepSeek-MoE, OLMoE; MoE routing, compression, inference optimization), not a domain application or out-of-scope area. The task-conditioned, layer-wise expert-allocation controller (support-set meta-learned retention threshold + bounded bias on a frozen router) is a genuinely new point in the design space between offline layer-wise allocation (MoLA/AlphaLoRA/LExI) and token-level dynamic routing, though incremental over both. Evaluation is careful and unusually honest (gate-agreement/low-use diagnostics, layer-mask ablations, separated latency harnesses, explicit 'adapted' baseline caveats), but statistically thin: the headline '40% fewer experts at comparable accuracy' rests on 192 MMLU queries with ~1.5pp gaps inside the reported seed noise (Appendix C.2: fixed k=6 0.505±0.030 vs conservative 0.506±0.022, at mean k 4.94 vs 6.00), the aggressive profile clearly loses accuracy on C-Eval (0.386 vs 0.444, Table 1), the OLMoE win is admitted to be weak compression evidence (Section 5.4), and latency gains (3.4-4.9%) are far below the expert reduction. Reproducibility is strong (full hyperparameters Table 6, subject splits Appendix B, seeds described, code promised).

primary_link.title: Meta-Learning Where to Allocate Experts: Task-Conditioned Layer-Wise Compression for MoEs

papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a subset of expert networks, increasing capacity while keeping per-token computation sparse. In many deployed MoEs, the number of active experts is fixed across layers and tasks, although layer roles and expert redundancy vary with depth and demand varies with difficulty. Existing approaches address only part of this setting: layer-wise allocations are usually determined offline and reused for all tasks, while token-level methods vary expert ac
papers.summary_zh: MoE模型雖以稀疏路由降低每步運算，但多數部署在所有層與任務間使用固定的專家啟用數，忽略各層角色與專家冗餘隨深度變化的事實。既有方法不是離線決定逐層配置並跨任務重用，就是僅依逐token路由訊號調整而缺乏任務層級脈絡。作者提出MetaNet，一個支援集控制器：以少量支援樣本通過凍結骨幹取得的逐層路由統計（熵、最大專家機率、top-R覆蓋率）為輸入，預測每層的保留門檻與有界路由偏移，骨幹、原始router與完整專家池皆保持不變。以DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat為主要對象，激進設定平均啟用2.28個專家（較固定k=6減少62%），MMLU準確率約降3.7個百分點；保守設定啟用3.61個（減少40%）並達0.489，與固定k=6的0.474相當。以MMLU訓練的控制器可零樣本遷移至C-Eval與OLMoE。消融顯示預算分支與先驗分支互補，先驗分支可維持與原始gate一致的專家選擇（gate agreement 0.943）；深層比淺層更可壓縮。限制：方法降低的是啟用專家負載而非儲存或總FLOPs，端到端延遲僅降3.4–4.9%，且重複取樣僅兩個種子。此工作證明專家需求隨任務與深度而異，為MoE推理壓縮提供新軸線。
papers.title: Meta-Learning Where to Allocate Experts: Task-Conditioned Layer-Wise Compression for MoEs
papers.title_zh: 以元學習決定專家配置位置：針對MoE的任務條件化逐層壓縮

links.title: When Does Supervised Fine-Tuning Reduce Instruction Sensitivity?

evidence: Section 4.3: identical fine-tuning across conditions — LoRA r=8, alpha=16, AdamW lr 2e-5, warmup 0.1, batch size 8, seq len 512, 3 epochs, post-SFT results over three random seeds, no model-specific tuning

Section 5.3/Table 4: at 1.7B and 4B all Delta-S CIs lie below zero; at 8B individual changes are not reliable but D=0.0103 with CI [0.0021,0.0173] and P(D>0)=0.996; seed-level contrasts positive (0.0116, 0.0064, 0.0128) and all leave-one-seed-out CIs above zero
Section 5.3: cross-family checks qualify the pattern — Gemma-2-9B D=0.0024 with CI [-0.0013,0.0086] including zero; Mistral-7B D=-0.0009 with CI [-0.0044,0.0027]

Section 5.4/Table 5: ESCI free-generation sensitivity rises 0.0121 to 0.0141/0.0171 while forced-choice goes 0.0136 to 0.0119/0.0138; mean valid-label rate 0.9983 (sd 0.0027), ruling out format failure as the explanation

Section 6.3 Limitations: scale analysis limited to three Qwen3 sizes, only three training instructions and ten evaluation paraphrases, three seeds deemed insufficient for inference over training runs, no mechanism identified

Introduction footnote: code, instruction sets, and analysis scripts in anonymous repository https://anonymous.4open.science/r/instruction-sensitivity-sft-61A0; Table 2 provides full texts of training instructions
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM-methodology study of how fixed-instruction SFT changes instruction sensitivity, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, prompting/prompt robustness, training & optimization, evaluation). It is not a pure domain application: the object of study is LLM behavior (Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B, plus Mistral-7B and Gemma-2-9B checks), with search relevance only as the testbed. Novelty is moderate: the pre-post within-model design and training-instruction contrast extend known results on prompt sensitivity (POSIX, ProSA, PAFT, SAPO) and evaluation artifacts (Hua et al.), but the framing and findings are genuine contributions. Rigor is strong: paired query-level bootstrap (10,000 replicates), explicit separation of non-significant individual 8B changes from a reliable paired contrast (D=0.0103, CI [0.0021,0.0173], P(D>0)=0.996), three seeds with leave-one-seed-out checks, and honest cross-family reporting (Gemma directional only, CI includes zero; Mistral no pattern). Evidence is supported by consistent tables, but scope is narrow: two relevance tasks, three training instructions, ten eval paraphrases, three seeds, one systematically studied family. Generalizability is correspondingly limited and acknowledged in Section 6.3. Reproducibility is good: full LoRA/hyperparameter details, verbatim training instructions (Table 2), public datasets, and an anonymous code repository, though checkpoint identifiers are only indirectly provided.

primary_link.title: When Does Supervised Fine-Tuning Reduce Instruction Sensitivity?

papers.summary: Large language models can exhibit substantial performance variation across alternative formulations of the same task instruction, yet it remains unclear how conventional task-specific supervised fine-tuning (SFT) changes this instruction sensitivity. We study this question by evaluating fixed model checkpoints under multiple paraphrased instructions and defining instruction sensitivity as the standard deviation of task performance across them. We conduct a controlled scale analysis with Qwen3 mo
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型對同一任務的不同指令改寫可能表現出顯著的效能變異，但傳統任務專屬監督式微調（SFT）如何改變此指令敏感度仍不清楚。作者以固定模型檢查點在多個改寫指令下評估，定義指令敏感度為跨指令任務效能的標準差。主要實驗採Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B於MS MARCO段落排序，並以Mistral-7B與Gemma-2-9B進行跨家族驗證。結果顯示：SFT前敏感度隨規模下降；在1.7B與4B，SFT在各訓練指令下一貫降低敏感度約54–71%；但在8B，個別變化在統計上無法與零區分，惟訓練指令間的成對對比（T_B−T_A為+0.0103，P(D>0)=0.996）可靠且在三個隨機種子方向一致；Gemma-2-9B呈現同向模式而Mistral-7B則否，顯示效果強度跨模型變異。ESCI-English實驗進一步發現：自由生成與以likelihood為基礎的forced-choice兩種評測協定，在平均效能與有效標籤率（>99.8%）相近時，對穩健性的結論卻截然不同。限制包括僅三個Qwen3尺寸、訓練指令有限、三個種子不足以支撐跨訓練回合的推論。此研究的啟示是：SFT並非一致降低指令敏感度，其效果取決於模型、訓練指令與評測協定，任務效能與指令穩健性應分開評估。

links.title: ASIL: Replacing Screenshot-and-Click with Structured State and Semantic Actions

evidence: Abstract: ASIL reaches above 80 with closed models executing fewer than five actions per task; repaired GUI baselines give 6.6 and 26.6 strict success, and matched native comparisons show ASIL exceeds LibreOffice UNO by 28-38 points but only matches draw.io MCP.

Section 5.2 / Table 2: matched baselines run with same evaluator, model, 15-step budget, and no success hint; GPT-5.4 LibreOffice ASIL/UNO 95.0/66.7 strict; draw.io ASIL/MCP 55.0/55.0 for GPT-5.4 and 25.0/55.0 for sonnet4.6.

Limitations section: main ASIL prompts include evaluator-derived success hints (29/30 vs 26/30 strict on balanced-30), so the original main table does not isolate the interface variable; broader independent validation across all 380 tasks is future work.

Section 5.3 / Tables 8-9 (Appendix C): Qwen3.5-2B 58.0->72.1 (SFT)->74.4 (RL) and 9B 66.6->80.4->82.2 on the 380-task benchmark; RL uses 320 train/80 valid tasks on 4-8 A800 GPUs with detailed hyperparameters; no GUI-mode training arm is reported.
Section 5.4 / Table 3: held-out 80-task hard suite shows 9B gains grow to +17.1/+19.8 but 2B RL checkpoint (+3.6) trails 2B SFT (+6.0), with Creative real-photo editing at best 15.2 for any row.

Section 2: paper cites AXIS, API-based web agents, CLI-Anything, OpenCLI, and declarative-interface analyses (Wang et al. 2026) as prior work making similar API-over-pixels arguments, bounding the claim to a cross-application contract plus training reuse (Table 5).

Appendix E: release covers adapter library for all 15 applications, 380-task and hard-suite task definitions, RL curriculum, SFT/RL checkpoints, baseline scripts, and a one-command Docker path with fail-closed readiness report over 15 adapter gates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent paper: proposes a structured-JSON/semantic-action agent-software interface replacing screenshot-and-click, evaluated on a self-built 380-task benchmark across 15 applications, with closed models (GPT-5.4, sonnet4.6, Qwen3.6-plus, Kimi K2.5) and SFT+RL on Qwen3.5-2B/9B. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code, RL, and Training preferences. Novelty is bounded: the paper itself cites AXIS, CLI-Anything, OpenCLI, declarative-interface analyses, and SWE-agent/CodeAct as prior interface-over-pixels arguments, so the contribution is systematization breadth, a shared contract, and a training demonstration rather than a new concept. Rigor is solid with notable camera-ready validity work (hint-off arms, independent raw-state validator, matched UNO/MCP baselines, realization-pattern ablation, training-overlap audit) and an unusually honest limitations section admitting prompt asymmetry in the headline main table, 2B RL instability on the hard suite, and coverage gaps; residual confounds remain since ASIL prompts carried evaluator-derived hints in Table 1 and the 'OSWorld-comparable' band is only proxy-calibrated. Evidence is extensive but almost entirely on the authors' own benchmark and validators, with no direct GUI-mode training comparison to substantiate the training-efficiency claim, and GUI baselines only for two models. Generalizability is explicitly scoped to software with at least one open file/script/API access door, excluding opaque applications. Reproducibility claims are strong: full adapter library, tasks, checkpoints, training data, baseline scripts, and a one-command Docker smoke test are promised in Appendix E.

primary_link.title: ASIL: Replacing Screenshot-and-Click with Structured State and Semantic Actions

papers.summary: Powerful code agents can execute scripts, call tools, and manage files, yet many important applications remain accessible primarily through graphical user interfaces. We argue that screenshot-and-click is an inefficient interface for software-operating agents: screenshots are state-incomplete, and GUI actions are brittle, semantically weak, and poorly matched to long-horizon planning. We introduce ASIL (Agent-Software Interaction Layer), an agent-native interface that exposes software through st
papers.summary_zh: 論文主張，軟體操作代理的瓶頸不在任務難度，而在介面錯配：截圖是軟體狀態的不完整投影，GUI事件則是座標敏感的脆弱動作原語。作者提出ASIL（Agent-Software Interaction Layer），以結構化JSON觀察與可執行程式碼的語意動作取代截圖與點擊，並依應用特性選擇最深的可行存取路徑（檔案、原生腳本或服務API），在15個應用上實作380項任務的基準（300單應用＋80多應用），共用驗證器與GUI渲染以便公平比較。結果顯示：GPT-5.4與Qwen3.6-plus在ASIL下達81.6與81.1，每任務平均執行少於五個動作；修復後的GUI控制（50步預算）僅6.6與26.6，在較易的easy60帶亦僅15.0與53.3。與原生介面對比，ASIL在LibreOffice上超出UNO API 28–38分，但在draw.io僅與MCP打平。訓練方面，ASIL軌跡可重用於SFT與on-policy RL：Qwen3.5-2B由58.0升至72.1（SFT）再至74.4（RL），9B由66.6升至80.4再至82.2；9B在80任務難題套件的增益進一步放大。限制包括主表比較存在提示不對稱、2B模型RL在長時程任務不穩、全閉源應用無法覆蓋、以及本質上依賴像素判斷的感知型任務。此工作將軟體操作重新定義為對狀態與可驗證產物的互動。

links.title: ProRetrieval: Learning to Orchestrate Hybrid Search via Executable Program Synthesis

evidence: Abstract: 4B model surpasses GPT-5.5 (Hit@1 0.81 vs 0.69 e-commerce; 0.91 vs 0.86 email) using Qwen3-4B trained with GRPO/DAPO under a hierarchical four-term reward.
§4.2 Table 1: 4B GRPO 0.809 and 4B DAPO 0.909 Hit@1; 8B SFT 0.820 on e-commerce; baseline paradigms B1–B4 plus few-shot commercial LLMs.
§4.3 Table 2: full-DSL SFT (0.680) underperforms SQL+text SFT (0.752); RL on full DSL reaches 0.809 with image queries improving 0.323→0.716.
§4.4 Table 4: IID-to-OOD Hit@1 gaps within 3pp on both benchmarks for 300 human-annotated OOD queries per domain.
Appendix F Table 11: bootstrap 95% CIs (10,000 resamples) separating GRPO [0.795,0.823] from SFT [0.663,0.697]; GRPO and DAPO intervals overlap on email.
Limitations (i)–(ix): schema dependence, two-domain evaluation, corpora of 3,000/5,000 documents, no cross-seed variance, and GPT-4o query verbalization bias acknowledged.
Appendix H: commercial LLM few-shot prompts with schemas and exemplar DSL programs reproduced verbatim; code/data links given (anonymous.4open.science, HuggingFace).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM methodology work: RL-trained (GRPO/DAPO) small LLM as a retrieval orchestrator emitting a hybrid SQL+vector DSL, directly matching LLM, RAG, agents/tool-use, and RL preferences. Novelty is moderate: the delta over SUQL, Text2VectorSQL, and DeepRetrieval is RL-optimized cross-backend orchestration with an image primitive and a hierarchical four-term reward. Rigor is solid—four baseline paradigms, action-space ablation (§4.3), modality/complexity breakdowns, human-annotated OOD queries (§4.4), bootstrap CIs (Appendix F), and honest negative results (full-DSL SFT underperforms SQL+text; GRPO post-peak degradation in Appendix C)—but the evidence rests on two small self-built synthetic corpora (3,000 products, 5,000 emails) with GPT-4o verbalization bias, single-seed RL runs, and comparisons whose frontier model names cannot be independently verified. Generalizability is constrained by schema dependence, two-level nesting, and single-turn retrieval as the authors concede. Reproducibility is aided by anonymous code/data links, verbatim prompts (Appendix H), and detailed hyperparameters, though the multi-stage synthetic pipeline is complex to rebuild.

primary_link.title: ProRetrieval: Learning to Orchestrate Hybrid Search via Executable Program Synthesis

Existing hybrid pipelines such as reciprocal rank fusion or self-querying retrievers admit only a fixed form of composition, while recent reinforcement-learning retrievers train the language model as a query generator for a single backend, leaving the orchestration of heterogeneous retrieval paths outside its action space. We propose ProRetrieval, which recasts t
papers.summary_zh: 真實世界的檢索常需在結構化欄位與文字、影像的語意意圖之間，以任意布林邏輯組合條件，但現有混合管線（如RRF、self-querying retriever）僅支援固定組合形式，而RL檢索器多將LLM訓練為單一後端的查詢產生器。作者提出ProRetrieval，把語言模型重塑為檢索編排器：給定自然語言查詢，模型在混合DSL中合成可執行程式，交錯SQL運算元與文字、影像向量檢索原語，並透過佔位符注入讓SQL承擔最終的AND/OR/NOT融合。訓練分兩階段：先以專家DSL範例SFT暖啟動，再以GRPO或DAPO在四項階層式獎勵（格式、可執行性、結果、長度）下強化學習，訓練對象為Qwen3-4B。作者另建兩個基準：Amazon電商（3,000商品）與Enron郵件（5,000封）。結果顯示4B模型超越GPT-5.5（電商Hit@1 0.81對0.69；郵件0.91對0.86），並全面領先檢索、重排、結構化查詢與圖式基線；行動空間消融揭示全DSL在SFT下因多任務干擾遜於SQL+text，但RL克服此障礙（影像查詢提升39.3分）；OOD測試差距在3分以內。限制包括依賴預定義schema、邏輯深度受限、僅兩個領域與中等語料規模，且未報告跨種子變異。此工作確立「檢索程式合成」為跨模態統一檢索的有力方向。
papers.title: ProRetrieval: Learning to Orchestrate Hybrid Search via Executable Program Synthesis
papers.title_zh: ProRetrieval：透過可執行程式合成學習編排混合式搜尋

links.title: Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit

evidence: Abstract/§6.1: registered primary endpoint PAG_weak = +0.085 (95% BCa [-0.167,+0.353], exact signed-rank p=0.684) is null, explicitly framed as failure-to-detect; Appendix E gives power 0.709 at +0.353 and >0.80 only past +0.40-0.42.

§6.3: on 17 of 30 weak stimuli the productive-struggle low pole is pinned at 1.000 in all three arms; a post-hoc zero-differential-preference construction reproduces +0.321 (85%) of the observed +0.378 interaction (79% when rounded), with the residual acknowledged to bound nothing.

§5 Eq.(2): closed-form result PAG = (κ_H - κ_L)δ showing a common severity shift manufactures an interaction under unequal censoring; headroom asymmetry 6.62 vs 1.38 scale points on the weak stratum (§5).

§3 and Appendix A: judge is a frozen Claude Opus 4.8 instance over 990 calls; full system prompt, user template, both 59-word profile texts, and decoding ('provider defaults, no temperature specified, a 512-token output cap') are reproduced; token-count controls rule out prompt-length confounds.

§7 Limitations: demonstration confined to 'a single judge model, one rubric, six acid-mixture word problems, and 55 stimuli clustered in 23 source tutoring runs', with acknowledged pole-construction and tutor-family confounds.
§2: authors state 'that a scale can manufacture an interaction is known (Rohrer and Arslan, 2021)', bounding novelty to the within-item LLM-judge transfer rather than the phenomenon itself.

Appendix D Table 3: per-estimand specification status (frozen-hash registered vs post-hoc exploratory), 21 tests and 26 intervals disclosed; no code/data repository for this study is stated, though underlying corpus logs from Fan et al. (2026) are reused and test-retest r=0.979 is documented (§7).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM evaluation-methodology work: an identifiability analysis showing within-item difference-in-differences endpoints on bounded LLM-judge rating scales confound preference with differential censoring, demonstrated inside a pre-registered audit of a frozen Claude Opus 4.8 pedagogy judge. Preference relevance is solid but not top-tier: it targets LLM-as-judge bias auditing (matching LLM and evaluation/safety topics) rather than capabilities, reasoning, agents, or Japanese LLMs, and the empirical setting is a small pedagogy niche. Novelty is moderate because the authors themselves concede the manufactured-interaction phenomenon is known (Rohrer and Arslan 2021; Puhani 2012); the contribution is the within-item two-pole closed form and its live demonstration in judge audits. Rigor is exceptional for this literature: a pre-registered primary endpoint reported honestly as null at stated resolution, exact tests with attainable p-value floors disclosed, BCa intervals, power/coverage simulation, a per-estimand specification-status table, and unusually thorough limitations. Evidence strongly supports the narrow claims (the zero-differential-preference construction reproduces 79-85% of the significant interaction; 17/30 weak stimuli are floored), but the demonstration spans one judge model, one rubric, six word problems, and 55 clustered stimuli, limiting generalizability despite the generic algebra. Reproducibility is good via the fully reproduced instrument, profile texts, decoding parameters, and hashed frozen analysis code, though no artifact release URL for this study itself is stated.

primary_link.title: Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit

papers.summary: Audits of LLM judges certify a bias by contrasting matched conditions, and the strongest designs difference twice: a within-item contrast between two candidate responses, differenced again across a manipulated attribute, read off a bounded rating scale. We show that this endpoint is not identified on the scale that reports it. Each term of the double difference is censored by its own share, so the observed statistic confounds differential preference with differential attenuation: a severity shif
papers.summary_zh: LLM評審稽核常以配對條件對比驗證偏誤，其中最強的設計是雙重差分：在兩個候選回應間做組內對比，再跨操作屬性再差分，並從有界評分量表讀取結果。本文證明此端點在所報告的量表上不可識別：雙重差分的每一項都受各自的截斷影響，觀測統計量混淆了差異性偏好與差異性衰減；當兩極距離量表上下限不等時，共同的嚴重度位移會製造出交互作用，而高品質素材恰將兩極推向量表兩端。作者以預註冊稽核為例：對凍結的教學法評審（Claude Opus 4.8）發出990次呼叫，註冊的主要端點Profile Anchoring Gap為零結果（+0.085，95% BCa [−0.167, +0.353]，p=0.684），而唯一名義顯著的交互作用+0.378（p=0.002）經一個零差異偏好的建構，即可由觀測嚴重度位移與量表下限重製79–85%；在30個弱層刺激中有17個低極在所有條件下釘死於下限，此時雙重差分在代數上退化為單極對比。封閉形式分析並顯示截斷對此端點並非保守。限制為單一評審模型、單一rubric與55個刺激。此文對以短評分量表報告交互作用的LLM評審稽核提出明確的識別性警示。
papers.title: Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit
papers.title_zh: 受限評分量表上的雙重差分可能憑空製造效應：來自預註冊LLM評審稽核的證據

links.title: SPEAR: Distilling Domain-Adaptive Reasoning Skeletons via Sequential Symbolic Alignment in Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: SPEAR is a training-free, plug-and-play process reward using domain-adaptive symbolic milestones and LCS alignment for on-policy RL distillation, code at https://github.com/zhuochunli/SPEAR

Section 4.4, Table 1: SPEAR improves average accuracy by +1.58% to +2.01% over GRPO/Dr.GRPO/DAPO and consistently beats Logic-RL across Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B on GSM8K/MATH/GPQA/CommonsenseQA
Section 5.1, Table 2: SPEAR is within 1-2% of Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B on MATH and outperforms it on GPQA by avg 3.87% using only a ~12MB spaCy parser
Section 5.2, Table 3: ablations show removing accuracy reward drops MATH 30.00->25.40; raw-token LCS and Jaccard each cost ~2%; generic surface anchors cost 2.22% avg
Appendix G, Table 11: measured per-step slowdown 1.87% for SPEAR vs 30.04% for a 7B neural PRM on four A100-80GB GPUs

Appendix B, Tables 5-8 and Appendix I: full teacher/student hyperparameters (seed 731, LoRA r=8 on q_proj/v_proj), prompts, and API settings provided; Appendix H, Table 12 shows OOD anchor mismatch degrades gains, evidencing domain-specificity
Limitations section: exact subsequence matching may under-credit semantically equivalent alternative paths; rule-based parsing is sensitive to errors; only sequence-level distillation explored
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning-distillation work squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, RL training, efficiency): it distills DeepSeek-V3.2 reasoning into Llama-3-8B/Qwen3-4B via GRPO/Dr.GRPO/DAPO with a training-free symbolic process reward. Novelty is moderate: LCS rewards (Dong & Fan 2025) and rule-based process rewards (Logic-RL) exist; the contribution is the domain-adaptive anchor projection plus order-aware LCS-F1 combination. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: 2 students x 3 RL backbones x 4 benchmarks, plus PRM comparisons, ablations, cold-start SFT sweep, OOD-anchor and AlpacaEval transfer; however gains are small (+1.5-2.0% avg, Table 1), single seed (731), no variance/significance tests, LoRA-only RL, and GPQA diamond has only 198 test items. Evidence is backed by consistent numbers across tables and measured overhead (1.87% vs 30.04% slowdown), but no uncertainty quantification. Generalizability shown across domains and students but limited to English spaCy parsing and one teacher; authors concede exact subsequence matching can under-credit valid alternative paths. Reproducibility is strong: code/data URL, full hyperparameter tables, prompts, seeds, hardware, teacher API settings.

primary_link.title: SPEAR: Distilling Domain-Adaptive Reasoning Skeletons via Sequential Symbolic Alignment in Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning-based knowledge distillation has the potential to transfer complex reasoning from teacher to student models, yet it currently faces a critical dilemma: researchers must choose between sparse outcome-based rewards, which provide insufficient logical guidance, or expensive neural Process Reward Models (PRMs) for dense signals. We resolve this by introducing SPEAR (Symbolic Process Evaluation and Alignment Reward), a training-free and plug-and-play process reward method for s
papers.summary_zh: 蒸餾大型語言模型的推理能力時，現有強化學習方法面臨兩難：僅依賴稀疏的結果獎勵無法引導多步驟邏輯，而採用神經網路過程獎勵模型（PRM）則成本高昂。本文提出 SPEAR，一種免訓練、即插即用的過程獎勵方法。其核心是將自然語言推理軌跡投影為領域自適應的符號里程碑：數學任務抽取 LaTeX 表達式與變數賦值，科學任務利用依存句法解析得到動詞—受詞關係序列，常識任務則擷取名詞—動作狀態轉移。接著以最長共同子序列（LCS）計算 LCS-F1，對學生與教師的符號軌跡進行具順序感的對齊，並與格式閘門、答案正確性組成複合獎勵。在 GSM8K、MATH、GPQA、CommonsenseQA 上，以 DeepSeek-V3.2 為教師、Llama-3-8B 與 Qwen3-4B 為學生，SPEAR 在 GRPO、Dr. GRPO、DAPO 三種框架下平均提升約 1.6 至 2 個百分點，表現與 7B 級 PRM 相當，僅需約 12MB 的 spaCy 剖析器，每步時間開銷僅增加 1.87%。消融實驗證實格式閘門、正確性獎勵、推理權重 λ 與順序對齊缺一不可。限制在於精確符號匹配可能低估語義等價但結構不同的推理路徑，且仰賴規則抽取管線與教師軌跡品質。此研究展示免神經驗證器的密集過程監督確實可行，對高效蒸餾極具價值。
papers.title: SPEAR: Distilling Domain-Adaptive Reasoning Skeletons via Sequential Symbolic Alignment in Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: SPEAR：於強化學習中透過循序符號對齊蒸餾領域自適應推理骨架

links.title: Reason in the Words You Speak: Idiolectal Paraphrasing Off-Policy Traces for Reasoning Distillation in VideoLLMs

evidence: Sec 3.2 / Fig 2(a): Mixed-Policy GRPO clips a substantial fraction of training samples; semantically important tokens account for 71.8% of clipped tokens, and selective semantic unclipping raises the three-benchmark average from 35.9 to 52.0 (Table 1), isolating clipping as the failure driver.

Sec 4.2 / Table 2: VideoEcho-R1 reaches 57.2 average on Qwen3-VL-4B across five benchmarks vs GRPO 55.9, SFT→GRPO 54.0, and Mixed-Policy GRPO 39.5; results replicated on InternVL3.5-4B (52.7) and Qwen3-VL-8B (58.2).

Sec 4.4 / Table 4: rewriting-strategy ablation shows prompt-only student rewriting 56.0, semantic-reference-only 56.8, distributional-only 54.9, full DRD 58.2, supporting the dual-reference design; Appendix D.2/Table 7 shows top-k=5 optimal (k=10 drops to 53.4).
Appendix D.3 / Table 8: on text-only AIME24/25 and HMMT25 with Qwen3-4B, Echo-GRPO averages 41.1 vs GRPO 33.3 and Mixed-Policy 31.1, evidencing domain generalization beyond video.
Appendix E / Table 10: DRD costs 163.9 ms/token (17.5x single-pass) but only during offline trace construction; deployed inference unaffected.

Sec 4.1 and Appendix A: training uses 2.4K OneThinker-SFT-340K samples with Seed1.5-VL teacher, G=6 rollouts, k=5, lr 9e-7, EasyR1/LLaMAFactory/vLLM stack—reproducible in principle, though no code or data release is stated.

Appendix F.2: authors acknowledge preprocessing overhead, gains bounded by teacher quality, reduced benefit on fine-grained numerical tasks (VSI-Bench in Sec 4.2 where GRPO is superior), and possible pretraining-benchmark leakage.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A language-methodology paper (not out-of-scope video CV): it targets RL-based reasoning distillation for LLMs/VideoLLMs via GRPO, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, Reasoning & CoT, RL, Multimodal). Core contribution—diagnosing trust-region clipping on semantically critical tokens in mixed-policy GRPO and rewriting teacher traces into the student's 'idiolect' via Dual-Reference Decoding—is a genuine but incremental advance over LUFFY and Mixed-Policy GRPO. Rigor is solid: diagnostic clipping analysis, token-unclipping intervention (Table 1), three backbones x five benchmarks (Table 2), distillation-baseline comparison (Table 3), rewriting-strategy and top-k ablations (Tables 4, 7), scale-up (Table 9), and text-only math generalization (Table 8). Weaknesses: no variance/seeds or significance testing, small 2.4K training set, the dramatic Mixed-Policy collapse on Qwen3-VL-4B (39.5 vs 55.9 GRPO) partly softens at scale (51.7 vs 56.4 in Table 9), some key evidence lives in unquantified figures (Figs 2, 5-8), and VSI-Bench favors plain GRPO. Hyperparameters, frameworks, and prompts are documented but no code/data release is claimed.

primary_link.title: Reason in the Words You Speak: Idiolectal Paraphrasing Off-Policy Traces for Reasoning Distillation in VideoLLMs

papers.summary: Recent large language models achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, where reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a leading paradigm for optimizing models on self-generated trajectories. However, the on-policy nature of GRPO bounds the model to the reasoning skills it can already produce, restricting to learn more advanced capabilities. Prior works inject privileged reasoning traces from a stronger teacher policy to guide training, yet
papers.summary_zh: 以 GRPO 為基礎的混合策略訓練會將更強教師的特權推理軌跡混入取樣群組，但此類離策略軌跡與學生政策分佈落差巨大，導致信任區域裁剪壓制語義關鍵標記的梯度更新——模型雖答對卻學不到支撐答案的推理；實驗顯示被裁剪標記中 71.8% 屬語義重要詞彙。本文提出 Echo-GRPO，將教師軌跡改寫為學生自身的語體：透過雙參考解碼（DRD），以專家乘積結合語義參考（限制候選標記以忠於原軌跡）與分佈參考（確保標記落在政策原生分佈內），使改寫軌跡既保留語義又貼近學生分佈，進而穩定重要性取樣比率。實例化為 VideoEcho-R1 後，於 InternVL3.5-4B、Qwen3-VL-4B/8B 三種骨幹及 VideoMMMU、MMVU、Video Holmes、VSI-Bench、VideoMME 五項基準，平均優於純 GRPO、SFT 與 Mixed-Policy GRPO；消融顯示僅解除語義標記裁剪即可提升 16.1 點，DRD 在 k=5 時最佳。改寫亦可作為外掛模組提升 RL w/ SFT 與 LUFFY，並同樣改善 SFT 目標與純文字數學推理。限制包括 DRD 於離線資料建構有 17.5 倍逐標記運算開銷、品質受教師上限約束，以及在重視精確數值估計的 VSI-Bench 上增益較小。其貢獻在於指出並修補離策略蒸餾的根本失敗模式。
papers.title: Reason in the Words You Speak: Idiolectal Paraphrasing Off-Policy Traces for Reasoning Distillation in VideoLLMs
papers.title_zh: Echo-GRPO：以你口中的話語推理——VideoLLM 推理蒸餾中以個人語體改寫離策略軌跡

links.title: Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration with Ledger-Based Control for Improved LLM Coding Performance

evidence: Abstract: nine models on the 100 latest hard LiveCodeBench problems; scaffold benefit 'real but conditional' — Qwen3.8-27B +23.4, GPT-5.6-Luna +10.6, GPT-5.6-Terra +8.0 over five paired passes at p<10^-4, but Qwen3.6-35B −1 to −9 with reasoning off.
§2.1/Table 2: per-problem McNemar agreement (Qwen3.8-27B manager-only 125 vs single-only 8, p=4×10^-28; Luna 71/18, p=1×10^-8), supporting that gains are not single-pass artifacts.

§2.2/Table 3-4: manager roughly triples token bill (Qwen3.8-27B $20.44→$51.75/pass, +153%); GPT-5.6-Terra+manager 85.0 vs Fable 5 87.4 (p=0.59) at $11.71 vs $61.11 per pass (p<10^-4) — the cost-frontier claim is quantified and arithmetically consistent with stated rates.

§3.2 'Statistics': paired sign-flip permutation tests (2×10^5 resamples, problem as unit, n=100), Holm correction, 95% t-intervals across five passes, exact McNemar on pooled discordants — appropriate and clearly specified.

§3.3: evaluator defect documented (stateless mock binary readline()); replaced with a BytesIO-backed view, all stored generations re-scored without re-running models; 311/3,456 §2.1 outputs used the affected idiom, 97% previously scored wrong.

§3.1: scaffold fully specified (workspace files, 10-round budget, verifier step, cut-off summarizer, temperatures 0.2–0.4); however prompts are described only in prose ('short generic prompt') and no code or artifact availability is claimed anywhere in the document.

§4.5 Limitations: OpenRouter routing a 'substantial and time-varying confound' for §2.4; Opus-5 85→91 is a single-pass point estimate that 'warrants replication'; 'One benchmark family' — all results are competitive-programming code generation; math/knowledge benchmarks dropped as at/near ceiling.

Title page: broken footnote markers, empty affiliation fields, 'Persis Capital Inc.' industry thanks, and 2026-dated model/pricing citations (GPT-5.6 Terra/Luna, Claude Fable 5, Qwen3.8-27B, Kimi-K3 ~2.8T) that cannot be externally verified; internally consistent but unverifiable claims cap evidence strength.

§4.4: honest regression analysis (Qwen3.6-35B LCB 3765 scaffold talks itself out of a correct O(n^2) CHT solution into a wrong O(n^3) DP), with two concrete training-free mitigation proposals — a rigor positive.

§2.4 vs §2.1: OpenRouter set uses the original scaffold (4 rounds, no verifier, one pass for most conditions) and is correctly kept separate from the pinned-backend five-pass v2 headline results, avoiding improper pooling.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled empirical study of a training-free manager-worker scaffold vs. single-call baselines for LLM code generation, squarely on-topic for LLM agents, coding, and test-time compute (high preference relevance). Methodologically careful: five paired passes, sign-flip permutation tests with Holm correction, exact McNemar agreement tables (§2.1, Table 2), a cap-matching replay procedure (§3.2), cost accounting that is internally arithmetically consistent (Table 3), and an unusually honest limitations section (§4.5), including discovery and correction of a LiveCodeBench evaluator bug (§3.3). Novelty is modest: shared-workspace manager-worker orchestration recombines known ideas (MetaGPT, AutoGen, blackboard systems, budget-controlled comparisons), and the paper itself positions the design between existing families; the main contribution is the disciplined conditional-gain measurement and cost-accuracy frontier. Key weaknesses: a single benchmark family (100 hard LiveCodeBench problems only, with a thin ceiling excuse for math/GPQA probes), mixed scaffold versions and serving paths across model sets, headline Opus-5 91% result being single-pass, Fable 5 lacking a manager arm, cherry-pickable one-per-model transcript case studies, no code/prompt artifact release, and an unverifiable external ecosystem (future-dated models, pricing pages, garbled author block with 'Persis Capital Inc.' affiliation) that prevents external validation despite strong internal consistency. Conditional, model-dependent effects (negative for Qwen3.6-35B reasoning-off) further limit generalizability. Solid empirical work, calibrated at ~0.72.

primary_link.title: Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration with Ledger-Based Control for Improved LLM Coding Performance

papers.summary: Multi-agent large language model systems are widely reported to beat single-model baselines, but the evidence is mixed, and comparisons are usually confounded: pipelines change token budgets, tool calls, and prompts simultaneously, so an aggregate gain rarely reveals what actually helped. We investigate the effect of introducing the manager-worker scaffold over a shared filesystem workspace, with no training and no per-benchmark tuning, measured against the same model answering in a single pass.
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統常被宣稱優於單一模型，但證據混雜且比較往往同時改動多項變因。本文在固定模型與題庫下，檢驗一個不需訓練、不針對基準調校的管理者—工作者架構：管理者於共享檔案系統工作區（計畫、任務清單、筆記、現行解法）上規劃、派發單一任務、以樣本測試驗證並迭代，每個角色皆為同一模型的全新情境呼叫。在 LiveCodeBench 最難的 100 題上，三個固定後端模型經五次配對測試均顯著受益：Qwen3.8-27B +23.4（達 86.4%，媲美頂級閉源模型）、GPT-5.6-Luna +10.6、GPT-5.6-Terra +8.0；關閉推理時 Kimi-K3 +30.4、Minimax-M3 +11.0，Opus-5 由 85 升至 91。但效益有條件：Qwen3.6-35B 反而下降 1 至 9 點。成本上管理者約使帳單增至三倍，卻常比改用更大模型划算——GPT-5.6-Terra 加管理者以 85.0 分逼近 Fable 5 的 87.4（p=0.59），費用僅 11.71 美元對 61.11 美元。逐字稿分析歸納出脈絡管理、問題分解與截斷救援等機制，也記錄深思反致倒退的案例，並揭露且修正 LiveCodeBench 評測器的 readline 缺陷。整體而言，本文為零樣本自我編排的價值與局限提供了乾淨基線。
papers.title: Zero-Shot Self-Orchestration with Ledger-Based Control for Improved LLM Coding Performance

links.title: JudgeStealer: Extracting LLM Judging Capabilities across Evaluation Protocols

Section 5.1: victims GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Qwen3-235B-A22B, DeepSeek V4 Pro, UniRRM; surrogates Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Qwen3-1.7B; baselines Vanilla, LoRD, Lion, Proxy-KD

Novelty is moderate: the cross-protocol agreement exploitation (pointwise→pairwise/listwise reuse) is a genuine, empirically grounded insight (Section 4.1 reports 88.7-95.0% agreement), but the component techniques (active-learning-style selection, Gaussian label smoothing, joint fine-tuning to prevent forgetting) are standard combinations. primary_link.title: JudgeStealer: Extracting LLM Judging Capabilities across Evaluation Protocols

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used across various evaluation scenarios, making their judgment capabilities valuable intellectual property. However, black-box access exposes these capabilities to model extraction attacks. Existing extraction methods do not specifically target LLM judges and provide limited support for multiple evaluation protocols under restricted query budgets. In this study, we propose JUDGESTEALER, the first query-efficient model extraction framework for r
papers.summary_zh: LLM 評審與獎勵模型的評判能力是寶貴的智慧財產，但黑箱 API 存取使其易受模型萃取攻擊；現有萃取研究未針對評審功能，也缺乏在有限查詢預算下支援多種評估協定的方法。本文提出 JudgeStealer，首個涵蓋逐點評分、成對比較與列表排序的查詢高效萃取框架。其洞察是能力強的評審在三種協定間高度一致（平均約 88% 至 95%），故只需取得最細粒度的逐點分數，即可轉換為成對與列表監督而不增加受害者查詢。為提升效率，框架動態選取兼具語義多樣性、預測不確定性與評審偏誤（冗長、位置偏誤）的輸入；訓練採可調式高斯平滑以保留分數的序數結構，並以多協定整併對抗災難性遺忘。在 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Qwen3-235B-A22B、DeepSeek V4 Pro 與 UniRRM 等受害者上，1B 級代理模型最高達逐點 73.3%、成對 87.0%、列表 71.6% 的準確率，於 480 項指標比較中 475 項超越 Vanilla、Lion、LoRD、Proxy-KD；對代理規模（0.6B 至 32B）、LoRA 與全量微調、CoT 設定均有效，並能避開異常偵測、抗蒸餾擾動與浮水印追蹤等防禦。此研究凸顯評審服務的智慧財產與安全防護亟待強化，作者亦承諾僅釋出可於開源模型重現的成果以降低濫用風險。

papers.title_zh: JudgeStealer：跨評估協定萃取 LLM 評審能力

Section 6.1 / Table 3: 'Temporal relationships prove most challenging, deteriorating from F1 0.142–0.470 (S) to 0.062–0.173 (XL)'.
Section 6: 'We specifically select “lighter” models to strike a balance between performance and cost given evaluating a model on the full 263,466 document set in CB can incur significant API costs.'

Footnote 1 / Abstract: 'We release data and code at https://huggingface.co/datasets/epiq-ai-labs/corporatebench'; generation pipeline, prompts, and ETL described in Sections 3, Appendices E, P, Q.
Section 6.2: 'Integrated QA exhibits a different pattern: performance slightly improves with scale for both methods' — an honest caveat against uniform scale-degradation claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM benchmark paper squarely on-topic: it evaluates five recent LLMs (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5 Nano, GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite) with tool-using agents over RAG and SQL-based KB access on enterprise QA/extraction tasks, making it highly relevant to LLM, agent/tool-use, RAG, and evaluation preferences. Novelty is moderate: KB-grounded synthetic corpus generation exists (Agarwal et al. 2021, PhantomWiki), and the contribution is mainly scaling the approach to ~263k documents with temporal consistency and deterministic SPARQL-derived labels. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: controlled question counts, TF-IDF baseline, detailed error analysis (Table 14), but QA was a single run, only 'lighter' models were evaluated for cost (Section 6), RAG is fixed at k=10 without ablation, and human validation covers only 100 of 263,466 documents with a mediocre 76.2% agreement rate (Section 4). Evidence strength is moderate-to-good: reported numbers in Tables 3/4/13/14 support the headline claims (e.g., KB-RAG gap widening 0.24 to 0.37; temporal extraction F1 degrading to 0.062-0.173 at XL), and the paper honestly notes Integrated QA improves with scale, contradicting a blanket degradation claim. Generalizability is limited: synthetic Haiku-generated emails over one quarter are explicitly framed as a 'lower bound' (Limitations), so absolute numbers may not transfer to human-written corpora. Reproducibility is strong: public data/code release (footnote 1), prompts in Appendices P-Q, full experimental setup in Appendix K (temperature, tool-call limit of 5, pgvector/text-embedding-3-small, ETL details in Appendix E).

primary_link.title: CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases

papers.summary: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information e
papers.summary_zh: 本論文發表CorporateBench，一個針對企業規模文件集合的問答基準，旨在解決現有合成資料集過於簡化、真實企業資料受限於保密協議而稀缺的問題。作者提出一套從時間演進的知識庫（KB）生成文件管線：先以OWL本體定義公司結構（員工、團隊、部門、專案、任務），模擬一季（90天）的任務指派與六種會議型態，再以Claude Haiku 4.5填充產生電子郵件，並嵌入「證據字串」確保每份文件可追溯到知識庫中的關係三元組，從而保證跨文件邏輯一致性。四家合成公司規模從12人到10,210人，總計263,466份文件，單一公司最大達232,693份。基準涵蓋五項任務，分屬抽取（KB抽取、主題分類）與問答（KB QA、主題QA、整合QA）兩類，答案由SPARQL查詢知識庫直接計算，確保可重現評估。評測五個模型顯示：實體抽取F1在0.715至0.824間相對穩定，但關係抽取隨規模擴大明顯衰退，時間性關係最為困難（XL規模F1僅0.062至0.173）；RAG在KB QA上比直接SQL查詢知識庫的差距隨規模擴大，從S規模的0.24增至XL的0.37，顯示RAG在真實企業規模下難以正確浮現知識。限制包括僅模擬電子郵件、90天時間窗、以及LLM生成文件可能引入風格偏誤。此基準填補了企業通訊網路推理評測的缺口，對評估LLM在部署於企業環境時的實際能力具有參考價值。

links.title: Do User-Authored Permission Policies Improve Protection Against AI Agent Overreach?

evidence: Abstract: POLICY blocked less overreach than HITL (−20.1 pp, 95% CI [−32.1, −8.1]) and AUTO (−14.5 pp, 95% CI [−25.8, −3.2]) while required-action completion remained high.
§8.4: POLICY participants chose ask for 114 of 140 rules (81.4%); only 26 rules settled a decision in advance (10 allow, 16 never).
§8.5: Of 148 executed POLICY overreach actions, 133 followed runtime human approval and 15 ran automatically under allow rules; alluvial breakdown in Figure 5(b).

§7.7: 'The study was preregistered on OSF before confirmatory data collection'; preregistered outcomes, exclusions, model families, and Holm correction followed; non-inferiority margin not preregistered.
§4.2: 538-tool corpus from 36 MCP servers, 120-tool human-labeled evaluation set, three annotators, Krippendorff's α=.88 (action type) and Fleiss' κ=.89 (sensitivity/externality).

§6.1: Frozen mapper on 100 unseen tools achieved 69.0% exact-set and 90.0% main-action agreement; Table 1 shows prompted LLM beats keyword (43.3%), OAuth-scope (16.7%), and embedding (43.3%) exact-set baselines.
§7.3: 'Recruitment was later extended with POLICY-only assignment'; §A.3 sensitivity analysis on the initial randomized sample (n=94) shows a similar POLICY-vs-HITL gap of −25.0 pp.
§7.4: 'the study received no formal ethics review or exemption determination' — an acknowledged governance limitation.

§9.6: Limitations include one scripted simulated day with no real-world consequences, four coarse categories confounding the design comparison, exploratory pathway analyses, and a mapper that 'should support, rather than replace, deterministic enforcement'.
§5.1 and §7.8: claude-sonnet-5 used as the tool-classification mapper and offline AUTO gate; artifact retains prompts, model records, deidentified participant records, and analysis code.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match to the Agents & Tool Use (weight 2.5) and AI Safety (weight 2.0) preferences: the paper studies permission enforcement for LLM agents via an MCP proxy, tool-calling consequence categories, agent overreach, and human control, with LLMs as functional components (claude-sonnet-5 classifier and AUTO gate) rather than as the object of study. Research quality is solid: OSF preregistration (§7.7), 113-participant three-condition between-subjects design, Bayesian and frequentist models with Holm correction (Appendix A), human reference labels with high agreement (α=.88, κ=.89, §4.2), mapper baselines including keyword/OAuth-scope/embedding comparisons (Table 1), a held-out evaluation (§6.1), and a sensitivity analysis on the POLICY-only recruitment top-up (§A.3). The counterintuitive finding (ask dominates authored rules, 114/140, §8.4; most executed overreach followed runtime approval, 133/148, §8.5) is well supported within the tested design. Limitations cap the score: a single scripted 18-action simulated day with no real stakes, four coarse categories confounding design comparison (§9.6), key mechanism analyses exploratory, no non-inferiority margin, no formal ethics review (§7.4), and only the POLICY-vs-HITL difference surviving multiple-comparison correction. Novelty is moderate since the authors concede reusable rules and model review already exist in deployed systems (§3.1); the contribution is the comparative behavioral evidence and the preference-vs-commitment framing. Reproducibility is strong: anonymous artifact with proxy code, prompts, codebook, labels, deidentified records, analysis code, and released study app.

primary_link.title: Do User-Authored Permission Policies Improve Protection Against AI Agent Overreach?

papers.summary: AI agents are poised to become a primary interface to digital products, acting across email, files, payments, and personal data. People without professional software backgrounds need understandable, reusable ways to control actions across services. We examine a mechanism in which a language model maps actions to plain-language consequence categories with user-authored "allow", "ask", or "never" rules. We ask what is gained and lost when decisions are made in advance as reusable rules rather than
papers.summary_zh: 本論文以113位無專業軟體背景的參與者進行受試者間實驗，比較三種AI代理權限設計：逐動作人工核准（HITL）、模型自動審查（AUTO）、以及使用者預先撰寫的後果類別政策（POLICY）。後果類別包括花錢、傳送或發布資訊、刪除、存取私人資訊四類，使用者可為每類設定allow、ask或never規則。所有參與者監督同一個18動作的模擬一天，其中7個屬於超出任務授權的過度擴權動作。結果顯示POLICY的過度擴權阻擋率比HITL低20.1個百分點（95% CI [−32.1, −8.1]），比AUTO低14.5個百分點，而必要任務完成率在三種設計下均維持94%以上。POLICY將執行時提示從18.0降至10.9次，但計入規則設定時間後總干預時間並未可靠降低。探索性分析揭示關鍵現象：140條自訂規則中有114條（81.4%）選擇ask，將大多數決策退回執行時；在POLICY執行的148個過度擴權動作中，133個經使用者執行時核准，僅15個由allow規則自動執行。這暴露了偏好表達與規則承諾之間的落差：反覆選擇ask保留了個案裁量權，卻使預設規則無法事先定案。論文貢獻包括一個MCP代理（proxy）與120個工具的人類標註評測集，顯示後果層級規則可連結至工具執行，但分類器尚不足以單獨作為安全邊界。作者主張權限不僅是偏好蒐集問題，更是承諾設計問題，介面應清楚呈現規則事先決定了什麼、又留給使用者什麼。

links.title: Video-FLAIR: Not Whether to Reason, But How

evidence: Section 5, Table 1: Video-FLAIR on Qwen2.5-VL reports 73.8 on MathVista (+5.4 over base 68.4) at 74 avg tokens, vs 342-411 tokens for always-thinking baselines Video-R1/R2/VideoRFT reproduced by the authors.

Section 5.2, Tables 3-5: ablations show three-mode rollout structure beats binary (EMMA 27.3 vs 24.4), removing R_select or R_verifier degrades EMMA to 24.9/25.7, and no forced mode Pareto-dominates adaptive selection (e.g., <deep> costs 963 tokens on MMMU).

Appendix E and E.5.1: full mathematical reward definitions with weights, plus worked cost-pressure case analysis showing ALP relaxes penalties on hard queries; Appendix Table 11 lists all hyperparameters with directional sensitivity notes.
Appendix K: authors acknowledge verifier calibration drift and backbone-affinity bias when policy and verifier share Qwen3-VL, citing consistent Qwen2.5-VL gains as partial mitigation.
Appendix C and Figures 13-17: complete training algorithm and all prompt templates are provided, but the paper contains no code or model release statement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal LLM reasoning paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (Reasoning/CoT, RL, alignment/DPO, efficiency) but not text-LLM, agent, or Japanese NLP topics. It extends binary think/no-think routing (AdaptThink, Video-Auto-R1) to a three-mode space with within-query mode comparison, an incremental-but-genuine step beyond cited prior work. Rigor is strong: two base models, 11 benchmarks, reproduced baselines, extensive component ablations and hyperparameter sweeps, plus failure-mode and limitations sections. Evidence is internally consistent (abstract deltas match Tables 1-2; token averaging 95 vs 417 checks out), though results are single-run without significance testing and rely on a same-family VLM verifier whose circularity is acknowledged but not fully resolved. Detailed prompts, rewards, and hyperparameters aid reproduction, but no code or checkpoint release is stated.

primary_link.title: Video-FLAIR: Not Whether to Reason, But How

papers.summary: Multimodal queries can require different types of reasoning. Some can be answered via perceptual reasoning, extracting information directly from the visual signal, while others require compositional reasoning that combines observations or deliberative reasoning that evaluates competing hypotheses. However, many existing methods apply a uniform reasoning strategy across queries, leading to unnecessary computation on simple tasks and insufficient reasoning on complex ones. We introduce Video-FLAIR
papers.summary_zh: 本論文指出多模態LLM常以單一推理策略處理所有查詢，導致簡單任務浪費運算（ token 用量可達所需的20倍）並引發幻覺，複雜任務卻推理不足。作者提出Video-FLAIR訓練框架，以強化學習讓模型學會依查詢複雜度在三種推理模式中選擇：Percept（<direct>，直接從視覺證據擷取答案）、Compose（<concise>，線性串連多個觀察）、Deliberate（<deep>，檢驗並排除競爭假設的深度推理）。訓練時，每個提示產生K=8個模式結構化rollout：六個受控槽位各強制兩種模式，兩個自適應槽位由模型自行選擇。複合獎勵綜合正確性、格式、模式遵從、成本（含自適應長度懲罰ALP）、模式平衡、選擇監督與驗證器回饋，其中Qwen3-VL作為線上驗證器提供時間與空間接地分數，並定期以DPO刷新避免漂移。效用函數結合準確率、接地與成本，選出最適模式並監督自適應槽位；再透過GDPO各元件獨立正規化與DAPO更新策略，並以token級信用分配放大證據跨度梯度。在Qwen2.5-VL與Qwen3-VL兩個骨幹上，Video-FLAIR相較基線在MathVista提升+5.4、Video-Holmes與Video-MMMU各+4.8，平均token用量僅95（對照always-thinking基線的417），且在六個影像與五個影片基準上多數取得最佳成績。消融實驗確認三種槽位類型、選擇獎勵、驗證器回饋與三模式空間缺一不可；二模式切換版本效能下滑證明區分組合式與深思式推理有其必要。限制包括驗證器校準可能漂移，以及模式空間對本質單層任務可能浪費運算。此工作將推理適應性從二元開關推進到多模式選擇，兼顧準確率與效率。

links.title: When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'SARA limits ASR to no more than 0.63% across four primary evaluation settings while maintaining competitive task utility, and consistently reduces ASR across additional Agent backbones' — headline claim matched by Table 1 numbers (ASR 0.06/0.17% GPT-4o-mini; 0.62/0.63% Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite).

Section 2.2 Threat Model: trusts 'the user request U, the tool schema T, the SARA runtime, and the real tool executor'; scope explicitly excludes direct runtime bypass and unconditional delegation, stated in Section 6 Limitations.

Section 5 Baselines: ten comparisons 'covering input filtering, execution-structure constraints, action attribution, and execution-boundary control,' with 'method-specific defense mechanisms configured according to their official implementations.'

Table 3 (Section 5.3): ablations w/o AIT raise ASR to 3.37%/3.02%, w/o PSG to 2.49%/2.73%, w/o NHP to 0.65%/0.75%, while w/o AE lowers ASR but drops UA ~10-13 points — results are consistent with each mechanism's claimed role.

Table 4 (Section 5.4): SARA total input 25.86K (1.91× Agent-only) on AgentDojo and 43.61K (2.21×) on AgentDyn, with cost decomposed into guard authorization analysis and Agent replanning after rejection.

Section 5.2 and Table 2: honest reporting that Llama3.1-8B retains 1.64%/1.75% ASR and that BU on AgentDyn drops 13.24/12.06 points for Llama3.3-70B/Qwen3-32B, with utility attributed to backbone recovery capability via tool_error rates (19%-35% for Llama3.1-8B).

Reproducibility gap: no code, prompt, or configuration release is mentioned anywhere in the paper, and the underlying model for the context-isolated Action Probe (Section 4.3, 'Probe(O_t, T)') and support-classification functions (Section 4.4) is unspecified; UA/ASR lack reported variance despite only 92/141 benign tasks for BU.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-fit paper on tool-augmented LLM agent security: it targets indirect prompt injection that turns tool Observations into unauthorized tool executions, directly matching the highest-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Prompting & In-Context Learning). The conceptual contribution—separating action induction from execution authorization, with persistent action-origin tracking (Ft) distinct from audited execution evidence (Ht) and a No-History-Promotion rule against provenance laundering—is well-motivated and cleanly formalized, but it is an incremental refinement in a crowded runtime-authorization space (CaMeL, RTBAS, PACT, AIRGuard, ClawGuard, AuthGraph are all positioned as close predecessors), so novelty is moderate. Rigor is solid: formal problem definition and threat model (Section 2), two benchmarks with 3,528 and 5,202 attack instances and four attack formulations (Section 5), ten baselines spanning four defense categories, four-component ablations (Table 3), six backbones (Table 2), and a token/call cost decomposition (Table 4). Weaknesses: no variance or significance testing (BU is 3-run averaged but UA/ASR appear single-run, and benign sets are small at 92/141 tasks), the model implementing the Action Probe and authorization functions is never specified, and several key baselines are concurrent preprints. Evidence is internally consistent and honestly reported (e.g., CaMeL achieves lower ASR in three of four settings; residual 1.64%/1.75% ASR for Llama3.1-8B explained via tool_error rates in Section 5.2), but results are limited to two tool-IPI benchmarks and cannot be independently checked. Generalizability is decent across backbones and attack templates but confined to the stated threat model with trusted user request, tool schema, and runtime; the authors themselves scope this out in Section 6. Reproducibility is weak: no code or prompt release is mentioned anywhere, and guard implementation details are missing. Overall a strong, on-topic agent-security paper with careful evaluation but limited novelty, no availability artifacts, and narrow threat scope.

primary_link.title: When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
