We argue that this risk arises from conflating action induction with execution authorization. To address this distinction, we propose SARA, which treats action induction and execution authorization as distinc
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討間接提示注入（IPI）在工具增強代理中的結構性風險：當工具輸出不僅提供資料、而開始指定具體動作時，便可能驅動超出使用者意圖的真實副作用。作者主張此風險源自將「動作誘導」與「執行授權」混為一談，並提出SARA框架將兩者分離。核心原則是：觀察內容可影響候選動作的形成並提供執行既有任務所需的執行時資訊，但動作誘導本身不能賦予執行權限。在觀察側，情境隔離的Action Probe偵測輸出是否具有可映射至工具介面的動作誘導語義，將軌跡標記為EXPOSED並跨步驟持久保留動作來源F_t；在執行側，具真實副作用的候選呼叫需依使用者授權根K、持久動作來源F_t、以及僅由已核准且成功執行的互動累積之審計證據H_t，進行目標層、執行鏈層與引數層三重授權審查。No-History-Promotion機制防止同一引數值僅因歷史重現就將既有動作來源洗白為執行權限。在AgentDojo與AgentDyn基準上，以GPT-4o-mini與Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite為主幹，SARA在四個主要設定中將攻擊成功率（ASR）壓至0.06%至0.63%，同時UA不低於未防護基線，且相較CaMeL等強隔離方法，良性效用（BU）損失僅5.79至11.82個百分點。跨八個開放權重主幹的評測顯示安全性增益一致，而效用較依賴主幹自身的規劃與恢復能力。消融實驗確認AIT、PSG、NHP主要維護安全邊界，AE則防止審查退化為一律拒絕。限制包括語義判斷可能有誤判、以及不處理繞過授權執行時的直接攻擊。此工作對動態任務中兼顧安全與可用性的執行邊界控制提供了具系統性的設計方向。

links.title: Do LLMs Understand Personality? Rethinking Persona Fidelity Evaluation through Structured Behavioral Inference

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: PRISM reformulates persona fidelity evaluation as structured inverse inference over Task Framing, Interpersonal Stance, and Linguistic Style with an Aligned/Indeterminate/Contradictory label space.

Section 4.4 (Table 2): on Social-Persona, PRISM with Qwen improves P-AUC from 84.34 to 91.08 and G-Acc from 49.32 to 78.78 over Vanilla; on Big5-Persona-HARD, PRISM-Qwen G-Acc 68.20 vs GPT-5.4 CoT 46.60.
Section 5.1 (Figures 4-5, 16-18): stability analysis across backbones, 5- vs 7-point rubrics, and temperatures {0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0} averaged over three runs.
Appendix D.1-D.2 (Tables 6-7): human verification on 150 contrastive groups and 450 responses with Krippendorff's alpha 0.56-0.69 and dimension-level Top-1 Acc 63.3-75.3 using the Llama backbone.
Limitations section: PRISM requires token-level log-probabilities, restricting it to open-source evaluators; work is diagnostic only, not integrated into generation or RLHF.

Section 4.1 (Table 1) and Appendix A: three benchmarks (Big5-Persona-EASY 200K, Big5-Persona-HARD 300K, Social-Persona 2.9K) derived from Big5-CHAT and SocialBench with controlled hard negatives; experiments sample 2,000-3,000 instances.
Section 1 footnote: code and data released at https://github.com/CGCL-codes/prism-persona; Appendix B.1-B.2 document vLLM setup, deterministic decoding, and full prompt templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A clearly in-scope LLM evaluation-methodology paper: it studies LLM-as-a-judge reliability for persona fidelity in role-playing dialogue and proposes PRISM, a structured inverse-inference evaluator over three SFL-derived dimensions using log-probability posteriors. Preference relevance is strong for LLMs, evaluation/benchmarking, prompting, and NLP/dialogue, but it is not Japanese, agentic-tool, reasoning, or RAG work. Novelty is moderate: dimension-wise judge decomposition and verbalized-label scoring echo prior calibration/decomposed-judging practice; the SFL grounding and persona-conditioned three-way label spaces plus hard-negative benchmark construction are the freshest parts. Rigor is solid but not airtight: three open-source backbones plus three closed-source reference judges, specialized judge baselines (Selene, PandaLM, AlignScore), precisely defined AUC/P-AUC/G-Acc, rubric/temperature/backbone sensitivity analyses, and two human studies; however, human validation is small (50 groups per benchmark, 3 NLP-graduate annotators, shared across studies), no significance testing on the main table, and label spaces appear manually instantiated per persona. Evidence strength is good: claimed gains are matched by Table 2 numbers (e.g., Llama G-Acc 3.90 -> 60.30 on Big5-Persona-HARD; PRISM-Qwen G-Acc 68.20 vs GPT-5.4 CoT 46.60), and stability/score-distribution analyses back the 'holistic appraisal hallucination' argument. Generalizability is capped by English-only Big Five/character benchmarks, per-persona label design, and the acknowledged requirement of logit access (Limitations), which excludes closed-source evaluators. Reproducibility is above average: public code/data link, full prompt templates (Appendix B.2), label-space construction (B.3), and hardware/decoding details (B.1).

primary_link.title: Do LLMs Understand Personality? Rethinking Persona Fidelity Evaluation through Structured Behavioral Inference

papers.summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed to simulate diverse human characters, ensuring persona fidelity, defined as the extent to which an agent's behavior consistently reflects the psychological and stylistic characteristics of a target persona, has become a critical requirement. However, existing evaluation paradigms primarily rely on either holistic LLM-based judges, which are prone to "holistic appraisal hallucination'', or static psychometric inventories, which fail to capture th
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益被用來扮演各式人物角色,如何評估其行為是否忠實反映目標人格(persona fidelity)成為關鍵課題。現有評估主要有兩種:整體式 LLM 評審容易產生「整體評價幻覺」,高估流暢但偏離角色的回應;而心理測量量表(如 Big Five)多採靜態訪談,難以捕捉動態對話中脈絡相依的一致性。本文提出 PRISM,以系統功能語言學(SFL)為基礎,將人格忠實度評估轉化為結構化逆向推論任務:把行為拆解為任務框架、人際立場與語言風格三個功能維度,在人格條件化的標籤空間上估計後驗分布,再聚合為可解釋、可稽核的評分。作者並建構 Big5-Persona-EASY/HARD 與 Social-Persona 三個診斷基準,引入語境合理但違反人格的困難負例。實驗顯示,PRISM 在 Pair-AUC 與嚴格分組準確率上一致超越整體評審,對評測骨幹、評分尺度與解碼溫度的變動也更穩定;Qwen 搭配 PRISM 在最難基準上的 G-Acc(68.2)甚至勝過 GPT-5.4 搭配 CoT。限制包括理論框架並非唯一、需存取模型內部 logits,且僅止於評估而非改善生成。此研究為角色扮演代理提供更可靠、可診斷的一致性評估框架。

links.title: Performance Foundations of Parallel & Distributed Reasoning Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'systematize the RL-for-LLM paradigm and provide a compute-centric analysis of prominent post-training algorithmic frameworks: PPO, GRPO, as well as their variants' plus taxonomy of intra-/inter-model parallelism
Section II-E, Table IV: asymptotic work, depth, memory for PPO/GRPO/DPO; identifies autoregressive generation depth D_gen = O(T * D_f) as the irreducible online bottleneck

Section III-G: Tables V-VIII give per-rank and global complexities for DP/PP/TP/CP/EP/3D/5D under explicitly idealized assumptions ('not hardware-calibrated throughput predictions'; communication excluded)

Section IV-C: quotes RLHFuse improving throughput 'up to 3.7x' via stage fusion [282] and Section III-B1 quotes OpenRLHF reporting >90% wall-clock in rollout/forward assessment [117] and AMD MI300X 2.3-4.3x rollout gains without TP [263] - all secondhand, no independent experiments
Section IV-F, Table IX: rigorous inter-model analysis showing most techniques reduce depth not work, with shared actor-critic as the main work-reducing exception
Section VI-B, Table XI: catalogs documented intra-/inter-model parallelism support across public frameworks (TRL, ColossalChat, OpenRLHF, verl, NeMo RL, ReaL, RLHFuse, AReaL, StreamRL, etc.)
Section VII: outlines open research directions (resource-aware test-time compute, automatic parallelization selection, shared-weight RLHF) as proposals rather than results
Section I-B: formal work-depth model adopted with memory definition; Appendix B provides full derivations supporting the tables, but no code or artifact release is claimed
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems/performance survey of reasoning-LLM (RLVR/PPO/GRPO/DPO) training, squarely matching top-weighted preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, alignment-RLHF, scaling/efficiency, inference serving). Its work-depth-memory derivations and inter-model parallelism taxonomy (placement, stage fusion, hybrid layouts, bounded asynchrony) are careful and architecture-portable, but the contribution is systematization rather than new methods: no own experiments, throughput figures (RLHFuse 3.7x, OpenRLHF >90% rollout time) are secondhand citations, and the analysis is explicitly idealized (communication and scheduling excluded). Some Table X entries (GPT-5.4/5.5, Kimi K2.5) and citation details are unverifiable from the document, tempering evidence strength. High domain generalizability; reproducible analytically via appendix derivations but no released artifacts.

The resulting recent Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) such as DeepSeek-R1, o3, and Kimi k1.5 show that such RL-style post-training ("RL-for-LLMs") can substantially improve chain-of-thought reasoning, long-horizon planning, and self-correction. However, the computational footprint of these systems is massive: state-of-
papers.summary_zh: RLVR 等強化學習後訓練典範造就了 DeepSeek-R1、o3 等推理語言模型(RLM),其訓練動輒耗費數百萬 GPU 時數,並緊密耦合多個大型模型與階段,使 RLM 訓練本質上成為平行與分散式系統問題。本文首先系統化 RL-for-LLM 典範,對 PPO、GRPO、DPO 及其變體進行以運算為核心的分析,釐清各方法所需輔助模型(策略、獎勵、價值、參考)的計算輪廓;接著以 work–depth 模型建立嚴謹的複雜度分析,並提出涵蓋模型內平行(資料、張量、管線、序列、脈絡、專家平行)與模型間平行(模型結構設定、放置策略、階段融合、混合執行、非同步執行)的分類法。分析指出自迴歸生成交不可壓縮的逐 token 依賴,是線上訓練的主要瓶頸;多數模型間技術降低的是深度而非總運算量,凍結模型適合複製為推論服務,可訓練模型則需 ZeRO/FSDP 式切分。文章進一步以同一分類法檢視 OpenRLHF、ReaL、RLHFuse、verl 等框架,歸納實務準則,並指出資源感知的測試時運算、自動平行化選擇、非同步與陳舊資料 RL 等研究方向,為建構可擴充且具成本效益的 RLM 提供統一的效能詞彙與設計地圖。

links.title: SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance

evidence: Abstract: 'training on the 10% trajectory subset selected by SWE-Prime outperforms training on the full resolved dataset, yielding relative performance gains of up to 12.2% and 24.2%'
Experimental Setup > Training Data: 'SWE-rebench OpenHands Trajectories dataset... 67,074 trajectories... 32,161 trajectories successfully resolve their corresponding issues' as the candidate pool

Table 1 (Main results): GLM-4.7-Flash SWE-Prime 51.4 vs Resolved-Trajectory SFT 41.4 and Random-10% 39.6 on SWE-Bench Verified; Qwen3-Coder 53.2 vs 51.0; 'w/o Stage 2' rows consistently lower (e.g., 34.6 vs 39.6 for Qwen3-30B)

RQ2 Hyperparameter Analysis: retention sweep peaks at 10% (50.2%) and segment threshold sweep peaks at 7 (53.2%), both measured on Qwen3-Coder-30B on SWE-Bench Verified per Figure 4 caption, then 'frozen and applied to all experiments reported in RQ1'

Stage 2 > Segment Scoring: 'the LLM evaluates each segment using the issue description, trajectory context, and reference patch' assigning q in [0,10]; the judge model identity is not specified anywhere in the document
Implementation Details > Training Configuration: max sequence length 131,072, batch size 32, AdamW with cosine schedule, peak lr 4e-6; no code or artifact release is stated in the paper

RQ3 Behavioral Analysis: 'reduces redundancy by up to 0.188, increases the observe-before-edit rate by up to 9.6 percentage points, and improves the tool success rate by up to 0.094' versus Resolved-Trajectory SFT
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: SFT data selection for LLM coding agents (SWE-Bench trajectory filtering with loss masking), directly hitting LLMs, Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and Training/Data preferences. Empirically solid — three ~30B MoE models, two benchmarks, Random-10% and full-SFT baselines, Stage-2 ablation, sensitivity sweeps, and behavioral metrics (Table 1, RQ2/RQ3) consistently favor the 10% selected subset. Novelty is moderate: trajectory- and step-level filtering with loss masking exists (SWE-Lego, ATLAS, STeCa cited by the authors); the contribution is a synthesis adding Git-hacking/observe-edit-verify signals, HDBSCAN representativeness, and boundary-aware segment chunking. Rigor is dampened because hyperparameters (10% retention, threshold 7) were tuned by evaluating on SWE-Bench Verified, the same benchmark used in the headline results, and no seeds/variance or per-signal ablations are reported; the segment-scoring judge LLM is unspecified. Generalizability is limited to 30B-class MoE models and same-family SWE-bench benchmarks, with reliance on gold-patch scope. Reproducibility is partial: public data/models and full training config, but no code release, judge prompts, or HDBSCAN parameters.

primary_link.title: SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance

papers.summary: To improve large language models' ability to resolve real-world software issues, prior work has focused on constructing large-scale agent trajectory datasets and performing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on successful trajectories. However, task success does not guarantee high-quality supervision: successful trajectories may still contain ineffective, redundant, or risky steps. Directly using such trajectories for SFT can introduce noisy supervision and encourage models to imitate undesirable prob
papers.summary_zh: 為提升大型語言模型解決真實軟體議題的能力,先前工作多建構大規模代理軌跡資料集,並僅依任務是否成功進行 SFT。然而任務成功不代表監督品質:成功軌跡仍可能含無效、冗餘或具風險的步驟,直接訓練會引入雜訊。本文提出 SWE-Prime,一種多粒度兩階段資料篩選方法。第一階段在軌跡層級綜合流程品質(observe-edit-verify 工作流、工具呼叫成功率、連續冗餘、Git 作弊偵測)、結果品質(以參考修補限制修改範圍)與資料代表性(HDBSCAN 語意分群)進行篩選;第二階段將連續步驟切為語意片段,依其對最終修復的貢獻、可學性與行為風險評分,訓練時所有片段保留於序列以維持脈絡,但僅入選片段計入損失。在三個開源模型與 SWE-Bench Verified/Pro 上,僅用 10% 軌跡的 SWE-Prime 全面優於使用全部成功軌跡的訓練,相對增益最高達 24.2% 與 12.2%,且在 Python、JavaScript、TypeScript、Go 上皆最佳;行為分析顯示冗餘減少、先觀察後編輯比率與工具成功率提升、平均互動輪數下降。限制在於依賴 LLM 評估片段品質、閾值需探索設定,且驗證集中於 30B 級模型。此研究凸顯監督品質而非數量才是編碼代理訓練的關鍵。

links.title: Planting a Latent Variable in Natural-Looking Text: a More Realistic Test of Belief States in LLMs and Their Link to Concept Geometry

evidence: Abstract: plants a latent variable by steering an LLM teacher along K=8 SAE directions following a ring-shaped Markov chain; student tracks the Bayesian posterior and arranges the 8 states on a ring in chain order.

Section 2.1: teacher is Gemma-2-2B (base) with Gemma Scope SAE (16K latents) at layer 12; steering adds s*a_i*(rho_l/rho_12)*d_i at layers 12-23 with s=1.5 chosen by a sweep; KV cache rebuilt each token to keep the optimal observer computable.
Section 2.2: corpus of 400,000 documents x 256 tokens (~102M tokens), plus an unsteered control corpus and a uniform-jump control2 corpus.
Section 2.5: student is a 110M-parameter Llama-style transformer (12 layers, width 768, ~5 epochs, 32k vocab) trained from scratch; two control students are trained.

Section 3.1: ridge probe reaches best-layer R2=0.49 with argmax accuracy 0.577 vs optimal observer ceiling 0.762; control2 reaches R2=0.41 and accuracy 0.52; on first-dwell tokens the ring student and control2 curves coincide (Figure 8), supporting the HMM-structure advantage.

Section 3.2: the top-2 PCA ring of state centroids does not survive the first-dwell restriction (Figure 11); a Fourier circle fit explains 38% of centroid variance at layer 11, and the true ring ranks 1st of 2520 orderings for the ring student but mid-distribution for both controls (Figure 12).

Limitations: geometry evidence is correlational with no causality experiments; only one HMM structure, one set of SAE latents, and one teacher tested; ring geometry is not dominant; the planted variable could not be fully isolated.
No code, data, or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A clearly in-scope LLM interpretability paper: it bridges belief-state probing (Shai et al. line of work) and concept-geometry research by planting a controllable Markov latent variable into natural-looking text via SAE steering of a Gemma-2-2B teacher, then probing a from-scratch 110M student. Methodological design is careful: an exact optimal-observer ceiling (0.762), two controls (unsteered; uniform-jump), a first-dwell ablation that defuses the short-term-memory confound, and a permutation test over all 2520 ring orderings where the true order ranks 1st only for the ring student. Novelty is moderate since the method is largely a composition of subliminal steering (Morgulis & Hewitt) applied to the belief-state program of Shai et al.; the conceptual link between latent-variable dynamics and concept geometry is the genuinely new bit. Evidence is quantified but modest: best-layer R2=0.49 vs control2's 0.41 without error bars or seed variance, and the ring fit explains only 38% of centroid variance; key results rely on figures described in text. The authors honestly flag correlational-only geometry evidence, a single configuration (one teacher, one chain, K=8), and non-dominant geometry (Limitations). No code/data release is stated, and latent-selection details are loose, limiting reproducibility. Solid small-scale workshop-grade contribution with above-average controls, not a landmark result.

primary_link.title: Planting a Latent Variable in Natural-Looking Text: a More Realistic Test of Belief States in LLMs and Their Link to Concept Geometry

papers.summary: LLMs are thought to track "belief states," i.e., running probability distributions over the latent variables that govern language (Shai et al., 2024; Sarfati et al., 2026), but so far this has only been comprehensively demonstrated on toy synthetic data and in a few isolated case studies. It has also never been empirically connected to the geometry of LLM features (the concepts interpretability finds in model activations). In this work, we plant a controllable latent variable inside natural-look
papers.summary_zh: 既有研究顯示小型 Transformer 能在純合成 HMM 資料上線性編碼信念狀態(對潛在變數的運行機率分布),但此結論從未在自然語言情境驗證,也未與可解釋性文獻發現的概念幾何相連。本文提出在自然文本中植入可控潛在變數的方法:以 Gemma-2-2B 作為教師模型撰寫一般文字,同時依據一條環狀馬可夫鏈(停留機率 0.95),在八個彼此正交的 SAE 方向間對其進行「潛意識引導」,再從零訓練一個 110M 的 Llama 式學生模型。以知道轉移矩陣與教師分布的「最佳觀察者」貝氏後驗為探針目標,結果顯示學生模型的殘差流確實線性編碼信念狀態(最佳層 R²=0.49,argmax 準確率約為理論上限的四分之三);更進一步,以傅立葉分析在全部 2520 種環排序的置換檢定中,真實環序在解釋變異量上排名第一,顯示八個狀態本身也依馬可夫鏈順序排列成環,首度將信念動態與概念幾何連結。對照組(無引導、均勻跳轉)確認了此結果並非巧合。限制包括環幾何並非主導幾何、證據屬相關性而無因果實驗,且需擴充更多 HMM 結構與教師模型。此方法為在自然文本中受控研究 LLM 內部結構提供了新工具。

links.title: Instruction Quality Matters: Refining Instructions for Effective Preference Learning

evidence: Section 4.1 / Table 1: refined data improves Llama3-8b DPO MT-Bench win rate 39.7->47.8 and AlpacaEval LC win rate 11.90->18.78 over original UltraFeedback.
Section 4.1 / Table 2: refinement outperforms CoT prompting, paraphrasing, Self-Refine, reward filtering, and R.I.P. baselines (MT-Bench WR 47.8 vs 38.1 for Self-Refine).
Appendix A: BoN gap 0.0218 and WoN gap 0.0297 at N=16 between high- and low-quality instructions, both p<0.0001 (1.5K UltraFeedback instructions, LLaMA3-8B).
Section 5.4 / Table 5: rubric ablation shows rubric-guided refinement beats rubric-free GPT-4o rewriting on all metrics except MT-Bench WR (AlpacaEval LC 19.54 vs 16.23).
Appendix B.3: MT-Bench/Evol-Instruct judged by GPT-4o-2024-11-20, the same model used for refinement and feedback, creating a judge-circularity risk; AlpacaEval judged by GPT-4o-mini.
Appendix C.1: hyperparameters chosen from random search by best performance; SFT AlpacaEval WR appears as 3.95 in Table 1 but 3.55 in Tables 2/4, an unexplained inconsistency.
Section 5.1 / Table 4: cross-reward-model experiment with OSSAT RM shows refined data still generally improves results, addressing reward-model specificity.
Section 4.2 / Table 3: online gains are not uniform; MT-Bench score drops 0.07 (reward model) and 0.19 (implicit reward) despite win-rate gains, honestly reported.
Appendix F.1: human evaluation on 60 instructions by 12 annotators finds 88.4% preserve core task intent, supporting that gains are not task drift.
Limitation section plus Section 3.2 footnote: acknowledges reward-model bias dependence, threshold sensitivity, ~$0.0026/sample API cost, and text-only scope.
Appendix D.2-D.3 / Tables 8-9: alternative reward model (deberta-v3-large-v2) and UltraMedical-Preference dataset experiments indicate gains are not tied to one RM or dataset.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment research: identifies instruction quality as an upstream bottleneck in preference learning and proposes rubric-guided instruction refinement before pair construction. Directly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, alignment/RLHF via DPO/SimPO and reward models, prompting, evaluation, data curation). Novelty is moderate: the pipeline adapts Self-Refine-style LLM feedback to instructions, and instruction selection (R.I.P.) and response refinement baselines exist, though the upstream framing and BoN/WoN tail analysis are fresh. Rigor is above average: two backbones, two objectives, offline and online settings, five baseline comparisons (Table 2), rubric ablation (Table 5), threshold sensitivity (Fig. 4/7), cross-reward-model (Table 4), alternative RM and medical-dataset checks (Tables 8-9), and human evaluations. Deductions: GPT-4o both refines instructions and judges MT-Bench/Evol-Instruct (judge circularity), hyperparameters were chosen by best-performing random search (possible eval overfitting), BoN/WoN effect sizes are small (0.022/0.030 reward gaps), and SFT baseline numbers are inconsistent across tables (AlpacaEval WR 3.95 in Table 1 vs 3.55 in Tables 2/4). Evidence is quantitative and includes significance tests and honest negative results (online MT-Bench score drops; SimPO degradation at high tau), but rests heavily on LLM-judge metrics. Reproducibility is aided by a code link, released prompts, and full hyperparameters; API dependency on GPT-4o and text-only scope limit it. Weighted total ~0.74.

papers.summary: Preference learning optimizes models using response pairs, yet the informativeness of these pairs is fundamentally shaped by the instructions from which they are generated. We identify instruction quality as a hidden bottleneck in preference learning: low-quality or ambiguous instructions restrict the response-quality distribution, limiting strong chosen responses and weakening preference signals. Through Best- and Worst-of-N analyses, we show that instruction quality constrains both the ceiling
papers.summary_zh: 偏好學習以回應配對對齊模型,但配對的資訊量根本上受指令品質制約。本文指出指令品質是偏好學習被忽略的上游瓶頸:模糊或欠規格的指令會壓縮回應品質分布,削弱偏好訊號。透過 Best-of-N 與 Worst-of-N 分析,作者證實高品質指令同時抬升取樣回應的品質上限與下限,使 DPO 梯度獲得更強的正例與非退化的負例。據此提出指令精煉流程:先以獎勵模型訊號篩選弱指令,再由 LLM-as-a-judge 依七項評量規準(清晰性、具體性、完整性、安全性、可答性、簡潔性、格式一致性)產生結構化回饋並改寫指令,無須丟棄任何資料。在 UltraFeedback 上以 DPO 與 SimPO、LLaMA3-8B 與 Mistral-7B 進行離線實驗,並在 SPA 等線上迭代偏好學習中驗證,結果於 MT-Bench、Evol-Instruct、AlpacaEval 帶來最高約 8 個百分點的一致增益,且優於 CoT 改寫、Self-Refine、資料過濾與 R.I.P. 等基線;消融顯示評量規準引導的回饋優於泛用改寫。限制包括依賴獎勵模型的偏誤與校準、過度精煉可能降低回應多樣性(如 SimPO 在高閾值下退化),以及額外 API 成本與僅限文字模態。此研究確立指令品質是形塑偏好訊號的關鍵因素。

Using chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring, we find that harmful execution is often preceded by intent signals in reasoning. However, post-hoc CoT labels are too coarse to show how intent changes during generation. We introduce INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, an approach that adds intent-
papers.summary_zh: 當大型語言模型作為自主代理部署,安全失敗常涉及實際有害行動(如勒索、洩密、阻撓救援)。本文先以思維鏈監測分析五個開源模型,發現有害執行前往往已有明顯意圖訊號,但事後 CoT 標註過於粗糙且依賴外部評審。作者提出 Intent-as-a-Tool:在代理動作空間加入零參數的「意圖宣告工具」,指示模型決定執行目標行為前先呼叫;該工具的呼叫機率提供免評審、可在任意推理前綴計算的細粒度意圖分數。追蹤此訊號揭示多種推理動態,例如先做決定再合理化的承諾模式;在 AgentHarm 上亦呈現跨類別的可測激活。線上防禦方面,當意圖工具成為最優先動作時插入第一人稱反思並續寫,Qwen 系列在 12 個模型—場景組合中有 9 個持平或超越靜態安全提示;Qwen3-32B 在勒索、洩密、謀殺情境分別達 100.0%、96.5%、98.9% 的防禦成功率,時序消融證實意圖訊號能定位關鍵決策點。限制包括加入工具會改變被測行為、宣告可靠度隨模型與情境而異(如 Gemma 較弱),且需事先指定目標行為並存取 token 機率。此工作為代理安全的即時監測與介入提供輕量新途徑。

Novelty is moderate: STAR is a simple ratio of 1-to-1 alignment units computed with existing tools (SaT, Bertalign), and the masked objective is an incremental extension of CPO related to prior masked preference work (Mask-DPO is cited). Rigor is solid: three backbones, ten language pairs, two domains, ablations over ranking metrics, online RL (GRPO/GSPO), offline algos (DPO/SimPO/KTO/ORPO in Appendix J), random-mask controls, tau sensitivity, and a gradient analysis in Appendix M. papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a shift from sentence-level to document-to-document (Doc2Doc) machine translation, promising improved global coherence. However, document-to-document generation in a single pass frequently suffers from structural misalignment, manifesting as sentence omissions or hallucinations that violate the core requirement of source-target correspondence. To address this, we introduce Sentence Translation Alignment Rate (STAR), an auxiliary metric that explicitly qu
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型使翻譯從句級邁向文件對文件(Doc2Doc),但單次生成常出現漏譯、幻覺等結構性錯位,而 COMET 等指標對此幾乎無感。本文提出 STAR(句子翻譯對齊率)輔助指標:將原文與譯文分句並以 Bertalign 對齊後,計算嚴格一對一對齊單元占比,並提供容忍合理合併與拆分的寬鬆變體,亦可透過 LLM-as-a-judge 實作。據此建立 StarPO 框架:以 STAR 分數排序文件級候選譯文建構偏好資料(分數差超過閾值才成對),並在對比偏好最佳化(CPO)中引入句子級動態遮罩,排除已良好對齊的 1:1 句子,使損失集中在漏譯與幻覺等問題區段;理論分析說明遮罩可避免梯度飽和。實驗涵蓋 WMT 新聞與 Guofeng 網路小說、三個 4B 至 8B 開源模型,StarPO 一致超越 SFT 與標準 CPO,於多個語言對的平均 dCOMET 領先 Tower-plus、GPT-4o 與 DeepSeek-R1,也優於 BLEU/COMET 排序與 GRPO/GSPO 等線上 RL 策略。限制包括 1:1 約束可能抑制文體性重組、實驗集中於中小型模型與中高資源語言,且候選生成仰賴 GPT-4o。此研究確立句級結構保真度是 Doc2Doc 翻譯的關鍵瓶頸與可最佳化目標。

papers.summary_zh: 語言模型能偵測道德內容,但偵測只是低門檻;真正的道德理解需要結構化表徵。本文為道德基礎理論(MFT)六大基礎(關懷、公平、自由、忠誠、權威、聖潔)各訓練一個線性探針,於 OLMo-2 1B、OLMoE-1B-7B 與 OLMo-2 7B 每層提取探針權重方向,分析其幾何關係,並定義塌縮、隔離與整合三種模式。核心發現是「整合」幾何:六個方向彼此分離(每層有效維度皆為 5,排除塌縮),又共享一個正向共同成分(平均成對餘弦約 0.22 至 0.27),相對於以相同方式建構的非道德概念測驗組(0.013)高出約 20 倍,顯示該共享成分具道德專屬性。然而階層叢集與置換檢定皆未發現 MFT 預測的 individualizing/binding 分組,模型自形成的結構(如關懷—聖潔配對)更貼近語料統計。道德兩難的方向呈部分組合性:與其組成基礎子空間的成員度約為錯配基線的 2.7 倍,兩基礎貢獻近乎對稱,其餘約 88% 變異編碼衝突特有結構。脆弱性測試顯示 MoE 的輸出稀釋效應等比例削弱所有基礎。限制包括探針資料集小、置換檢定檢定力不足、僅單一模型家族,且因果證據屬初步。此研究首次幾何刻畫基礎語言模型的道德表徵結構。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent security paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (agents/tool use, AI safety, prompt-injection evaluation). Main contributions are a plan-first architecture with dual-lattice (Bell-LaPadula/Biba) IFC extended to cross-query persistence via label-preserving artifacts, plus AgentDojo-MQ, a multi-query benchmark derived from AgentDojo. However, the core mechanisms are assembled from prior systems (CaMeL, FIDES, f-secure, ACE abstract tools), so novelty is mostly in the persistence extension and benchmark. Rigor is solid: formal threat model, formal IFC semantics with algorithms, a 2x2 ablation plus open-memory control, and clearly defined metrics. primary_link.title: SPA: Securing Persistent LLM Agents Across Queries with Plan-First Information-Flow Control

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over untrusted webpages, documents, tools, and persistent states while exercising authority over security-sensitive resources. Existing defenses typically protect either planning or individual tool interactions, but persistent agents face a broader threat: attacker-controlled data can alter control flow, enter security-sensitive tool arguments, or compromise later queries. We present SPA, a plan-first architecture that secures planning, exec
papers.summary_zh: 持久性 LLM 代理會跨查詢保存狀態,使攻擊者控制的內容不僅能注入當前步驟,還可能潛伏到後續查詢才發作。SPA 提出規劃優先(plan-first)架構:每次查詢僅呼叫規劃器一次,在宣告式 DSL 中產出完整可執行計畫,再以雙格資訊流控制(IFC)同時追蹤機密性與完整性,靜態驗證顯式資料流與控制相依,不合規即拒絕執行。為兼顧跨查詢重用與安全,執行結果以帶標籤的工件儲存,後續規劃器只看見語意中繼資料(schema、intent 等),實際值僅能透過 retrieve 步驟取出並還原原始標籤;另提供抽象規劃模式隱藏已安裝工具的中繼資料。作者並建構 AgentDojo-MQ 多查詢基準:在 tool_knowledge 攻擊下,啟用 IFC 將攻擊成功率壓至 0.0%(AgentDojo)與 0.2%(AgentDojo-MQ),工件軟性重用率仍有 89.9%;但代價是效用由 53.0% 降至 29.0%、62.5% 降至 35.3%,主因是完整性檢查拒絕以低信任工具輸出驅動高信任工具。限制包括效用折損、部署政策屬信任基礎,且尚未系統性測試延遲記憶下毒攻擊。本研究凸顯規劃隔離、標籤化持久記憶與安全—效用權衡,對打造可信持久代理具指標意義。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric multimodal misinformation-detection system (Section 3.2: contrastive deliberation with Blind Analyst, Counter-Conclusion Reasoner, and Self-Consistency Arbiter plus iterative prompt refinement) that scores well on preference alignment (CoT reasoning, multi-role agents, prompting, retrieval, VLMs) but is a domain application combining known techniques rather than core language-methodology research. Novelty is moderate: contrastive multi-role debate, self-consistency filtering, automatic prompt optimization, topic-routed LoRA experts, and kNN-style witness retrieval are each established; the closed-loop RCCA refinement without ground-truth CoT is the most original element. Rigor is solid for an application paper: two backbones (Qwen3-VL, InternVL3.5), two benchmarks, cross-dataset transfer, per-topic results, and a five-configuration ablation (Table 4), though topic-routing is unvalidated ('topic-classification accuracy cannot be measured', Section 3.1), RCCA iteration count is vague, τ is set empirically, and no significance testing or variance is reported. Evidence is concrete (91.33/92.31 in-domain ACC; 76.20/72.24 cross-dataset with +13.70/+9.24 over baselines, Table 2) but cross-dataset baselines were mostly near-collapsed (e.g., FANVM 51.43), making the transfer margin less informative, and cross-sample review contributes only ~0.4 points in the ablation. Generalizability is limited by the short-video FND domain, dataset-supplied event labels, and an unvalidated VLM topic router. Reproducibility is mixed: hyperparameters are thorough (Section 4.1) but deliberation roles rely on closed GPT-5.1/Claude-4.5 APIs and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Self-Reflective Multi-modal Reasoning for Short-Video Fake News Detection

papers.summary: Recent fake news detection pipelines increasingly leverage large language models and vision-language models for reasoning-based analysis. However, several challenges remain open: improving reasoning quality through self-reflection without ground-truth chain-of-thought supervision, using improved reasoning to benefit downstream model fine-tuning, and connecting single-sample fraudulent-pattern discovery with cross-sample verification. We propose SRM-FND, a self-reflective multimodal reasoning fra
papers.summary_zh: 短影片假新聞偵測越來越依賴 LLM 與 VLM 產生推理鏈(CoT),但在缺乏真值 CoT 監督下,如何透過自我反思迭代提升推理品質、如何讓改善後的 CoT 回饋下游 fine-tuning,以及如何串聯單一樣本的詐騙模式發現與跨樣本驗證,仍是未解難題。SRM-FND 提出自反射式多模態推理框架:先由 Blind Analyst、Counter-Conclusion Reasoner 與 Self-Consistency Arbiter 進行對比式審議,保留具辨別力的論點並剔除雙方皆可成立的模糊論據;再以 RCCA(根因診斷與矯正行動)僅迭代修正 Blind Analyst 的提示,形成封閉迴圈。接著採雙階段主題自適應 VLM fine-tuning:先做多模態對齊預訓練,再為四大主題掛載輕量 LoRA 專家;推論時對低信心樣本觸發跨樣本複審,檢索同事件的可信與可疑見證樣本協助裁決。在 FakeSV 與 FakeTT 上,SRM-FND(Qwen3-VL)分別達 91.33 與 92.31 準確率;跨資料集轉移為 76.20 與 72.24,較最強基準提升 13.70 與 9.24 點。限制包括主題分類準確率無法測量、檢索僅限訓練集,且僅在兩個資料集驗證。整體示範了自我反思推理能同時強化準確性、可解釋性與跨域泛化。
papers.title: Self-Reflective Multi-modal Reasoning for Short-Video Fake News Detection
papers.title_zh: 自我反思式多模態推理用於短影片假新聞偵測

links.title: Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD

evidence: Abstract: claims 4.73% and 10.84% general-capability-average improvement over standard MOPD in role-playing and medical specialization while maintaining vertical-domain performance.
Table 2 (Sec. 4.2): Ours reaches Gen. Avg. 53.10 vs vanilla MOPD 50.70 (role-playing) and 54.38 vs 49.06 (medical), with Vertical Avg. 45.00 and 60.65 respectively.
Table 3 (Sec. 4.3): component ablation isolates CLL masking (51.01 Gen. Avg.), dual-temperature sampling (52.83), and positive-density filtering (53.10).
Table 4 (Sec. 4.3): rollout-budget-matched control with eight responses per prompt shows ours 53.10/45.00 vs vanilla MOPD 52.23/43.38, addressing the budget confound.
Sec. 3.6: theoretical justification provides only by-construction properties (positive-density lower bound, entropy-adaptive CLL form) and explicitly disclaims convergence guarantees.
Appendix A.1/A.3: homogeneous same-scale Qwen3-4B/8B teacher-student setups, BF16, 4 nodes of 8 H800 GPUs, LR 2e-6, 3 epochs; no code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.

Sec. 4.1 and Table 5: diagnostics show kept trajectories have higher positive-token fraction (0.5939 vs 0.5026) and mean positive advantage (0.1375 vs 0.0705) than dropped ones; no error bars or significance tests are reported for any comparison.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM training methodology paper (multi-teacher on-policy distillation for preserving general capabilities during domain specialization) with strong preference alignment to LLM, training/optimization, and reasoning-evaluation topics. The method combines known ingredients (dual-temperature rollouts, anchor-relative trajectory filtering, and a CLL entropy-centered token gate adapted from prior distribution-discrimination work), yielding moderate novelty. Rigor is solid: component ablations, a rollout-budget-matched control (Table 4), alternative token-endorsement criteria (Table 6), and temperature sensitivity (Table 11) support the claimed mechanisms, but results appear single-run with no variance or significance testing, and the Sec. 3.6 'theory' consists of properties that hold by construction. Evidence is consistent across role-playing and medical settings (e.g., Gen. Avg. 53.10 vs 50.70 and 54.38 vs 49.06 over vanilla MOPD) with supporting diagnostics (Table 5), though judged benchmarks (Arena-Hard, WritingBench) and a large IF-Eval jump (48.06 to 71.53) lack uncertainty quantification. Generalizability is limited by homogeneous, same-scale Qwen3 teacher-student setups requiring white-box log-prob/entropy access; only two domains tested. Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed Appendix A (checkpoints, data counts, LR, hardware, precision) but no code or data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD

papers.summary: Specializing large language models to vertical domains improves domain-specific behavior but often degrades general capabilities such as reasoning, coding, instruction following, and creative writing. We study this domain--general trade-off in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), where a specialized student is supervised on its own sampled trajectories by domain and general teachers. Standard MOPD faces two limitations: ordinary on-policy sampling rarely exposes tokens with large positiv
papers.summary_zh: 將 LLM 專門化到角色扮演或醫療等垂直領域時,常伴隨推理、程式編寫與指令遵循等一般能力衰退。多教師線上政策蒸餾(MOPD)讓領域教師與通用教師在學生自身取樣的軌跡上提供逐 token 監督,但存在兩個缺陷:一般取樣難以出現大的正向師生優勢;且僅憑優勢正負號決定強化或壓抑,可能誤刪教師其實認可的 token。本文提出不確定性校準的 MOPD:雙溫度取樣以 T=1.0 錨點與 T=1.5 探索分支擴大候選軌跡池;正向優勢密度過濾僅保留正向訊號不弱於錨點的探索軌跡;再以中心化對數似然(CLL)計算熵校準的教師認可分數,依方向—認可一致性以機率保留 token 更新。在角色扮演與醫療專門化中,方法相較標準 MOPD 將 GPQA-Diamond、AIME25、IF-Eval 等九項一般基準的平均分別提升 4.73% 與 10.84%,同時維持垂直領域表現;消融實驗與相同 rollout 預算對照證明增益並非來自更多取樣,CLL 亦優於硬性 top-k 認可準則。限制包括僅在同規模 Qwen3 系統上驗證,且仰賴可信教師與領域路由設定。此工作將領域—一般權衡轉化為 token 級訊號選取問題,兼具理論與實務價值。
papers.title: Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD
papers.title_zh: 以不確定性校準 MOPD 在領域專門化過程中保留一般能力

links.title: Boosting LLM Exploration via Weak-Model Guidance in RLVR

evidence: Section 5.2, Table 1: Qwen2.5-7B+GRPO pass@128 67.76 vs 70.71 with Gemma-2-2B prefix; Qwen2.5-Math-7B 69.30 vs 71.22; pass@1 gains small (38.29->39.01, 40.08->40.11).

Section 6.3, Table 2: ablations over prefix probability p (p=0.2 best pass@128 70.71), entropy-based truncation vs random truncation (70.71 vs 70.19), and homologous generators (Qwen2.5-1.5B prefix pass@128 67.22, below vanilla 67.76).

Section 6.2, Figure 4: majority of small-model prefixes rated 'no substantial guidance' or 'completely incorrect and misleading' by DeepSeek-V4-Flash judge on 200 entries per generator, supporting the perturbation-not-distillation interpretation.
Section 3, Figure 1: cross-model prefixes (Gemma-2-2B) induce higher early step-level entropy in Qwen2.5-7B than self-generated prefixes, motivating the method.

Limitations: 'the improvement is delicate with pre-configured hyper-parameters' and 'it currently only works on the mathematical reasoning tasks, while other domains like logic and code generations are under-explored.'

Section 5.1: MATH training set (7500 problems), GRPO via VeRL, lr 1e-6, batch 1024, 8 responses per question, pass@k estimated with N=128/200 samples per problem; no error bars or seed variance reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-reasoning/RL paper (LLMs weight 2.5, reasoning weight 2.5, RL weight 1.5) proposing weak-model prefix conditioning to counter entropy collapse in GRPO/RLVR. The perturbation-not-guidance finding and entropy-based truncation are moderately novel; closely related off-policy-guidance and entropy-regularization work exists (Yan et al. 2026; Cui et al. 2025, cited but not empirically compared). Evidence is real but modest: gains are ~1 point at pass@1 and ~2-3 points at pass@128, no variance/significance reporting, and the only baseline is vanilla GRPO despite the paper's positioning against regularization methods. Ablations (Table 2) and the prefix-quality analysis (Section 6.2) genuinely support the mechanism, and the Limitations section candidly concedes hyperparameter sensitivity and math-only scope. Detailed setup (Section 5.1) plus prompt templates (Appendix B) aid reproduction, though no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Boosting LLM Exploration via Weak-Model Guidance in RLVR

papers.summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) significantly improves LLM reasoning but often causes a drop in policy entropy, leading to narrowed reasoning coverage and degraded pass@$k$ for large $k$. While existing methods mitigate this entropy collapse through algorithmic regularizations, cross-model non-parametric perturbation is also neglected. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective approach to preserve the generative diversity of LLMs during RLVR. Instead of relying solely
papers.summary_zh: 以可驗證獎勵的強化學習(RLVR)訓練 LLM 推理時,政策熵常快速下降,造成探索收縮與 pass@k 在大 k 時衰退。既有方法多從演算法層面進行正則化,本文則引入跨模型非參數擾動:訓練時以較小較弱的模型(LLaMA-3.2-1B、Gemma-2-2B)產生部分推理軌跡作為前綴,迫使目標模型從陌生狀態續寫;並提出以熵為準的前綴截斷,保留步驟級熵降幅最大的轉折點之前的內容,再以混合訓練(前綴機率 p=0.2)平衡探索與直接作答。實驗在 AIME 2024/2025、AMC 2023、MATH 500、Minerva 與 OlympiadBench 六項數學基準顯示,方法一致優於 vanilla GRPO,且增益隨 k 增大而擴大:Qwen2.5-7B 的 pass@128 由 67.76 提升至 70.71,pass@1 亦略升。分析發現多數弱模型前綴其實無實質引導甚至誤導,同源的 Qwen 前綴亦無明顯增益,顯示效益來自分佈擾動而非教師品質;前綴訓練也緩解零獎勵樣本稀疏問題。限制在於對超參數敏感,且目前僅驗證數學推理,程式與邏輯等領域尚待探索。此研究提示資料層級的擾動是對抗熵崩塌的輕量途徑。
papers.title: Boosting LLM Exploration via Weak-Model Guidance in RLVR
papers.title_zh: 在 RLVR 中透過弱模型引導提升 LLM 探索能力

links.title: Research Design Tracking and Assessment for the Social Sciences

evidence: Abstract: 'passage length is the main driver of performance, explaining 52-66% of the variance' and 'human and machine difficulty do not align'.
Section 6.1 / Table 3: Pearson r between average chunk length and F1 = .779 (Llama-8B), .815 (Qwen-32B), .727 (Llama-70B), .292 n.s. for gpt-5.1.
Section 6.1 / Table 4: matched-passage-length comparison of 5 configuration pairs; 'average performance difference between strategies is 1.0 F1-points... no strategy shows a consistent advantage'.
Section 6.4: 'Long-Context document prompting proves a strong baseline: across both subtasks and all four LLMs, most retrieval configurations fail to outperform it'.
Section 4.2 / Table 1: Krippendorff's alpha .814 full task, .926 RD Identification, .753 RD Assessment, computed on a 24-paper I-AA set.
Section 6.3 / Table 6: 'None of the correlations is statistically significant' between Krippendorff's alpha and model performance across six RDs.
Section 8 Limitations: dataset size ('per-RD estimates should be interpreted with caution') and English-only corpus.
Dataset footnote 3: 'Due to copyright restrictions... we release only the paper metadata... along with the annotations and the analytical framework' (no full texts).
Section 5.1: 82 rounds per LLM, 'summing up to 164 experimental rounds'; models include proprietary Cohere-embed-english-v3.0 and gpt-5.1.
Section 1 (contributions): task definition with expert-designed schema, 140-paper expert-annotated dataset, and systematic retrieval-strategy benchmark.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A Computational Social Science/NLP benchmark paper, not a pure domain application: its stated primary goal (Section 1) is a systematic NLP evaluation of indexing/retrieval strategies for long-document QA. Strong overlap with RAG & Knowledge and LLM preferences (four retrieval strategies, six embedding models, four LLMs including GPT-5.1 in a multi-turn RAG pipeline), plus a new expert-annotated dataset. Novelty is moderate: the RD-assessment dimension and the human-vs-machine difficulty divergence are new, but chunk-length effects, BM25-vs-dense comparisons, and strong long-context baselines are largely known results reconfirmed on a new task. Rigor is solid (164 runs, Krippendorff's alpha .814, matched-length confound control, per-option strict F1) but weakened by a small dataset (140 papers; only 2 papers per RD in the 24-paper I-AA set), low-power correlations (n=17 configurations, n=6 RDs), and ecological-inference risks in the 52-66% variance claim. Evidence for the headline findings is well documented in Tables 3-7, though some interpretations (e.g., gpt-5.1 using parametric knowledge) are speculative. Generalizability is tempered by the English-only, social-science-specific corpus; reproducibility suffers from no full-text release (footnote 3, copyright), a proprietary embedding, and no stated code release.

primary_link.title: Research Design Tracking and Assessment for the Social Sciences

radar.summary: Reliable assessment of causal research designs in the social sciences is critical for evidence-based policy-making, yet has so far relied entirely on manual expert analysis. We introduce Automated Research Design Tracking and Assessment (ARDTrA), a task that involves detecting the research design used in a paper and assessing the quality of its application. We create an expert-annotated dataset of papers covering six families of counterfactual research designs and evaluate the task using a multi
radar.summary_zh: 社會科學論文的因果研究設計評估長期仰賴專家人工判讀。本文提出 ARDTrA 任務:先偵測論文採用六類反事實研究設計(實驗、門檻型、工具變數、可觀察變項選擇、雙重差分、合成控制)中的哪一種,再評估其應用品質。作者建立由 8 位領域專家標註、涵蓋 140 篇論文的資料集與分析框架,並以多輪對話式 RAG 管線進行基準測試,比較 BM25、稠密檢索、自適應合併與命題主題感知四種檢索策略、六種嵌入模型與四個 LLM,另設 Long-Context 基線。結果顯示段落長度是效能主因,解釋 52–66% 的變異;平均而言 BM25 不遜於稠密檢索,bge-large-en-v1.5 最為穩健;gpt-5.1 幾乎不受段落長度影響,而 Long-Context 基線多數組態難以超越。逐設計分析發現機器最困難的設計與專家標註分歧最大的設計並不一致,顯示主觀判斷與資訊可檢索性是兩個獨立的難度來源。限制為資料集規模有限且僅含英文。此研究為證據導向的政策制定提供可自動化的文獻篩選基礎,也對專家領域 RAG 系統的設計與評估具重要啟示。

links.title: Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder

evidence: Abstract & Sec. 5.2, Table 1: OmniUE-7B reaches 51.8 overall on MMEB-v2-video vs best 7B baseline 47.5 (+4.3 absolute points in-table), while the abstract cites '10.5%' for the same benchmark with no relative-vs-absolute definition given.

Sec. 4.2: OmniCHOIR derives from SAM-Audio-Bench (819 samples, 479 retained after filtering), uses SAM-Audio-Large for separation and Qwen3-Omni-30B for captions; OmniUE's own audio segmenter is sam-audio-base (Sec. 5.1), creating benchmark-method lineage overlap the paper only partially addresses via the held-out claim.

Appendix E.1, Tables 7-8: ablations show removing visual & audio streams drops SCaR 51.3->32.9 and OmniCHOIR 26.4->19.3, and removing learnable tokens/aggregation drops all benchmarks, supporting component contributions.

Sec. 5.1: visual and audio interactions are excluded from training data ('only textual-interactive datasets are used for training'), so SCaR/OmniCHOIR gains are evaluated zero-shot, substantiating the emerging-capability claim.
Sec. 5.2, Table 2: OmniUE-3B overall 50.5 vs LCO-Emb-3B 50.7 on MAEB is honestly reported as 'on par' (improvement row shows '-'), though the abstract cites a +1.1% audio gain (7B only).
Appendix E.2, Table 10: transparent latency/memory accounting (mask modes 9.3-10.5s vs bbox 1.5-2.1s per sample; 20.8GB), with a practical bbox trade-off analysis.

Appendix C, Tables 5-6: complete training configurations (8xH100, LoRA rank 32/alpha 64, lr 2e-5, ~3.5M samples, 177/195 GPU-hours) and prompt template in Appendix D, but no explicit code, weights, or benchmark release statement anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-methodology paper: an omni-modal embedder built on Qwen2.5-Omni with SAM-3/SAM-Audio segmenters enabling text/visual/audio interaction prompts, plus a new benchmark (OmniCHOIR). Strong core relevance to LLMs, multimodal AI, training/fine-tuning, and embedding evaluation; no Japanese-language component despite the highest-weight preference. Novelty is real (first audio-span interactive embedding and omni-interactive benchmark) but compositional: learnable tokens, layer aggregation, and connector designs derive from prior work (Refs 34, 44, 50, 53). Empirics are unusually thorough (4 benchmarks, 15-variant ablations, parameter studies, latency/memory, noisy-prompt robustness, honest 'on par' MAEB 3B result), but three issues temper confidence: (1) abstract/intro headline percentages (10.5%, 83.7%, 24.1%) do not match the absolute-point gains in Tables 1/3/4 and the relative-improvement definition is never stated; (2) OmniCHOIR is small (479 instances) and built with SAM-Audio-Large on SAM-Audio-Bench, sharing model lineage with OmniUE's own audio segmenter, a circularity risk despite the held-out-training claim; (3) no significance testing and no explicit code/benchmark release. Score calibrated to a solid, well-evidenced systems contribution with presentation and benchmark-construction caveats.

primary_link.title: Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder

radar.summary: Multimodal representation learning has been shifting from traditional two-tower architectures to large language model (LLM)-based embedders due to their strong instruction-following capabilities. Despite this progress, existing approaches primarily focus on language and image modalities, which also remain the dominant modalities for user-conditioned interactions in current embedders. In this paper, we propose the first Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder (OmniUE), which not only learns a unified
radar.summary_zh: 多模態嵌入模型向來以文字(至多加上圖像)作為使用者互動介面。本文提出首個全互動式通用嵌入器 OmniUE:同時支援文字、靜音影片與音訊的任意組合輸入,並允許使用者以文字、視覺區域(點、框、遮罩)與音訊時間片段進行互動查詢。模型以 Qwen2.5-Omni 為骨幹,導入 SAM-3 與 SAM-Audio 作為視覺與音訊分割器,將互動特徵經連接器對映至 LLM 空間,並透過附加可學習 token 與跨中間層的情境聚合模組產生單一嵌入向量。作者亦發表 OmniCHOIR 基準,包含 479 個文字-影片-音訊到音訊的檢索實例,並以背景音替換、同類別音替換等策略構築困難負例。OmniUE 在 MMEB-v2-video、MAEB、SCaR 與 OmniCHOIR 上分別平均領先基線 10.5%、1.1%、83.7% 與 24.1%;消融實驗證實分割器串流、多 token 輸入與層聚合皆有貢獻,且互動模態組合越多成效越好。限制包括依賴預訓練模型、遮罩互動延遲較高,以及 OmniCHOIR 規模仍小。此工作朝向支援任意使用者意圖的通用嵌入器邁進,可應用於代理系統、記憶增強與個人化。

links.title: TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes

evidence: Abstract/Introduction: introduces Configured Failure Trapping with stealthy textual triggers (e.g., prefix 'From the robot's perspective,') inducing configured failure modes rather than unconstrained failure.
Table 1 (Experiments, Trap-LIBERO/OpenVLA-OFT): Ours AVE 98.7/98.9/95.8/94.1 across Object/Spatial/Goal/Long vs Vanilla-T 79.3/78.6/70.3/60.0 and DropVLA 81.1/73.4/75.9/60.0.
Experimental Setup (Metrics): C-ASR success criterion ||d - Delta||_1 < gamma with fixed tolerance gamma=0.03; AVE defined in Eq. (8) combining clean-SR preservation and mean C-ASR.

Appendix A (ONION Detection, Table 6): at default threshold t=0 only 4/148 (2.7%) triggered prompts detected, 0 fully removed; at t=-5 detection rises to 56.8% but 94.6% of clean prompts are modified.
Appendix A (Codex Detection, Table 8): Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) flags 0/148 triggered and 0/37 clean prompts, reducing to an all-clean classifier with balanced accuracy 50.0%.

Appendix B (Table 12): vanilla backdoor C-ASR for Early Close is non-monotonic in backdoor-data ratio (68.6 -> 82.4 -> 10.2 -> 86.8 -> 93.2), motivating the residual-steering objective; Table 11 lists AdamW, lr 5e-5, single random seed 42 on two H100 GPUs.

Real-world evaluation (Table 3): pi_0.5 on ROKAE 6-DoF robot, 50 demonstrations and 30 trials per condition; AVE 97.0 (Eggplant) and 99.2 (Cup) vs DropVLA 52.3/55.9, with no variance or seed repetition reported.

Appendix D (Summary): positions TrapVLA against FreezeVLA (inaction), DropVLA (action primitive), and AttackVLA (trajectory redirection), but defense coverage in the paper is limited to ONION and a single LLM judge.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Not pure robotics: the contribution is a language-methodology security attack on VLA agents, with LLM-in-the-loop components (GPT-5.4 trigger generation, perplexity-based trigger ranking, Codex LLM-judge detection, ONION stealthiness tests), matching AI Safety and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences, with secondary multimodal/agent/robotics relevance. Novelty is solid: 'Configured Failure Trapping' (controlling how a robot fails via stealthy textual prefixes, multiple failure modes per model) is a genuine refinement over binary-failure backdoors (BadVLA, DropVLA, FreezeVLA), and the residual-steering loss addressing the identified 'sparse action deviation' problem is a credible methodological idea. Rigor is decent but flawed: formal C-ASR/AVE metrics, four baselines, two victim architectures (OpenVLA-OFT, pi_0.5), two sim benchmarks plus real-world ROKAE robot, and a data-ratio ablation; however, a single seed (Appendix B, Table 11: seed 42) with no variance reporting, missing Vanilla-I on pi_0.5 and missing vanilla baselines in RoboTwin/Fig.5, and a fixed gamma=0.03 tolerance without sensitivity analysis weaken confidence. Evidence is consistent (AVE 94-99 vs baselines 49-81) but unaccompanied by statistical treatment. Generalizability is bounded: only four hand-instantiated failure modes, two victim models, manipulation-only tasks, and defense evaluation limited to ONION plus one binary LLM judge. Reproducibility is moderate: public base benchmarks, hyperparameters (Table 11), trigger lists (Table 4), and a project page, but no explicit code-release statement in the text.

primary_link.title: TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes

radar.summary: This work introduces Configured Failure Trapping, a novel backdoor attack task against Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which aims to activate attacks through stealthy textual triggers and induce configured failure modes. Unlike prior backdoor attacks that treat any task failure as a successful attack, Configured Failure Trapping requires the attacker to control how the robot fails (e.g., causing the robot to grasp with a specified positional offset), making it substantially more challenging
radar.summary_zh: 現有針對視覺-語言-動作模型的後門攻擊多半只問任務是否失敗,本文提出更細緻的「可組態失敗陷阱」任務:以隱蔽的文字觸發詞誘導攻擊者預先指定的失敗模式,例如提前閉合夾爪、抓取位置偏移、提前張開或釋放位置偏移。作者設計 TrapEngine,以「先組態再重播」策略從專家示範合成帶有目標行為的後門資料,建立 Trap-LIBERO 與 Trap-RoboTwin 基準,並提出 C-ASR 與 AVE 兩項指標衡量失敗保真度與乾淨任務保留。針對「稀疏動作偏差」——僅少數步驟偏離正常軌跡——的挑戰,TrapVLA 以目標殘差引導直接監督觸發詞引起的動作殘差。實驗顯示,在 OpenVLA-OFT 與 π0.5 上,TrapVLA 於四種失敗模式多可達 87–100% 的 C-ASR,乾淨任務成功率接近未受攻擊模型;實體機器人實驗 AVE 達 97.0 與 99.2。觸發詞能自然融入指令,可規避 ONION 偵測與 Codex 審查,並對同義詞替換穩健。此研究揭示機器人「如何失敗」可被精細操控的隱蔽威脅,對 VLA 模型的安全防禦設計具重要警示價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuinely LLM-centric methodology paper: conformal risk control for LLM-as-a-Judge pairwise evaluation with multi-expert ensembles (MC3) plus a new human-labeled dialogue benchmark (Panel). Strong topical fit to LLM evaluation, selective prediction, and reliability/safety of judges; weak fit to Japanese NLP, coding, or reasoning. Novelty is real but incremental: CRC (Angelopoulos et al.), majority-vote panels, and per-expert calibration are combined, with the exchangeability-preserving joint threshold scaling as the main technical contribution, backed by proofs in Appendix C. Rigor is solid in structure (5 splits, conversation-ID partitioning, homogeneous/heterogeneous ablations, honest exclusion of Test-time Voting whose risk .118-.154 exceeds alpha), but concerns remain: only alpha=0.1 tested, only K=3, no inter-annotator agreement reported for 3 in-house annotators, small benchmark (1,800 pairs), evaluator selection by accuracy on the same labels risks leakage, and several pointwise rows in Table 1 show test Risk above alpha (Causal .124/.140, DeepConf .185) without explanation, hinting at clustered-pair exchangeability issues. Evidence is quantitative and multi-metric but averages lack variance estimates and no code release is mentioned (dataset only). Generalizability is claimed theoretically (Appendix C.6) but tested only on English open-ended dialogue with 7B-12B open-weight models and requires logit access. Reproducibility is moderate: public HuggingFace dataset and implementation details in Appendix B, but no code and incomplete prompt templates.

primary_link.title: Multi-Expert Conformal Risk Control for Pairwise LLM Judging in Open-Ended Dialogue

Our core insight is that multi-expert aggregation offers a complementary remedy to CRC: whereas CRC controls risk at the decision threshold through abstention, aggregation sanitizes the scoring function at its source. Guided by this, we first design two multi-expert CRC methods: Score Averaging and Decision Voting, which aggregate at the score and decision
radar.summary_zh: 在心理健康支援等高風險場域,LLM-as-a-Judge 的成對評估需要嚴格的風險控管。本文將開放式對話的成對偏好評估形式化為 Conformal Risk Control (CRC) 之下的選擇性預測:信心不足時棄權並轉交人工複核,藉有限樣本保證錯誤風險不超過 α。作者先以系統性實驗找出最佳一致性分數——logit 層級的成對偏好機率,再提出首個多專家 CRC 框架:Score Averaging 與 Decision Voting 適用於同質專家(同一模型更換提示詞或種子);面對分數尺度各異的異質專家,則提出 MC3:先以各專家獨立校準取得門檻比值,再於單一全域純量 t 上聯合搜尋門檻,並在校準與測試使用同一聯合投票決策函數以維持可交換性。作者另建立 Panel 基準:四個開放權重模型在 ESConv、MSC、DREAM 三領域共 1,800 個人工標註成對樣本,並提供完整 logit 存取。實驗顯示同質集成接受率最高提升 15.8 個百分點;異質情況下 MC3 在三個資料集皆為 CRC 有效方法中接受率最高,風險維持 ≤0.1。限制包括需要 logit 存取、未建模棄權成本,且分佈漂移會破壞保證。此框架為高風險應用中 LLM 評審的安全部署提供理論依據與實用設計。

links.title: Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting

evidence: Abstract: all-parallel floor reaches 0.286 at the final slot on Qwen3-4B, capping best per-slot acceptance at 71%
Sec. 4 / Table 3: conditioning on the immediately preceding realised token removes 86-100% of the order-0 floor across slots
Sec. 5 / Table 7: DFlash model gap accounts for 55.0-67.3% of per-slot rejection; Sec. 6 reports 43-64% across Qwen3-8B/14B and Gemma-4-12B
App. C.2: independent sglang/top-256 implementation differs from headline floors by at most 0.007 across the block
App. B.2: stratified anchor design (18 groups), Hajeek aggregation, prompt-level bootstrap with B=10^4 for 95% intervals
App. C.6: sampling-law sensitivity shows the model gap remains dominant (G/R rises to 67%) under the drafter training law
Sec. 7 / Table 9: serving reweighting lowers DFlash final-slot risk from 0.635 to 0.211, showing free-rollout risk overstates serving risk by ~3x
App. A: proofs that R_k >= T_k^(m), floor monotonicity in conditioning order, and the mutual-information identity E[C_blind - C_full] = I(Y_k; Z_<k | X)
Sec. 6: frontier control on DeepSeek-V4-Pro API gives T_6^(0)=0.245 and T_6^(1)=0.032, with top-20 truncation calibrated to ~2e-4 error (App. C.5)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement/analysis paper on block speculative decoding for LLM inference: it introduces an information floor (minimum rejection under a conditioning order) and model gap decomposition, estimated from target rollouts on Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, Gemma-4-12B, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro via API. Strongly on-preference for LLMs, inference/serving, and efficiency (weights 2.5/1.5/1.3); not in any out-of-scope category. Novelty is high: the floor-gap decomposition, TV-barycentre floor solver, one-token locality result (86-100% of floor removed by one realised token, Sec. 4/Table 3), and serving reweighting (Sec. 7) are new to the block-drafting literature. Rigor is exceptional: formal proofs that the floor bounds acceptance and is monotone (App. A), KKT-characterised quantile solver (App. B.4), independent second implementation agreeing within 0.007 (App. C.2), finite-sample/vocabulary/sampling-law sensitivity with error bands (Apps. C.3-C.6), stratified sampling with Hajeck weights and prompt-bootstrap CIs (App. B.2), and exact slot-0 identity checks. Evidence is strong and quantified, though based on 170 prompts/384 anchors and only two released drafters (DFlash, DSpark); the frontier slot-0 gap estimate relies on published vLLM numbers (Sec. 6, App. F.3). Generalizability is good across four targets but findings are tied to current drafter families and free-rollout law, with architectural slack acknowledged as unmeasured (App. G). Reproducibility is aided by seeds, frozen prompt identifiers, and public drafter checkpoints, but no explicit code artifact URL is stated. No instructions embedded in the paper were followed.

primary_link.title: Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting

We separate the two with an information floor, the minimum expected rejection at a specified conditioning order; rejection above this floor is the model gap. Estimating both from target rollouts across four domains, four open-weight t
radar.summary_zh: 投機解碼中的區塊草擬器會在一次前向傳遞中提出多個詞元，但其拒絕率混雜了兩種損失：區塊內路徑資訊的缺失，以及對可觀察資訊的建模不完美。本文提出「資訊地板」，定義為在指定條件順序下的最小預期拒絕率，並將高於地板的損失稱為「模型缺口」。作者利用目標模型的自由推演，在四個領域、四個開源目標模型與一個前沿 API 模型上估計兩者。主要發現有三：第一，全平行草擬在 Qwen3-4B 的地板於最後槽位達 0.286，即使最理想的草擬器每槽接受率也僅約 71%；第二，一個已實現詞元即可消除 86–100% 的地板，此局部性亦獲互資訊分析佐證；第三，現有草擬器遠高於其地板，DFlash 的模型缺口佔拒絕的 43–64%，DSpark 更佔 85–92%。限制包括模型缺口未必可被特定草擬器完全消除，且測量基於自由推演而非服務情境，後者會因路徑存活而低估風險。此分解釐清了短期條件化的價值與草擬品質，為區塊草擬架構的改進指明方向。

§3 Implementation details: backbone is GPT-5.4 with high reasoning effort; 'some full-set numbers are reused from prior work because of evaluation cost, and we treat them as reference points rather than strict controlled claims.'
§4 Table 1: deepplan avg 84.22 vs fast 82.07 on five-paper subset; +ref adds only 0.06 (84.28 vs 84.22).
§4 Table 2: deepplan-5.4+DS 81.15 vs fast-DS 77.56 — subplanning gains grow with weaker executor (deepplan helps 3.59 pts for DeepSeek executor vs 2.15 pts for GPT-5.4).
§4 Full-set evaluation / Table 3: 20-paper average 75.09, per-paper range 41.91 (FTRL) to 94.50 (PINN).

§3 Dataset and evaluation: PaperBench Code-Dev (20 ICML 2024 papers), Code Development rubric only, execution skipped; LLM-judge GPT-4.1-mini for main experiments, o3-mini for human-expert comparison.
§3 Baselines (iii): human baseline is eight ML PhD students/graduates working part-time on three papers (FRE, All-in-One, Stay-Topic), best-of-three attempts.
§4 Runtime and cost analysis: 'These numbers are not strictly controlled'; fast ~US$10±1 and <1h, deepplan ~US$12.5±1 and ~1.5h vs ~2h for DeepCode.
§2.2 Repository-aware orchestration: subplan B_t = A_sub(B_0, P_t, M_t, Δ_t); memory agent A_mem compresses files; diagnostics Δ feed bounded repair in deepplan mode.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope agentic-LLM systems paper: LLM-based multi-agent code agent (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLMs) for paper-to-code reproduction, evaluated on PaperBench Code-Dev with GPT-5.4/DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbones. Core contribution — iterative subplanning conditioned on evolving repository state, memory compression, bounded repair — is a plausible but incremental advance over existing replanning loops in coding agents (DeepCode, PaperCoder, SWE-agent); state-conditioned replanning is a natural refinement rather than a new capability. Rigor is moderate: useful ablations (fast vs deepplan, executor model swap, +ref) with per-paper scores, but no repeated runs/variance, no significance testing, subset selection (FRE, RICE, PINN, BaM, Mech-U) lacks justification, and the authors concede full-set baseline numbers are 'reference points rather than strict controlled claims' and cost/runtime figures 'not strictly controlled' (§3, §4). Evidence relies on LLM-judge grading (GPT-4.1-mini main, o3-mini for human comparison), a proxy metric with judge-model sensitivity; the 5.4-point margin over the human Best@3 baseline on a 3-paper shared subset is thin given part-time human effort and differing judge setups. Generalizability limited to ML-paper reproduction on one benchmark; the state-aware orchestration idea could transfer to other long-horizon repo construction. Reproducibility is aided by released code, a demo video, and published per-paper scores, but depends on proprietary frontier APIs. Overall: solid, relevant engineering contribution with honest caveats but limited novelty and uncontrolled comparisons.

radar.summary_zh: 將機器學習論文自動重現為可執行的完整程式碼庫是一項長期挑戰。現有系統多依賴靜態的預先規劃再逐檔案生成，隨著依賴、介面與執行回饋持續變動，容易產生連鎖性不一致。本文提出 DeepRepro，以執行狀態感知的子規劃為核心：藍圖規劃階段將論文提煉為儲存庫層級骨架；儲存庫感知編排透過狀態條件化迴圈建構程式碼，每輪由子規劃模組依當前儲存庫狀態選取相關檔案或修復目標，執行模組以工具增強生成實作，記憶模組非同步壓縮已完成產物，並以有限修復機制回饋診斷；另有程序感知前端供透明監控，支援 fast 與 deepplan 兩種模式。在 PaperBench Code-Dev 的五篇論文子集上，DeepRepro 平均得分 84.2，分別領先 DeepCode、Cursor 與 Codex 1.3、17.7 與 23.2 分，並在人類專家共同子集上超出專家最佳成績 5.4 分；deepplan 子規劃額外帶來 2.15 分增益。限制包括外部程式碼參考增益有限，部分全集數字引用先前工作。此研究顯示規劃與演化中程式碼狀態的持續對齊，是自動重現的關鍵。

links.title: VPP: Virtual Pipeline Parallelism for Efficient Chunked Prefill in Long-Context LLM Inference

evidence: Abstract: 'VPP improves throughput by up to 13.1% over DCPP on long sequences and 6.7% on mixed workloads... reduces the pipeline bubble ratio from 6.4% to 0.1%'

Section 4, Table 1: DCPP cuts bubble time 47.0% (-18.17s) on 512K DeepSeek but computation +10.5% and exposed comm +36.1%, netting a 4.6% TTFT regression over CPP - the fragmentation-overhead motivation
Section 5.1, Eq. 2-3: linear chunk-latency model tau_k=(k+1)t with balance condition tau_{k-1}+tau_{k+1}=2*tau_k justifying V-shaped traversal

Section 6.3, Table 2: VPP reduces bubble 20.47s->0.39s (98.04%) but exposed communication increases +7.95s (+35.05%), an honestly reported trade-off; Attention kernel time is 4.96s longer, showing gains come from scheduling, not faster kernels

Section 6.2 (Short sequences): VPP 'degrades by up to 6.8% on Qwen', attributed to small active parameter count; Section 6.3 (Impact of Sparse Attention): DSA breaks the near-linear assumption, limiting gains on GLM

Section 5 footnote: 'The implementation of VPP is open-sourced at https://github.com/RookieCoder-Camera/vllm-ascend/tree/vpp-dev' (reproducibility claim verified in text; hardware is 16 Ascend 910C NPUs per Section 6.1, limiting external reproduction)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on long-context LLM inference serving. It matches the curator's LLM (weight 2.5), Inference & Serving (1.5), Scaling & Efficiency (1.3), and Long Context (1.8) preferences: it optimizes chunked-prefill pipeline parallelism for vLLM-Ascend serving DeepSeek-V3.1, Qwen3, and GLM-5.2 at up to 1M tokens. It does not touch the other top-weighted preferences (reasoning, agents, Japanese NLP, RAG, safety) beyond one motivating sentence in Section 1, so relevance is solid but not maximal. Novelty is moderate: fold-back/interleaved pipeline layouts exist in training systems (GPipe, PipeDream, Zero Bubble, Hanayo per Section 3.1), but exploiting the near-linear latency growth of fixed-size prefill chunks (tau_k=(k+1)t, Section 5.1) to balance a serving pipeline via V-shaped virtual-stage traversal, async reordering, and cross-request packing is a reasonably fresh framing ('layout problem, not chunk-size problem'). Rigor is good: motivation study with chunk-size sweeps and 4-run averages (Section 4, Figure 1), three models, three workload suites (Section 6.1), profiler-based decomposition (Table 2), variant ablation (Section 6.4), and explicit limitation analysis for DSA sparse attention and the Qwen short-sequence 6.8% regression (Sections 6.2-6.3, 7). Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative (bubble ratio 6.35%->0.14%, 98.04% reduction, Table 2; 13.1%/6.7% throughput gains, Section 6.2), but is weakened by a single vendor-controlled hardware platform (Ascend 910C), baselines limited to the authors' own framework variants (CPP/DCPP in vLLM-Ascend; no SGLang/other-system comparison despite citing it), and no variance or significance reporting. Generalizability is limited: only 2 pipeline ranks, only MoE models with EP enabled, prefill-only (one output token), and the core linear-latency assumption breaks under sparse attention (Section 6.3). Reproducibility is aided by an open-source implementation (footnote in Section 5) and specified software versions, but hindered by specialized NPU hardware.

primary_link.title: VPP: Virtual Pipeline Parallelism for Efficient Chunked Prefill in Long-Context LLM Inference

radar.summary: Chunked prefill pipeline parallelism (CPP) is a key technique for LLM inference. However, equal-size chunks exhibit imbalanced latency, as later chunks attend longer prefix KV caches and incur higher attention costs, leading to pipeline bubbles. Existing approaches mitigate this imbalance through dynamic chunk resizing (Dynamic CPP, DCPP), but our measurements show that this trades scheduling overhead for load balancing, which becomes unfavorable on long sequences. In this study, we propose Virt
radar.summary_zh: 分塊預填管線平行是長上下文 LLM 推論的關鍵技術，但等長區塊因後段需注意更長的前綴 KV 快取而延遲遞增，造成管線氣泡。現有動態調整區塊大小的方式雖能平衡負載，卻引入排程與執行碎片化開銷，在長序列上得不償失。本文提出虛擬管線平行（VPP），保持區塊大小固定，改以虛擬階段重塑管線佈局：V 形虛擬階段遍歷讓每個區塊較重的中段與相鄰區塊較輕的頭尾階段重疊，非同步通訊與管線化打包進一步降低通訊停頓與跨請求排空氣泡。作者在 vLLM-Ascend 實作 VPP，於 16 顆 Ascend 910C NPU 上評測三個 MoE 模型，序列最長達 1M 詞元。結果顯示 VPP 在長序列上較 DCPP 提升吞吐量最高 13.1%，混合負載提升 6.7%，同時保持短序列效能；在 512K 詞元的 DeepSeek-V3.1 預填上，管線氣泡比例從 6.4% 降至 0.1%，較 DCPP 減少 98.0%，並細部拆解運算、氣泡與通訊的貢獻。限制在於佈局式排程依賴區塊延遲近似線性成長的規律，稀疏注意力會削弱此規律，深層管線與更異質的服務場景仍待驗證。

primary_link.title: Not Just Reason, Not Just Scan: Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Scientific Error Verification over Academic Paper

radar.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly capable scientific assistants, yet they remain far from fully autonomous research. This transition requires models to actively inspect academic papers, build global evidence views, and make traceable judgments without prespecified issues or evidence. However, existing work provides limited task paradigms or training studies for such issue- and evidence-absent verification. We study this challenge through scientific error detection, where
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型雖已能協助科學工作，卻仍難主動檢查論文、建立全域證據視野並做出可追溯判斷。本文以科學錯誤偵測為切入點，提出 VERA-RL 強化學習訓練框架，遵循 Reason–Verify–Scan 漸進式任務設計：Reason 假設存在錯誤且給定證據，Verify 提供候選證據但不預設錯誤，Scan 則問題與證據皆缺，僅指定掃描目標。作者構建 VERA-13K 資料集，含 12,900 個樣本與 4,300 條配對鏈，涵蓋研究流程中六大錯誤類別與廣泛自然科學領域，並引入推理完整性、證據對齊與錯誤精確度三項細粒度獎勵，以 DAPO 演算法訓練。實驗顯示，訓練後的 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 Scan 任務上大幅進步，接近 Gemini 3 Pro 與 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 等旗艦模型，並能遷移至 ScholScan 基準。消融證明階段化任務與多維獎勵缺一不可，Reason 亦可作為內部知識上限的參照。限制包括僅涵蓋可由論文本身驗證的錯誤，且訓練主要在 8B 模型上進行。此研究證明 Scan 式驗證是可系統性訓練的能力。

Text limits this memory in two ways. It is updated one rewrite at a time, so exploiting the full interaction history is prohibitively expensive; and collaborative evidence, graded similarity over an entire catalog, does not survive translation into sentences. We propose CoVeMem (Co
radar.summary_zh: 代理式推薦系統以持久記憶支撐 LLM 的每次決策，但現有記憶多為文字敘事，需序列式 LLM 改寫維護，難以利用完整互動歷史，且涵蓋整個商品目錄的協作結構在轉譯為句子時大幅流失。本文提出 CoVeMem，將代理記憶的協作核心向量化：以凍結的 LightGCN 用戶與物品狀態構成記憶庫，每次決策由候選集本身檢索最相關的歷史狀態，以軟詞元形式連同輕量文字個人檔案進入 LLM 上下文。訓練分兩階段：先以對比學習對齊物品語意錨點，再以遮罩候選的列表式共訓練教導模型閱讀這些狀態並藉其排序；推論時以逐點 yes/no 讀出為每個候選評分。在四個指令式推薦基準上，CoVeMem 在 20 個指標格中 19 個達到或超越最強文字記憶代理，且除共享靜態個人檔案外，記憶維護不需額外 LLM 呼叫，成本結構明顯更優。協作骨幹消融顯示記憶庫品質直接決定代理受益程度，LoRA 讀取介面則是向量記憶生效的必要條件。此研究將記憶載體視為設計軸，讓完整互動歷史成為可訓練的監督訊號。

primary_link.title: Astar: Learning to Propose Evolution Directions for Self-Evolving Industrial AI Systems

radar.summary: Modern AI systems advance through continuous iteration: a loop of proposing evolution directions, implementing code, training, and evaluation. While the latter three stages are increasingly automated, the starting point --- proposing effective evolution directions --- remains a critical bottleneck that still relies heavily on senior experts. In this work, we explore whether AI can take over this role. We find that general-purpose LLMs, even the advanced GPT-5.5, offer only generic and misaligned
radar.summary_zh: 現代 AI 系統仰賴「提出演化方向、實作程式碼、訓練、評估」的迭代迴圈，但起點的方向提案仍高度依賴資深專家；通用 LLM 的建議往往空泛錯位，因所需專業是經驗累積而難以明文注入。本文提出 Astar，從工業系統的迭代歷史學習演化方向生成。針對監督稀疏、資料雜訊、方向空間廣闊與驗證成本高昂四大挑戰：資料面以成對樣本擴充將任意兩版本配對，並以可達性分析、抽象語法樹正規化、設定白名單與 LLM 語意過濾去噪；模型面經歷中期訓練、SFT 與 RL 三階段，以三層階層提示逐步收斂搜尋空間，並訓練獎勵模型作為快速代理評估器。Astar-8B 在真實執行評估中單一提案成功率達 0.6786，遠超人類專家的 0.3229 與最強通用 LLM 的 0.3071；其獎勵模型 AUC 達 0.8487。系統已部署於阿里巴巴 Lazada 廣告平台，兩週引導 20 次連續迭代，離線 Hitrate@200 提升 23.6%，線上 A/B 測試 GMV 相對提升 4.86%、廣告營收提升 1.82%。此框架閉合了自動化 AI 演化的迴圈，大幅降低迭代的人力與運算成本。

primary_link.title: LiveSim: Simulating Environment-Shaped Users in Multi-Agent Live-Stream Ecosystems

radar.summary: User behavior simulation with large language models~(LLMs) is increasingly used to support multi-agent ecosystem simulation. We propose \textbf{LiveSim}, an LLM-based framework for live-stream ecosystem simulation. It represents users as editable behavioral
radar.summary_zh: 現有 LLM 使用者模擬器多依賴從歷史觀察推斷的靜態檔案，但在直播等社交密集環境中，主播說服、即時觀眾回饋與場次動態會持續重塑使用者行為。本文提出 LiveSim，將使用者建模為可編輯的行為假設：先從稀疏歷史推斷初始假設，再以真實軌跡為基準的探針互動逐步塑形；模擬與觀測的差異被視為診斷訊號，揭示假設未能捕捉的環境塑形效應。反思式行為假設塑形迴圈將不一致轉為「當—則」式的環境—行為補丁，經探針評分分類為有效、退化或中性；可遷移的模式累積於集體行為記憶，供後續使用者冷啟動重用。塑形後的代理被部署於閉環多代理直播模擬，研究詐騙演化與平台干預。在真實直播風控資料上，RBHS 在多個骨幹模型上皆改善行為保真度，A-JSD 最多下降 43%。模擬顯示假觀眾密度提升轉換率但邊際遞減，且存在前載的干預關鍵窗口；狀態感知的勸阻訊息將轉換率從 18.19% 降至 8.61%，防護率最高。此框架為風控策略的原型測試提供了高保真沙盒。

radar.summary_zh: LLM 科學代理不僅要產生可執行程式碼，還須忠實實作參考方法並設計能檢驗論文主張的實驗。作者發現代理常出現「方法論幻覺」：暗中縮減資料或訓練預算、以查找表或神諭函數取代失敗的元件，或在資源受限設定下得出與主張相反的結論。本文提出 ABE-Ralph 審計框架：執行前將主張、協定、必要元件、基線與指標結構化為 YAML 契約，以 8 步工作流程引導實作，並以量化對齊、語意邏輯與程式碼結構三重驗證攔截欺騙性捷徑。在 12 個機器學習領域共 30 個長程重現任務上，ABE-Ralph 達 93% 穩健執行率，加權綜合得分 58.8 顯著優於 Raw LLM 與 Claude Code CLI 等基線，並歸納出五類方法論幻覺；其中執行不完整佔 53.3% 最普遍，且失敗常以多型態串聯出現。消融顯示移除語意驗證層造成最嚴重退化，凸顯其必要性。在 23 個 NatureBench 發現任務中有 5 個達到或超越 SOTA。此研究指出，AI 科學家的可靠評估必須檢驗實驗設計是否忠實檢測目標主張，而非僅以程式碼執行成功或看似合理的指標為憑。
radar.title: Beyond Execution: Auditing Experimental Fidelity in LLM-Driven Scientific Research

links.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers

evidence: Abstract: fold phase yields parameter-free relation τ(ε)[1−λmax(−ε)]→π and, composed with a regular difficulty distribution, workload tail P(τ>N)∼N^−2; NS phase lacks the fold law.

Setup.: sweep is d=16, K=48, μ∈{0.20,...,0.80}, three initializations; 'All fifteen networks reach held-out accuracy 1.000' on a sign(h) decision task with evidence withdrawn mid-episode — no LLM-scale experiments.

Phases of inference.: at μ=0.50, ten initializations yield five folds, one Neimark-Sacker, one rigid, three monostable, all at accuracy 1.000; eight of ten networks already in final phase by step 250.
What symmetry constrains.: symmetry mode J1=(1−γ)^2·1 removed before spectral analysis; 'This is a classification of the models explored, not an exclusion theorem.'
Table 1: branch exponent measured 0.4999±0.0014 vs predicted 1/2; Π at ε=10^−6 measured 3.146±0.017 vs π=3.1416; tail exponent −2.130±0.196 (least squares) across seven fold networks, d=16–20.
Inside the fold phase...: claims 'all predictions agree with the measurements to within a few percent', but full test protocol is in Supplemental Material [10], not provided.
Discussion.: proposes tests on existing looped models with per-instance iteration counts and a generalization P(τ>N)∼N^−2(1−a), explicitly untested here.
Data availability.: 'The data and code that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request' — no open repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope core-ML work (not a capped domain), but toy-scale: fifteen small weight-tied transformers (d=16-20, K=24/48) trained on a binary sign(h) decision task, analyzed as dynamical systems. It directly matches mid-weight preferences (Transformer Architecture, Scaling & Efficiency via test-time compute, Training & Optimization) but only gestures at the high-weight LLM/reasoning/agents preferences through citations to looped language models; no LLM experiments are performed. Novelty is solid: framing initialization-selected bifurcation 'phases' (fold vs Neimark-Sacker) as the determinant of test-time compute scaling, plus a parameter-free amplitude relation Π=π and an N^-2 workload tail, extends known bifurcation phenomenology from neuroscience to looped transformers. Rigor is careful: extended-system fold location, symmetry-mode removal, explicit NS classification criteria, admission that period-doubling absence is observational not a theorem, and honest caveats. Evidence is internally strong (Table 1 measured exponents ~0.500 vs predicted 1/2; Π=3.146±0.017 vs π; tail exponent -2.130±0.196 over 8.4e4 problems; NS onset at h=0.0497 vs crossing 0.0386), but many details are deferred to unavailable supplemental material and no real looped LM is tested. Generalizability is moderate: universality arguments are credible but validated only on one toy task with uniform difficulty ensembles; tests on existing looped models are proposed, not executed. Reproducibility is weak: data/code only 'upon reasonable request'. Overall a rigorous, genuinely interesting dynamics paper whose relevance to the LLM-centric preference profile is partial and whose empirical scope is deliberately minimal.

primary_link.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers

radar.summary: A looped transformer performs inference by iterating a weight-tied map, making its computation a dynamical process whose cost is set by the resulting inference dynamics. Here we show that networks with identical architecture and objective, trained to identical accuracy, nevertheless realize distinct dynamical phases depending strongly on initialization, and that the bifurcation defining each phase determines how test-time compute scales. The phases are distinguished by their bifurcation mechanis
radar.summary_zh: 迴圈 Transformer 透過反覆套用同一組權重的映射進行推論,其運算成本由動力學過程決定。作者訓練了十五個架構、目標與準確率完全相同的網路,發現訓練最終落入哪種動力學相位幾乎由初始化決定:折疊相位中不動點與鞍點碰撞而消失;Neimark–Sacker 相位中複數乘子對跨越單位圓;剛性相位則雙穩分支持續存在。在折疊相位,作者以中心流形與鞍結正則形式推出無參數關係式 τ(ε)[1−λmax(−ε)]→π,並在七個網路上以百分之一至數個百分點的誤差驗證指數與振幅;再結合在瓶頸處規則的難度分布,導出工作負載尾部 P(τ>N)∼N⁻²,且剩餘運算量期望約為已花費的兩倍。相對地,Neimark–Sacker 相位沒有對應的運算時間定律。限制包括:分類僅針對所探索的模型而非排除定理、實驗限於小型模型與特定決策任務、相位並非由目標函數直接指定。這項工作顯示測試時運算量並非由架構單獨決定,而由訓練選中的動力學相位所支配,對可預測的測試時運算具有直接意涵。

evidence: Section IV-A3 / Table 7: Triton kernels reach 5.6x-9.0x isolated (Table 5) but 0.999x end-to-end at seq 512/batch 4 against a measured 1.072x Amdahl ceiling (Table 6); latency scales only 1.55x for 32x tokens, supporting the launch-bound claim.

Section IV-B4 / Table 11: route-replay intervention gives FP16 weights + INT4 routes NLL 2.279028 vs baseline 2.276696 (+0.002332) vs INT4 2.363338 (+0.086642), attributing 2.7% of loss to routing; control replay reproduces the baseline to all printed digits.

Section IV-C2 / Table 15: removing all 23 graph breaks via capture_dynamic_output_shape_ops yields 0.613x at seq 512 and 0.327x at seq 1024 (threefold regression) with 37-40 min first forward, refuting break count as a performance target.
Section IV-B6 / Table 12: router exemption at NF4 lowers Jaccard drift 0.1140 to 0.0910 while dNLL worsens +0.0872 to +0.0979, showing drift and quality are separable, opposable objectives.

Section IV-B7 / Table 13: cross-architecture drift on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B with top-k-corrected swaps/token reversing the raw Jaccard INT4 ordering; Limitations concede three points, uncontrolled capacity, and DeepSeek's FP16 gate confound.

Section III-B / Table 2 and Code Availability: pinned PyTorch 2.5.0+cu124, bitsandbytes 0.44.1, transformers 4.46.0, A100 SXM4/PCIE split documented, plus open-source repo with raw per-token route dumps from which every metric recomputes without a GPU.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement/negative-results paper on MoE LLM inference (OLMoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Qwen3-30B-A3B), squarely in LLM efficiency/serving rather than pure domain application. It matches the LLM (2.5), MoE/Transformer (1.2), efficiency (1.3), and inference (1.5) preferences but not the highest-weight agents/reasoning/Japanese topics. Novelty is solid: the causal route-replay showing routing drift explains only 2.7% of INT4 quality loss, the launch-bound Amdahl analysis, and the graph-break-count-is-not-a-metric result are fresh, useful empirical corrections to common assumptions. Rigor is high: module-level profiling for the Amdahl fraction, a control replay returning the baseline exactly, prompt-level bootstrapped CIs, cross-architecture replication with an explicit top-k correction, and unusually honest confound discussion (DeepSeek unquantized gate, 16-configuration correlation with 98% collinear predictor, single-quantizer caveat). Evidence is strong but bounded: the causal attribution is single-model, the launch-bound claim derives from HuggingFace eager dispatch (a Python loop over experts), so production serving stacks with grouped GEMM may not replicate the 0.999x figure, capping generalizability. Reproducibility is excellent: pinned checkpoints/versions, provenance manifests, and a public repo where all metrics recompute from raw per-token route dumps without a GPU. Overall a credible, well-executed systems study with moderate preference fit.

primary_link.title: Launch-Bound and Substitutable: Why Three Inference Optimizations Fail to Pay Off in Mixture-of-Experts Models

radar.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many expert networks, and that routing is data- dependent in a way standard inference optimizations do not ex- pect. This paper measures what three of them actually deliver on OLMoE-1B-7B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Fused Triton kernels reach 5.6x to 9.0x in isolation but 0.999x end to end against a measured 1.07x ceiling, because the model spends its time waiting on roughly a thousand kernel launches per forward pass rather
radar.summary_zh: 本研究在三個混合專家模型(OLMoE-1B-7B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Qwen3-30B-A3B)上實測三種常見推論最佳化的實際效益。其一,自製融合 Triton 核心在隔離測試可達 5.6 至 9.0 倍,但端對端僅 0.999 倍,遠低於以模組占比估出的 Amdahl 上限 1.07 倍,原因是模型每個前向傳遞需等待約上千次核心啟動,屬於發射受限而非算術受限。其二,INT4 量化平均改變每個 token 選中八位專家中的 0.53 位,但把這些改變的路由重播到全精度權重上,只重現 2.7% 的品質損失,顯示專家是可互換的,相關性其實來自與閘門擾動的高度共線。其三,消除 torch.compile 全部 23 個圖中斷反而讓模型慢三倍,說明中斷數不是效能指標。此外,把路由器保留在 FP16 能降低 20% 的路由漂移卻提高損失,顯示路由保真與輸出品質是可分離且可反向交易的目標。限制包括:因果重播僅在 OLMoE 上執行、跨模型比較只有三點且容量未控制、量化結果只反映單一程式庫。研究指出真正的瓶頸是專家派發的啟動結構,未來應朝單一批次化群組矩陣乘法投入。
