links.title: Representation Measurements Under Function-Preserving Reparameterizations

evidence: Section 4.1: 'numerical verification confirmed that all 25 transformations preserved the evaluated behavior... maximum absolute teacher-forced log-probability error was below 10^-4' on ten prompts.

Section 4.2 / Table 3: across 75 model-domain-transformation comparisons, median PA component-count disagreement 0.79, fixed-threshold decision disagreement 0.26, within-question ordering reversal 0.10.

Section 4.3 / Table 4: no-reparameterization independent-seed rate 0.06 vs reparameterization 0.76 (paired difference 0.69, bootstrap 95% (0.625,0.880), sign test p=4.88e-4); seed-only changes none of 1,200 decisions.
Section 4.3 (centering-only arm): 1,141 of 1,200 contexts change selected component count with max relative observed-eigenvalue error 1.26e-6, isolating the reference-distribution mechanism.

Section 4.4 / Table 5: median held-out AUROC 0.712 (ridge-shrinkage), 0.703 (PA-selected), 0.689 (answer log-probability) across 15 model-domain combinations; 'representation-based scores do not consistently outperform answer log-probability'.
Section 4.5 / Table 6: median disagreement rate remains between 0.86 and 0.99 across the complete 72-setting factorial grid.

Theorem 3 / Corollary 1: no data-internal reference procedure can simultaneously preserve coordinate marginals, be O(d)-equivariant, and alter covariance; Section 5 notes the result 'requires the full orthogonal group O(d)' and has not been extended to the LayerNorm subgroup.
Section 5 limitations: five small open-weight models (0.5B-1.7B), one independent seed-control rerun, one fixed transformation (seed 101) for the standardization ablation and robustness grid.

Section 7: public GitHub repo with protocols (publication_protocol., missing_controls_protocol., robustness_protocol.), fixed seeds, and context-level outputs so tables/figures 'can be regenerated without repeating model inference'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful measurement-validity study showing that column-permutation parallel analysis on LLM hidden representations is not invariant to function-preserving orthogonal reparameterizations, with proofs (marginal-preservation impossibility, spectrum-conditioned range bound) and matched controls. Preference relevance is solid but not core-topic: it targets LLM internal representations and probing-style measurement (interpretability-adjacent) within a retrieval context-sufficiency case study the authors explicitly frame as 'a representative case study rather than a proposed retrieval evaluator', so LLM and interpretability preferences are genuinely served while RAG/agents/alignment cores are only touched. Novelty is moderate-to-high: the invariance-as-intervention framing extends Dinh et al.-style symmetry logic to representation statistics, and the impossibility theorem plus PA-specific constructions appear new, though Gram-matrix invariance (CKA/RSA) is standard and basis-dependence of permutation references is intuitive once stated. Rigor is strong: pre-registered vs post-hoc protocol separation, numerical verification of behavior preservation (<1e-4 log-prob error), seed-only and centering-only controls isolating the mechanism, a 72-setting robustness grid, and honest limitations (one-rerun seed control, one transformation per robustness setting, impossibility result restricted to full O(d), structured rather than Haar rotations for RMSNorm). Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative (median decision disagreement 0.26 vs 0.00 seed control; 1,141/1,200 count changes under centering-only with eigenvalue error 1.26e-6; invariant comparators stable at ~1e-8), though absolute count shifts are modest (median 2 on a median of 39) and scale is limited to five 0.5B-1.7B models. Generalizability is constrained by small models, one pipeline, three QA domains, and subgroup caveats; reproducibility is strong with public code, fixed seeds, JSON protocols, and stored intermediate results.

primary_link.title: Representation Measurements Under Function-Preserving Reparameterizations

This study shows that column-permutation parallel analysis violates function-preserving reparameterization invariance because its reference distribution and selected component count can change while the model function and observed covariance spectrum remain fixed. More generally, a data-internal reference
radar.summary_zh: 語言模型的隱藏座標並非由其輸入輸出函數唯一決定,因此以表徵為基礎的測量應對函數保持的再參數化保持不變。本文以欄置換平行分析(PA)在檢索情境測量管線中檢驗此準則:理論上,正交旋轉保持觀測共變異數譜不變,卻改變置換參考分布所依賴的共變異數對角線;作者並證明任何僅由資料內部建構的參考產生流程,無法同時保留每個座標的經驗邊際分布、具正交等變性、又去除跨座標共變異。實驗涵蓋五個模型、三個檢索領域與 75 個轉換:元件數不一致的中位數為 0.79,固定門檻決策不一致為 0.26;僅置中對照下,觀測譜完全不變,1,200 個情境仍有 1,141 個元件數改變,遠大於僅更換隨機種子時的零變動。改用基於 Gram 矩陣的正交不變比較分數後,數值完全穩定且保留相近的判別力(各分數中位 AUROC 差距在 0.023 內)。限制包含僅測試小型開源模型,且一般性定理需要完整正交群,LayerNorm 情境另行構造處理。結果顯示表徵統計量在解讀為模型性質之前,應先檢驗其對架構相容、函數保持再參數化的不變性。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed retrieval benchmark paper defining relation-conditioned 'ideation move' retrieval (Address/Broaden/Specify) over scientific full text. Preference relevance is moderate: it squarely serves RAG/knowledge-retrieval and benchmark/evaluation interests and uses LLMs as calibrated judges and marker generators, but LLMs are tools rather than the object of study, and there is no Japanese/NLP, agentic, or reasoning-model contribution. Novelty is strong: extending discourse-marker distant supervision from sentence-pair classification (SciNLI, Sileo et al.) to corpus-scale retrieval with typed operations, distractor markers, and temporal splits is a clear methodological advance over MIR and LitSearch. Rigor is high: multi-stage lexicon vetting (4,252 markers, 809 validated, Sec 4.1/Table 2), human-calibrated LLM filtering with reported F1 (.83-.87) and inter-annotator agreement (.87/.90/.82, Table 10), contamination-resistant temporal splits (Sec 4.2), an oracle analysis ruling out operation-classifier shortcuts (Sec 5.2), false-negative-aware top-K judging (Sec 5.4, Table 16), and position-bias-controlled pairwise judging with significance tests (Table 17). Evidence is extensive and mostly internally consistent across Tables 3, 4, 8, 9, and 13-16; main caveats are reliance on a single LLM judge (GPT-5.4) for candidate-level and inspiration-potential judgments and only 400 queries per relation for those analyses. Generalizability is decent but bounded: CS-domain, sentence-level, adjacent-pair supervision only, with the extension recipe asserted rather than demonstrated. Reproducibility is good: hyperparameters (Table 7), prompts (Appendix I), training compute (1,800 GPU hours, Sec 5.1), and stated project/data/GitHub releases, though URLs and the lexicon release are promises in the text (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature

radar.summary: Retrieved scientific literature can serve as inspiration for both human and AI scientists. Inspiration can take different forms: prior work may directly suggest how to address a problem, or surface directions at different levels of abstraction - zooming out to a more general view or zooming in to a concrete realization. We introduce RATIO (Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations), a large-scale benchmark in which relevance is defined by three operations which we name ideation moves: Address r
radar.summary_zh: RATIO 是一個科學靈感檢索基準,其相關性由三種構思操作定義:Address 檢索針對所陳述問題的可能方法、Broaden 檢索更一般的表述、Specify 檢索具體實例。語料由數百萬篇全文論文以話語標記遠端監督擴建而成——先前此類標記僅用於句對分類——並結合多階段 LLM 生成與人工審核,產生超過三百萬個查詢—正例對,以時間切分避免汙染,另建經人工校準的 LLM 驗證之 silver 測試集。實驗顯示通用檢索器(含 BM25)難以捕捉這些構思操作;針對操作的對比微調帶來大幅提升,ModernBERT-embed-large 在各操作上最佳,但絕對效能仍然有限,顯示任務遠未解決。Top-K 候選評估進一步發現:挖掘出的正例並非唯一有效靈感,微調後的 Address 檢索器在 41.2% 的查詢上,即使標註正例未進入前十名,仍有替代候選獲得評審接受,且多來自跨論文;在參考自由的靈感潛力評比中,微調檢索器在三個操作上皆被偏好。限制包括僅涵蓋三種操作、以相鄰句對與 CS 領域為主。RATIO 為文獻扎根的構思系統提供可擴充的訓練與評測基礎。

links.title: Direct or Mediated? Task-Dependent Audio Information Routing in Large Audio Language Models

evidence: Abstract: two-segment concatenation yields a task-dependent gap where ASR remains stable while AQA degrades substantially; layer-wise attention knockout shows ASR uses direct audio-token retrieval whereas AQA depends on a prompt-mediated route.

Table 1 / Concatenated-Audio Evaluation Setting: under concatenation, WER rises only 0.10-1.30 percentage points across four models, while concatenated AQA accuracy falls to 35.33-67.33% for three models (Qwen3-Omni retains 82.67-88.67%) versus 85.17-98.00% single-segment controls.

Limitations: the knockout analysis is indirect - interventions are applied only to standard benchmark examples solved reliably under clean inference, so results characterize pathways supporting successful prediction and do not directly identify where computation fails in incorrect concatenated-AQA cases.

Layer-Wise Probing Setting: probes use 60%/20%/20% splits with speaker-level (SpeechCommands), track-level (GTZAN), and recording-level (ESC-50) disjointness; AdamW lr 1e-3, batch 256, early stopping patience 5.

Experiments / Figure 2 discussion: best macro-averaged probing accuracies range from 67.0% (Step-Audio-R1 on GTZAN) to 90.1% (Audio-Flamingo-Next on GTZAN), showing task-relevant attributes remain linearly decodable from prompt-token states despite low AQA accuracy.

Attention-Knockout Setting: five-layer sliding-window interventions on three pathways (P<-A, Y<-A, Y<-P) evaluated on LibriSpeech ASR and MMAU test-mini AQA; effect magnitudes are reported only qualitatively via Figure 1, with no numeric effect sizes or confidence intervals in the text, and no code or artifact release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability study of LLM-based audio models (Qwen3-Omni, MiMo-Audio, Audio-Flamingo-Next, Step-Audio-R1), so it sits inside scope via LLMs/interpretability/multimodal preferences, though the audio domain is a low-weighted preference and there is no core LLM-methodology contribution. Novelty is moderate: attention knockout and layer-wise probing are established techniques transferred from VLM analyses (cited in Related Work), with a new two-segment concatenation setting and a genuinely new direct-vs-mediated routing finding. Rigor is solid: single-segment controls, four models, three AQA datasets, leakage-controlled probe splits, and honest caveats that knockout renormalizes attention. The main weakness is a structural disconnect the authors admit in Limitations: knockout is run on reliably solved LibriSpeech/MMAU single-segment inputs, not on the failing concatenated condition, so the routing analysis supports success-pathway differences rather than explaining the failure directly; no statistical uncertainty is reported and knockout effect magnitudes appear only in figures without numbers. Evidence for the behavioral gap (Table 1) is concrete and strong; mechanistic claims are more hedged. Generalizability is limited to two-segment waveform concatenation by the authors' own admission. Reproducibility benefits from public datasets/models and detailed probe training specs but lacks a code/data release, prompt templates, and per-condition example counts.

primary_link.title: Direct or Mediated? Task-Dependent Audio Information Routing in Large Audio Language Models

radar.summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of audio understanding tasks. However, they are typically evaluated on single, coherent audio segments, leaving their behavior under less familiar input configurations underexplored. We study this issue through a controlled setting in which two audio segments are concatenated into a single input. Across multiple LALMs, we observe a striking task-dependent robustness gap: automatic speech recognition (ASR
radar.summary_zh: 大型音訊語言模型(LALM)在熟悉輸入下表現良好,但其在非典型配置下的行為尚待探究。本文以控制式雙段音訊波形串接為實驗設定,在四個 LALM 上發現顯著的任務依賴穩健性落差:語音辨識(ASR)串接後字詞錯誤率僅小幅上升,而音訊問答(AQA)在內容、順序、位置三類問題上大幅退化,儘管單段控制實驗證明模型具備基本屬性辨識能力。透過逐層注意力 knockout 追蹤資訊路徑,結果顯示兩個任務依賴不同路徑:ASR 主要靠答案 token 直接從音訊 token 檢索資訊;AQA 則更依賴音訊先整合進提示 token、生成時再存取的仲介路徑。逐層線性探針進一步顯示,即使 AQA 效能銳減,任務相關音訊屬性在中後層提示 token 表徵中仍可線性解碼,代表失敗並非音訊資訊完全消失,而較符合下游在答案生成時利用仲介資訊的瓶頸。限制包含 knockout 屬間接證據且僅套用於乾淨可解的樣本、雙段串接只是多音訊輸入的簡化形式、無法精確定位失效電路。這些發現揭示 LALM 的音訊資訊路由具任務依賴性,並凸顯資訊利用是泛化的潛在限制。
radar.title: Direct or Mediated? Task-Dependent Audio Information Routing in Large Audio Language Models
radar.title_zh: 直接或仲介?大型音訊語言模型中依任務而異的音訊資訊路由

links.title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy

evidence: Abstract/Sec 1: leave-one-out probe shows attention magnitude uncorrelated with causal marginal utility (Spearman rho=-0.004, p=0.96, n=136 chunks, Sec 2.1/Figure 1a).
Sec 3.4: repair pass swaps orphans for redundant donors holding |S1|=|S0|=K exactly, never altering the wrapped policy's scoring rule or budget.

Sec 4.1: evaluation grid of four wrapped policies (StreamingLLM, PyramidKV, SnapKV, ExpectedAttention) across LongBench (16 sub-tasks), LooGLE, RULER, and MMLU-Pro at ratios {0.3,0.5,0.7} on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.2-1B.

Sec 4.2: pooled mean repair improvement on Qwen3-4B over LongBench(excl. TREC)+LooGLE is +0.39/+0.73/+0.66 across ratios; TREC regresses sharply (ExpectedAttention 64.50->23.00 at ratio 0.7) and a threshold/window sweep is labeled diagnostic-only, not per-task tuning.

Sec 4.3/Table 3: on RULER Qwen3-4B the repair helps StreamingLLM/PyramidKV/SnapKV in all 9 cells (PyramidKV mean +21.86) but ExpectedAttention loses at all 9 cells (mean -6.72), attributed to a ceiling effect; RULER uses a 5% dev-slice (Sec 4.1).
Sec 4.4: Llama-3.2-1B requires a one-time threshold recalibration from 0.85 to 0.90 justified by a dev-slice sweep on its weakest tasks, tied to Qwen3's per-head key RMSNorm.
Sec 3.5: the repair pass adds O(n^2 d) prefill cost per head per layer; an O(nKd) restriction is acknowledged but left to future work.
No code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the supplied document; defaults (tau=0.85, w=32, sink=4, recent=64) are fully specified in Sec 3.2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM long-context inference methodology (KV cache eviction), squarely within preferred topics (LLMs, long context, efficiency, serving). The composable repair-pass framing (orphan/donor swaps holding budget fixed) is a genuinely distinct deployment mechanism versus standalone scorers, and the leave-one-out probe (Spearman rho=-0.004, n=136 chunks) is a motivating but small-scale analysis; the underlying pairwise key-redundancy signal overlaps with concurrent R-KV and is adjacent to KeyDiff. Rigor is solid: 4 policies x 4 suites x 2 models x 3 ratios, full Alone/+Rep tables, a no-op unit test, a TREC diagnostic sweep, and unusually honest reporting of negative results (ExpectedAttention regressions, MMLU-Pro no-harm failures, per-model threshold recalibration to tau=0.90). Evidence strength is capped by modest and mixed headline gains (pooled LongBench/LooGLE means +0.39 to +0.73 on Qwen3-4B), majority-of-cells wins for only two of four policies, a 5% dev-slice on RULER, no CIs/significance tests, and the tiny motivation probe. Generalizability is limited by per-architecture threshold recalibration, task-dependent failure modes (TREC), small models only (1B/4B), and an unaddressed O(n^2 d) prefill cost. No code release is stated despite fully specified defaults (tau, w, sink, recent), which caps reproducibility.

primary_link.title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy

radar.summary: Long-context inference is bottlenecked by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, especially for small models under tight resource budgets. Existing KV cache eviction methods score tokens using the model's attention distribution or, in attention-free variants, each key's distance from a global reference point. Using a controlled leave-one-out probe, we find that attention magnitude is unrelated to a token's causal contribution to the answer (Spearman $ρ=-0.004$), challenging the premis
radar.summary_zh: 長脈絡推論受 KV 快取記憶體限制,而主流驅逐方法以注意力作為重要性訊號。本文以留一邊際效用探針顯示注意力大小與 token 對答案的真正因果貢獻幾乎無關(Spearman ρ=-0.004),挑戰該前提。作者提出 TwinKV:一種免訓練、不依賴注意力的冗餘訊號,檢查某 token 的鍵向量在脈絡其他位置是否存在近重複副本,以判斷其資訊能否由其餘內容還原。部署上它不作為獨立策略,而是可組合的修復流程:在任一既有驅逐策略固定的保留集合上,偵測「被驅逐卻無存活副本的孤兒」與「被保留卻已有副本的冗餘捐贈者」並互換,嚴格維持原預算,並針對非均勻旋轉排程(如 LongRoPE)推出旋轉不變形式。與四種策略(StreamingLLM、PyramidKV、SnapKV、ExpectedAttention)組合,在 LongBench、LooGLE、RULER 與短脈絡 MMLU-Pro 對照上,以 Qwen3-4B 評估,前兩者多數配置受惠,第三者接近持平,第四者(自適應且接近上限)僅少數受惠;Llama-3.2-1B 上結果混合且於 RULER 全面反轉。限制包含少樣本分類任務 TREC 的假孿生失敗(可由放寬局部視窗緩解)、O(n²d) 的額外計算成本與逐架構門檻重校。整體凸顯注意力訊號不可靠,結構性冗餘是可行的補救訊號。
radar.title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy
radar.title_zh: TwinKV:以成對鍵冗餘為 KV 快取驅逐提供可組合的修復流程

links.title: BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing

evidence: Section 4.1 & Table 3: mean-predictor baselines (0.58/0.48/0.80 MAE); Claude-Haiku-4.5 Health-LLM reaches 0.42 on DiversityOne while many open-source configurations fail to beat the baseline.
Section 3.1: five backbones (Qwen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-v0.3, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B, Claude-Haiku-4.5) evaluated across three agentic paradigms.

Appendix B, Table 7: PHIA mode-collapse rates of 85.9% (GLOBEM) and 77.4% (PMData) with Qwen2.5-14B, plus failure taxonomy F1-F5 (silent execution, state loss, force-finish, magic thresholds, schema-blind aggregation).
Table 3 vs Table 4: DeepSeek PHIA GLOBEM MAE 1.68/+CoT 1.29 (Table 3) contradicts 1.14/+CoT 1.07 under Table 4 'Full' configuration; no explanation given.
Section 3.2 & Appendix D: T2 scored by a single Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct judge (greedy decoding, 8-bit vLLM); Limitations concedes this 'does not replace expert clinical or human-subject evaluation'.
Appendix A, Table 5: public datasets with URLs (DiversityOne, PMData, GLOBEM); 1,355/1,448/1,640 samples; DiversityOne restricted to the Mongolia cohort.
Section 3.3: implementation details given (vLLM on 4x A6000, ReAct capped at 10 iterations, top-3 retrieval), but no repository or code-release statement appears anywhere in the paper.

Section 4.2 & Figure 4: CoT 'improvements up to 41.4%' verifiable against Table 3 (Claude RAG DiversityOne 0.87 to 0.51); claim that only Claude closes the temporal-grounding gap is supported by the Tier-1/Tier-2 judge panels.
Section 4.4, Table 4: Fitbit-only configuration often matches or beats the full mobile+watch setup, supporting the 'semantically meaningful features' design insight.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic-LLM benchmark (prompt/tool/memory paradigms) for longitudinal mental-health score prediction and rationale generation across 3 public wearable datasets, 5 LLM backbones, with and without CoT. Strongly aligned with high-weight preferences (agents & tool use, LLMs, reasoning/CoT, RAG/memory, LLM-as-judge evaluation); the healthcare domain is the setting, but the methodology core is agentic language modeling, so it is not a capped pure-domain application. Strengths: mean-predictor baseline included with honest negative findings (Section 4.1), a detailed PHIA failure taxonomy with mode-collapse rates (Appendix B), sensor-set and look-back ablations (Table 4, Figure 5), and verbatim prompts/judge rubric (Appendix D). No code release is stated, though datasets and infrastructure are well documented. Calibrated overall: solid, transparent benchmark study with moderate novelty and verifiable-but-not-fully-validated evidence.

primary_link.title: BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing

radar.summary: Mental health assessment relies on episodic self-report scales, which convert subjective states such as stress into numerical scores but provide only sparse snapshots of wellbeing. Wearable devices offer longitudinal behavioral and physiological signals for continuous, low-burden monitoring. Recent LLM-driven personal-health agents enable natural language queries over wearable signals, but mainly handle short-term, retrieval-based lookups (e.g., highest step count over a week). They do not evalu
radar.summary_zh: 心理健康評估多仰賴間斷的自陳量表,而可穿戴裝置提供縱向行為與生理訊號,但現有 LLM 代理多僅處理短期事實查詢。BALMS 是首個系統性基準,評估代理式 LLM 在縱向心理健康感知上的能力:涵蓋三個真實資料集(DiversityOne、PMData、GLOBEM)、兩個任務家族(封閉式福祉分數預測,以 MAE 評分;開放式論證生成,以 LLM-as-Judge 評量時間推理與證據扎根),以及提示、工具、記憶三種代理設計與五個開源及閉源骨幹。主要發現:零樣本代理多數無法勝過簡單平均基線,除非使用更強的骨幹或緊湊且語意豐富的特徵;思維鏈提示主要嘉惠推理導向骨幹,但不保證時間扎根與數值正確;工具型代理 PHIA 因靜默程式執行、狀態遺失與魔法數閾值而模式崩塌,僅在與其設計契合的 PMData 上具競爭力;選擇性記憶檢索在長時間窗下最有幫助,而原始高頻感測流反而難以利用。限制包括僅涵蓋代表性設計、回溯性離線評估、以 LLM 評審取代臨床人工評估。BALMS 顯示未來代理需要選擇性檢索歷史、扎根時間證據,並在可解釋的行為特徵上推理。

links.title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents

evidence: Abstract: decoupled approach 'consistently outperforms controller-only and direct VLM action-generation variants' and is 'competitive with strong vision-language-action and multi-agent RL baselines on six of seven tasks'

Sec 4.3, Table 1: GPT-4o planner scores 891 (Atari), 11.7 (MC-Dia), 193.2 (OCook), 70.1 (Pico), 70.2 (MindC) vs Controller-Only 809/8.2/170.2/30.7/40.0 and Direct VLM Finetune 581/10.1/150.1/30.6/38.2

Sec 5: 'We do not claim the slow/fast decomposition as novel'; differences claimed are natural-language interface, world-model controller, and no expert data (BC from post-hoc VLM relabeling of on-policy rollouts)
Sec 3.4 and Sec 4.1: post-hoc instruction annotation uses GPT-4o summarizer on replay segments (50% of buffer), adding ~17% GPU-hours and 12% training slowdown (App A.4)
Table 2: instruction-source ablation on Minecraft Diamond - environment-derived 11.4, VLM-generated 11.1, template 9.9, clustered 8.9, random strings 8.3, no instructions 8.2
Table 3: cross-planner train x eval transfer ranges 9.2-10.2, indicating controller does not overfit to annotating planner
Appendix D: instruction-following accuracy judged by one of the authors on 200 held-out instructions per domain; API model (GPT-5.5) agreement 93.2%; authors flag single-annotator limitation
Sec 4.5 (Controller cost and scope): one 800M controller per environment at ~23 GPU-hours on 4x RTX A6000; joint multi-environment training lost 1.12 points on Minecraft Diamond (~10% relative)
Sec 1 footnote: 'Code and a demo for our project is available at https://zinengtang.github.io/speak-to-act/'
Table 9 (App A.6): online vs offline planning - throughput 37.5 vs 13.4 steps/s on Minecraft Diamond, 169.9 vs 92.7 on Overcooked, with staleness of 51.2 and 165.1 steps respectively
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly matches high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning): VLM planners (GPT-4o, Qwen-VL-2.5-72B, Gemma-3) drive a language-conditioned world-model controller across 7 environments with multi-agent language coordination. Not pure robotics since language methodology (planning, instruction generation, prompting) is central. Novelty is moderate: the authors themselves note the slow/fast planner-controller decomposition is not novel (Sec 5), with the contribution being a language interface, post-hoc VLM instruction relabeling without expert data, and asynchronous inference - useful but incremental over SayCan/HiRT/hierarchical RL. Rigor is solid: reproduced (DreamerV3, QMIX, MAPPO), domain-adapted (RT-2), and contextual baselines are explicitly stratified (Sec 4.3), with extensive ablations (instruction source Table 2, cross-planner matrix Table 3, controller architecture Table 7, online/offline Table 9, failure analysis A.7). Weaknesses: no variance/seed reporting in the main table, instruction-following accuracy (86-97%) judged by a single author with an API-model sanity check (Appendix D caveat), and GPT-4o serves as both annotator and planner. Evidence is concrete and quantitatively supported (e.g., GPT-4o planner 891/11.7/193.2 vs Controller-Only 809/8.2/170.2 in Table 1), though some comparisons are less controlled. Generalizability is mixed: planner swaps transfer without fine-tuning (9.2-10.2 across the Table 3 matrix) and a transformer world model performs comparably (11.2 vs 11.0, Table 7), but controllers are per-environment (~23 GPU-hours each) and joint multi-env training loses ~10% relative on Minecraft Diamond (Sec 4.5). primary_link.title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents

radar.summary: Recent work shows that pre-trained, instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) perform well at mapping from instructions and observations to high-level plans, but struggle to realize such plans as reliable low-latency action sequences in unfamiliar environments. At the same time, world-model controllers excel at fast observation-to-action control, but lack open-ended task guidance. In this work, we combine these strengths into a single system, Instruct-to-Act, where we train a world-model c
radar.summary_zh: 預訓練視覺語言模型(VLM)善於從指令與觀察產生高層計畫,卻難以在陌生環境中即時產生可靠且低延遲的動作序列;世界模型控制器則擅長快速的控制,卻缺乏開放式任務引導。本文提出 Instruct-to-Act,將具身決策解耦為規劃與控制:VLM 規劃器把觀察映射為稀疏的高層文字指令,語言條件化的 RSSM 世界模型控制器以控制頻率執行低階動作。訓練上,控制器沿用 Dreamer 式目標並新增事後指令監督:以 VLM 為控制器自身上線軌跡片段改標合成指令,再進行行為克隆,無需專家示範;推論時規劃與控制非同步並行,多代理情境下協調透過共享聊天室以語言完成。在七個具身環境(Atari、Minecraft Diamond、Crafter、DMLab、Overcooked、Pico Park、MindCraft)上,此解耦系統穩定優於控制器-only 與 VLM 直接生成動作的變體,在七項任務中的六項與強基線相當,指令遵循準確率約 86–97%,並支援免微調更換規劃器與穩定的跨規劃器遷移。限制包括控制器需逐環境訓練、多環境聯合訓練損失約 10% 相對效能、指令評估採單一標註者加上模型一致性檢核。此框架為在需要即時低階控制的場域部署通用語言模型提供了務實路徑。

links.title: When Context Gets Root: Privilege Escalation in LLM Harnesses

§5.3 Escalation Definition: formalizes IPE(c)=1 for tool-to-user and tool-to-system escalation via context-construction operations R_delegate and R_install.
§8.2 Table 5: tool-level baselines MCPTox/CoT Forgery/ChatInject reach at most 7/13 (Gemini CLI) and 0/13 on Claude Code and Codex, including under Auto PR.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent security paper: attacks on six coding-agent harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Kimi, OpenCode) directly match high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8). Novelty is real: 'instruction privilege escalation' differs from prompt injection/role confusion because the harness itself relabels tool-level content as user/system-effective during context reconstruction, formalized in §5.3 with IPE(c)=1 and a clear threat model in §6. Rigor is good but not maximal: 13 objectives, two permission regimes, three baseline attacks (§8.2 Table 5 shows near-zero baseline success, isolating the escalation effect), plus generality tests via goals/scheduled tasks (§8.5); however attempts are capped at 10, sample sizes per cell are modest (13-21, Table 10), the workload is a single TODO-app scenario, there is a minor text/table inconsistency (Codex Auto PR 70.0% in §8.4 text vs 72.2% in Table 10), and no defense or mitigation analysis is offered. primary_link.title: When Context Gets Root: Privilege Escalation in LLM Harnesses

These levels constrain which content may direct model behavior. During agent execution, however, agent harnesses construct context for each model invocation. This construction can elevate low-level content to a higher instruction level and grant it greater model-facing privilege. We introduce instruction privilege escalation. In this attack, an attacker induces an age
top5.summary_zh: 本論文探討 LLM 代理框架的指令安全問題：框架每次呼叫模型時會重建上下文，此過程可能將原本屬於 tool 層級的外部內容，重新標記為 user 或 system-effective 等較高指令層級。作者據此提出新攻擊典範「指令特權提升」（instruction privilege escalation），並以統一指令階層 tool < user < system-effective 進行形式化。與提示注入或角色混淆攻擊不同，此攻擊不靠偽造角色標記欺騙模型，而是利用多代理委派、自訂子代理安裝、持續性目標與排程任務等框架機制，由框架本身把攻擊者控制的內容提升至更高層級，使工作代理與自動權限審查（Auto PR）都將其視為可信的使用者或系統指令。評估涵蓋 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Kimi 與 OpenCode 六種編碼代理框架，以及橫跨機密性、完整性、可用性與遠端程式碼執行的 13 項攻擊目標：在完全存取模式下六個框架全部達成；支援 Auto PR 的三個框架上亦全數繞過審查成功，其中 tool-to-user 提升後平均成功率為 97.3%，tool-to-system 為 80.3%；相形之下，MCPTox、CoT Forgery、ChatInject 等工具層基線攻擊幾乎全數失敗，凸顯層級提升才是關鍵。研究限制包括僅針對編碼代理情境、惡意程式以明文提供而未混淆以隔離變因、部分提升路徑須在完全存取模式下驗證，且 Claude Code 需採間接誘導策略。此研究證明指令階層與權限審查共同依賴的「角色標記忠實反映內容出處」假設並不成立，對代理系統的防禦設計提出重要警示。
top5.title: When Context Gets Root: Privilege Escalation in LLM Harnesses
top5.title_zh: 當上下文取得根權限：LLM Harness 中的特權提升

links.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

evidence: Abstract: 3,808 instances, six DAG topologies, three difficulty tiers; hard without-GT alignment converges to a 77-82% band across all six judges, with GT exposure reducing alignment for GPT-5.4 (-1.5 pp) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (-3.9 pp).
Sec 3.2 / Table 2: full factorial alignment results across five generators, six judges, three difficulties, both GT conditions; QwQ-32B leads with-GT in 10 of 15 cells while never leading without-GT.
Appendix E (Table 10): 95% bootstrap CIs (n=2,000 stratified resamples) with half-widths <=0.3 pp for every cell, supporting robustness of monotone difficulty effects.

Appendix G (Tables 12-13): 120-record human study validates the programmatic scorer at 92.7% overall (82.5% on parameter structure); GPT-OSS-120B is most human-aligned judge (Delta=-2.8 pp) and QwQ-32B drops 1st to 4th under human verdicts.
Appendix N (Table 20): rewrite validation unanimity is 93.9% for hard-vs-medium but only 58.1% for medium-vs-easy, with the paper explicitly downgrading the medium tier to a robustness check.

Sec 4.2 RQ5 (Table 5/26): CoT thinking on/off changes alignment by at most 0.3 pp across 24 paired cells; RQ6 (Table 31): structured prompt advantage of +4.8 to +6.5 pp on one pairing only partially replicates and reverses on hard queries (+3.9/+2.4/-0.8 pp).
Appendix J (Table 1): C3 corrupted-GT control shows Gemini-2.5-Pro anchors to any reference block while QwQ-32B tracks its without-GT score within 0.2 pp.
Appendix O (Table 23): GPT-5.4 self-preference check finds aggregate bias +0.012 within cross-generator range but a localized sequence-accuracy over-credit of +0.172 vs <=+0.008 elsewhere.

Limitations / Appendix B: single-annotator validation, synthetic records with domain-drift risk, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot, and evaluation-time-only scope are all explicitly acknowledged and partially bounded (ranking shifts <=0.09 pp under generous correction).

Supplementary Material: dataset and all judge verdicts on HuggingFace (ServiceNow-AI/AgentJudgeBench) and pipeline code with reproducibility script via SyGra GitHub; verbatim prompts in Appendix W; GPT-5.4 identifier is a non-versioned Azure snapshot (Appendix M/P).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope: a systematic reliability study of LLM-as-judge for agentic tool-calling, directly hitting top-weighted preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, evaluation/benchmarking, CoT ablation, prompt-format sensitivity). Novelty is solid though incremental in parts: individual ingredients (BFCL-style data, DAG benchmarks, judge models) exist, but the paired with/without-GT protocol with difficulty stratification, per-metric decomposition, and deterministic programmatic reference is a genuinely new combination (Appendix L comparison). Rigor is strong: full 5x6x3x2 factorial (321,648 evaluations, Appendix D), bootstrap CIs <=0.3 pp (Appendix E), corrupted-GT C3 control (Appendix J), 0.5-default C2 ablation (Table 4), CoT and temperature ablations each replicated on a second pairing (Appendix R), scorer human validation (Appendix G), self-preference check (Appendix O), and unusually honest limitations (single annotator, 58.1% medium-tier validation, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot). Evidence strength is high; key claims are backed by tables with CIs and bounded corrections (Table 15). Generalizability is the weakest axis: synthetic single-shot records, domain drift acknowledged, ceiling partly prompt-dependent for weak generators, and judge rankings are model-version-specific. Reproducibility is good (code, HF dataset, verbatim prompts in Appendix W) but marred by the non-reproducible GPT-5.4 Azure snapshot used as generator, judge, and meta-judge.

primary_link.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

top5.summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate agentic tool-calling systems, yet their reliability on structured, dependency-driven workflows remains largely unexamined. We present AgentJudgeBench, the first benchmark to systematically study LLM-as-a-judge reliability for agentic tool-calling over workflow DAGs, as distinct from the broader LLM-as-a-judge task of open-ended text or preference evaluation. The benchmark comprises 3,808 instances spanning six DAG topologies and three difficulty tiers, eval
top5.summary_zh: LLM 裁判已廣泛用於評估代理式工具呼叫系統，但在結構化、依賴驅動工作流程上的可靠性長期未被檢驗。本文提出 AgentJudgeBench，首個針對工作流程 DAG 上 LLM-as-a-judge 可靠性的系統性基準：包含 3,808 筆 BFCL 風格資料，橫跨六種 DAG 拓撲與三個難度層級，每筆均附經程式化驗證的 ground-truth 軌跡。五個生成器（3B–70B 開源模型與 GPT-5.4）產出工具呼叫預測，由六個裁判（20B 至前沿規模）在有／無 ground truth 的配對條件下，就工具選擇、參數結構、序列準確性與查詢覆蓋四項指標評分，合計 321,648 次評估。主要結果：裁判對齊度隨難度單調下降，無 ground truth 時降幅約 1.5 倍；高難度且無參考答案時，六個裁判不論規模皆收斂於 77–82% 窄幅區間，顯示模型容量無法克服的結構性天花板；提供 ground truth 未必有利，GPT-5.4 與 Gemini-2.5-Pro 對齊度反而下降，符合過度錨定；思維鏈推理與取樣溫度影響可忽略，結構化評分準則最多提升 6.5 個百分點但未必通用。有 ground truth 時 QwQ-32B 最貼近程式化參考，GPT-OSS-120B 最貼近人類判斷。限制包括資料為合成生成、程式化評分器在參數結構指標上與人類一致度僅 82.5%，medium 難度未完全校準，且 GPT-5.4 身兼生成器、裁判與改寫驗證的 meta-judge。本研究揭露 LLM 裁判的根本限制，為代理系統評估提供部署指引，警示不宜單一依賴任何裁判。

links.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization

evidence: Abstract + Table 2: claim 'raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT' matches reported averages (Base 38.0, TTPO 45.2 over AIME26/HMMT26/BRUMO25).
Abstract + Table 7: non-thinking gains +25.2/+30.6/+36.4 correspond to Base 9.5/19.9/20.3 vs TTPO 34.7/50.5/56.7 averages.

Section 4.1: evaluation is Avg@12 at temperature 1.0; OPSD/TTPO trained 100 steps with 'peak performance across checkpoints saved every 25 steps', GRPO/TTRL 500 steps with peak across all checkpoints — peak selection without error bars.

Section 3.2 / Figure 1(a): asserts pseudo-labels wrong on ~85% of AIME 2026 prompts and ~79% of disagreeing rollouts wrong; the 85% figure is not analyzed per problem and sits uneasily with the 37.8 base Avg@12 and K=64 voting.
Table 1: TTPO vs label-supervised OPSD margins are 40.1 vs 39.7 (1.7B), 58.6 vs 58.4 (4B), 62.6 vs 61.7 (8B) — within plausible noise, no variance reported.
Section 4.3 / Table 3: token-level ablations (TTPO 46.5/31.6/54.7 vs w/o pos. weight 43.3/30.6/52.8 and w/o neg. mask 45.4/29.5/50.0) support both components.
Figure 3: update-strategy ablation shows full TTPO (48.9) beats all alternatives including reversed assignment (37.2) on Qwen3-1.7B AIME26 TTT.

Appendix A (Tables 5-6) and Appendix B: full training/eval hyperparameters (LoRA r=64, alpha=128, lr 5e-6, K=64, lambda=0.1, 16k sampling / 1,024 gradient tokens) and prompt templates; code URL given in Abstract.
Appendix F: limitations explicitly cover majority-vote dependence, restriction to math with verifiable answers, and fixed curriculum; code generation and open-ended reasoning unexplored.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic LLM reasoning paper: label-free test-time training via an asymmetric objective (OPSD distillation on majority-vote-agreeing rollouts, GRPO penalties on disagreeing ones) with token-level weighting/masking, evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B across five competition math benchmarks. Strong preference fit (LLMs, chain-of-thought reasoning, RL/GRPO, LoRA fine-tuning). Novelty is moderate: the asymmetric routing and the empirical observation that ~79% of disagreeing rollouts are wrong regardless of pseudo-label correctness are a genuine contribution, but components (TTRL, OPSD, TIP, STAPO token selection) are assembled from prior work. Rigor is good: four baselines including label-free and label-supervised, extensive ablations (Table 3 token selection, Figure 3 update-strategy grid, Table 4 privileged information, Tables 8-10 hyperparameter sweeps), theory appendix (E), and explicit limitations (Appendix F). Deductions: all methods report peak-across-checkpoint accuracy (Section 4.1) which inflates absolute numbers; headline 'matches or exceeds label-supervised OPSD' rests on 0.2-0.9 avg-point margins (Table 1) without error bars or significance tests; the ~85% wrong-pseudo-label rate (Section 3.2) seems internally high given a 37.8 base Avg@12 and K=64 voting, and is not broken down per problem; the surprising 'pseudo-labels beat ground-truth supervision' result (Figure 5) has plausible but unverified explanations. Generalizability is limited to verifiable-answer math on one model family, acknowledged in Appendix F. Reproducibility is solid: code link, full hyperparameter tables (Appendix A, Tables 5-6), prompt templates (Appendix B).

primary_link.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization

top5.summary: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型在無標籤情境下進行測試時訓練（TTT）的難題。現行後訓練方法如強化學習（RLVR）與 on-policy 自我蒸餾（OPSD）皆仰賴標準答案；改用多數決虛擬標籤時，錯誤共識會污染教師模型，在每個 token 上誤導訓練——在競賽級題目上虛擬標籤約有 85% 是錯的。作者觀察到關鍵的不對稱性：與虛擬標籤不一致的 rollout 中約 79% 本身也是錯的，因此懲罰「不一致」樣本不論標籤對錯幾乎都正確。據此提出 TTPO 不對稱目標：對一致的正樣本施以前向 KL 為基礎的 OPSD 蒸餾，並以 token 加權聚焦學生尚未掌握的位置；對不一致的負樣本施以 GRPO 懲罰，並以遮罩只懲罰導致失敗的自信錯誤。在 AIME、HMMT、BRUMO 五個競賽級數學基準上，完全不用標籤的 TTPO 即追平或超越使用標準答案的 OPSD；純 TTT 設定下將 Qwen3-1.7B 平均準確率由 38.0% 提升至 45.2%；關閉思考模式時增益達 +25.2 至 +36.4 個百分點，並展現跨基準遷移與自我演進能力。有趣的是，以虛擬標籤訓練反而勝過使用標準答案，因為過難的真實標籤使兩個分支同時缺乏學習訊號。限制包括依賴多數決品質、僅驗證於具可驗證答案的數學領域，以及採用固定的訓練課程。此研究為無標籤的測試時自我改良提供了穩健且有效的新方向。

links.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds

evidence: Section 3.3, Table 2: GraphSU achieves 46.83% soft leakage at retain PPL 3.27 on TOFU complete deletion, lowest among methods satisfying PPL<=10; GRU's 38.13% violates the constraint at PPL 79.11.

Section 3.3: Seed-Only ablation uses the same unlearning objective but omits the graph controller, isolating scope-control effects; reductions of 46.42/41.65/18.33 points on TOFU and 49.50/21.66/12.22 on PISTOL across settings.

Appendix F, Table 8: taxonomy-blind free-form probes (736 all-target, 342 confirmed-attack) evaluated with five detectors; combined-detector reduction 13.59 pp with 95% CI [8.97, 18.34] and McNemar p=5.98e-10.

Appendix D: local Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct extraction swap yields soft leakage 49.83% vs 46.83% (GPT-4.1); 40% graph-critical corruption retains 66/72 support nodes with diffusion-score correlation >=0.9974.
Appendix A: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct complete deletion shows 13.33% vs Seed-Only 93.67% leakage at PPL 1.96 vs 1.05; PPL definition correction (exp(0.03)≈1.03) documented.
Appendix J: the archive lacks a leave-one-view-out sweep for the five affinity terms and independent sweeps over rho, hop limit, and budget B; gains are not attributed to a single view.
Appendix K: unlearning runs use one training seed; no across-seed variance reported and none fabricated.
Limitations section: soft leakage measures behavioral recoverability under fixed route probes, not certified representational erasure.
Appendix H, Table 9: graph build at 4K samples takes 452.36s with 7.82MB cache and 4.01s warm selection; exact cosine retrieval is quadratic and flagged as bottleneck.
Section 3.1, Table 1: baselines GA, GA+KL, DPO, NPO-TR, AltPO, GRU, SELU from same SFT checkpoint with shared forget seeds and prompts; per-setting hyperparameters given but full sweeps deferred.
llm_evaluation.rationale: On-topic LLM methodology paper: selective unlearning for fine-tuned language models with privacy/compliance motivation, adversarial recovery-probe evaluation, and safety-adjacent framing, aligning with high-weight LLM, AI Safety, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences; no out-of-scope domain trigger. Novelty is solid but incremental: scope expansion beyond forget seeds via related-knowledge removal (UIPE, Wei et al.) and influence-style attribution (Koh & Liang, TRAK) exist; the multi-view support graph with restart-diffusion and graded forgetting strengths (Section 2.3-2.5) is a credible new controller, explicitly separated from the loss. Rigor is strong: matched Seed-Only ablation sharing the same objective (Section 3.3), seven baselines, three deletion settings, two datasets, two backbones (Table 2, Appendix A), local-extractor swap with corruption stress tests (Appendix D), and taxonomy-blind LLM-generated probes with bootstrap CIs and McNemar tests (Appendix F/Table 8). Evidence is weakened by a single training seed (Appendix K), absence of leave-one-view-out or fusion-weight sweeps (Appendix J), self-defined soft-leakage metric with tau=0.85, small models (GPT-2 Medium, Llama-3.2-3B), and a post-hoc PPL<=10 feasibility guardrail, though Appendix B shows Pareto robustness across caps 5-50 and honest reporting of residual partial-deletion leakage (81.67% TOFU). Generalizability is limited to QA-format English unlearning benchmarks; beyond-QA applicability is argued (Appendix A) but not tested, and quadratic candidate retrieval is a scaling bottleneck (Appendix H). Reproducibility is aided by released anonymous code, frozen prompts/manifests, hyperparameter tables, and a validated local extraction path, but full sweeps are not provided. Calculated: 0.85*0.4 + 0.7*0.15 + 0.8*0.15 + 0.77*0.15 + 0.6*0.1 + 0.7*0.05 = 0.77.

primary_link.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds

top5.summary: Enterprises fine-tune language models on proprietary data that may later require removal due to privacy, contractual, or compliance obligations. Selective unlearning removes requested knowledge while preserving model utility, offering a practical alternative to full retraining, but existing methods treat the explicitly identified forget examples as the complete deletion scope. This is insufficient when target knowledge remains recoverable through paraphrases, aliases, or neighboring training exa
top5.summary_zh: 企業常以專有資料微調大型語言模型，但基於隱私、合約或法規義務，事後往往必須刪除特定知識。現有選擇性遺忘方法多半只針對明確標記的遺忘樣本，忽略目標知識仍可透過改寫、別名或相鄰訓練樣本被推論還原的問題。本文提出GraphSU，一個與損失函數無關的圖引導控制器：先以GPT-4.1離線抽取事實三元組，融合實體、關係、尾實體三種符號重疊、語意相似度與答案側梯度對齊共五種視圖，建構加權支援圖；再以個人化圖擴散從遺忘種子傳播刪除壓力，選出高風險支援鄰居並賦予分級遺忘強度，最後結合熵最大化、unlikelihood、表示斥力與保留損失進行更新。在TOFU與PISTOL基準上，以GPT-2 Medium與Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct評估，GraphSU在所有刪除設定下均達到保留困惑度低於10的最低軟性洩漏，相較共用相同遺忘目標的Seed-Only對照組最多降低49.5個百分點，且在736個未見過的自由形式探測提示上維持統計顯著的改善。限制方面：部分刪除仍有大量殘餘洩漏；軟性洩漏僅衡量行為層面的可達性，並非具備正式保證的表徵抹除；實驗僅使用單一訓練種子，亦未完成逐視圖消融分析。整體而言，本研究顯示可靠的知識刪除關鍵在於控制支援路徑，而非只設計遺忘損失函數，對企業部署中的隱私與合規管理具實務價值。

top5.title_zh: GraphSU：圖引導的語言模型選擇性遺忘——控制遺忘種子之外的支援路徑

links.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations'; 'PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6; mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%'
Section 3.1 Setup: 'We run each configuration twice and report the mean pass rate across the two runs' — no variance, confidence intervals, or significance tests reported anywhere

Section 3.1 Evaluation settings: one-shot setting uses 'a fresh harness state, isolating whether live steering keeps the worker on track'; self-improvement setting uses verifier outcomes only to retain/discard updates, never to create them

Table 2 / Section 4.2: steering-aided successful runs classified by manual trace inspection at 2.3% (GLM-5.1) and 10.6% (Kimi-K2.6) overall, with a stated inclusion criterion but no inter-annotator agreement or second annotator

Appendix A.1: 'We exclude 43 SWE-bench Multilingual tasks and 198 SWE-bench Pro tasks whose pinned environments cannot bootstrap the JavaScript agent runtimes... We apply the same exclusions to every harness' — lists 'will be released'
Appendix A.3: identical self-improvement instruction prepended for every harness with only harness-native [SKILL_PATH]/[MEMORY_PATH] substitutions — a good control against instruction-induced gains

Limitations: 'Iterative self-improvement repeats every task across many iterations... limits the current evaluation to three benchmarks and two open-weight backbones'; supervisor and worker share the same backbone, heterogeneous pairings 'unexplored'

Section 3.3/Figure 3(b): skill library grows from 62 to 83 (GLM-5.1) and 50 to 81 (Kimi-K2.6) over 20 iterations; Figure 3(c) reports token reductions counting all supervisor and worker assistant turns (honest accounting)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly on-topic agentic-LLM paper: a supervisor-worker harness (PILOT) enabling mid-run 'live steering' plus concurrent harness evolution (skills/memory) over frozen LLM backbones (GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6), evaluated on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro. Preference relevance is high (agents, LLMs, coding benchmarks, token-efficiency analysis). Novelty is moderate: the framing of 'live' (mid-execution) correction plus concurrent harness updates is a sensible architectural gap relative to post-hoc self-improvement work (Reflexion, ExpeL, ACE, etc.), but the components (supervisor-worker, skill libraries, memory) are well-trodden. Rigor is decent but limited: fixed backbone across harnesses, identical self-improvement instruction across harnesses (Appendix A.3), uniform task exclusions (Appendix A.1), and two settings that partially decompose steering vs. self-evolution; however, only two runs per configuration with no significance testing, no ablations of the channel mechanics or supervisor design, and manual single-pass classification of steering-aided runs (Table 2, 2.3%/10.6%). Evidence includes concrete tables and two trace-grounded case studies (Figure 4), but gains of 4-5 points on 89 tasks are not statistically supported. Generalizability is constrained to two open-weight backbones and adjacent terminal/SWE domains, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is moderately good: public GitHub claim, pseudocode (A.2), full instruction text (A.3), exclusion lists promised, though supervisor prompts, skill schemas, and update criteria are underspecified.

primary_link.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

top5.summary: Long-horizon agent runs generate experience that can improve both the current run and future work. Most self-improvement methods process this experience only after execution ends, so they cannot redirect the active run or immediately apply and validate lessons learned from it. We argue that self-improvement should instead be live, using emerging experience both to redirect the active run and to update the persistent harness. Existing agent architectures do not fully support this goal. Single-agent self-correction combines task execution and trajectory assessment within one context, while subagent delegation separates execution but typically cannot redirect an active subagent. We present PILOT, a supervisor-worker harness for live self-improvement through two coupled mechanisms: (1) live steering lets a separate supervisor redirect or abort the active worker during execution; and (2) live self-evolution distils procedures and failure modes revealed during execution into reusable skills and memory. Across two frozen backbones and three benchmarks, PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, PILOT outperforms counterpart harnesses by up to 9.8 percentage points. In the self-improvement setting, PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6. Mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%, while successful evaluations per million output tokens rise by 110.3% and 134.0%, respectively.
top5.summary_zh: 長程代理在執行任務時產生的經驗,理應能同時改善當前與未來的表現:成功軌跡可沉澱為可重複使用的程序,失敗軌跡則暴露應避免的失敗模式。然而多數自我改進方法只在執行結束後做事後檢視,既無法導正進行中的執行,也無法立即套用並驗證新學到的知識;單一代理自我修正會讓執行與監督在有限的上下文中互相干擾,子代理委派又通常要等執行結束才能取得結果並介入。對此,作者提出 PILOT,一個監督者—工作者(supervisor–worker)框架,以兩個耦合機制實現「即時自我改進」:(1)即時導引(live steering),監督者透過雙向即時通道接收工作者的通知、提問、結果與錯誤警示,並能在執行中導引或中止工作者;(2)即時自我演化(live self-evolution),將執行中浮現的有效程序、專案慣例與失敗模式沉澱為可重複使用的技能庫與記憶。模型參數全程凍結,僅演化持久化的框架狀態。在 GLM-5.1 與 Kimi-K2.6 兩個凍結骨幹及 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro 三項基準上,PILOT 於六種組合中的五種排名第一,Terminal-Bench 2.0 最高領先對手 9.8 個百分點;在自我改進設定下,最佳通過率分別提升 14.6 與 12.4 個百分點,平均輸出 token 減少 42.9% 與 47.4%,每百萬輸出 token 的成功評估數增加 110.3% 與 134.0%,技能庫由 62、50 個成長至 83、81 個,且增益在困難任務上最為顯著。限制方面,迭代式自我改進成本高昂,評估僅涵蓋三項基準與兩個開放權重模型;監督者與工作者共用同一模型,異質配對的取捨尚待探索。本文的價值在於將「導正當前執行」與「累積可重用經驗」整合成單一連續迴路,使代理的自我改進能即時發生並跨任務延續。
top5.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
top5.title_zh: PILOT in the Loop:長程代理的即時自我改進
